prs.body:
## What this PR does

Add persisted diagnostics for Managed sessions: committed main-request context, cumulative model statistics, configured Skills/MCP resources, tool/file/Skill activity, and expandable child-invocation relationships. Authorized Public and WebShell reads use Session-owned journal evidence and SQL projections, including when the runtime is stopped.

The current branch includes execution diagnostics carried from #16499 in `d303213cf0`, alongside the original session diagnostics. The combined surface has six Public/WebShell API pairs and five diagnostic tabs. Execution evidence, Tool v4 attestation, occurrence identities, atomic replay-safe projections, resource closure and recovery compatibility are versioned together. It reuses existing tables and adds no DDL.

The follow-up restores credential rejection before the explicit writer transaction and aligns CSI `/3` acceptance initialization and diagnostic argument forwarding with the real entry point. Existing private-connection and native-proof checks remain in force; exact transaction/SQL inventories track the intended admission contract. Small conversions and capability resolution use existing helpers. The approval failover check now requires storage 4, matching execution evidence, while preserving the phase, request identity and zero-execution barriers. Upstream source-size corrections are integrated, so the class ceilings now match main and the temporary exception is removed.

## Why it's needed

Managed sessions need durable answers about model usage, tool outcomes, explicit file operations, loaded Skill instructions and child calls after refresh, replay or recovery. Separate requested/admitted/executed/captured/delivered states and explicit coverage gaps keep missing evidence from appearing as a successful call or a measured zero.

## Reviewer Test Plan

Verify the combined persisted behavior and its authorization/recovery boundaries on the current head. Historical checks below are tied to their tested revisions; acceptance of the combined head remains pending CI.

### How to verify

1. Run a Managed session with model calls, an explicit file read/edit, a Skill instruction load and a direct child call. Open Context, Statistics, Activity, Resources and Agents. Check that configured resources and actual recorded usage remain distinct, and that omitted/unknown evidence is explicit.
2. Include Hook/compression model calls, replay committed events, and cold-resume a turn. Totals must not double-count, fractional raw budget accounting must survive, and a Hook or failed/uncommitted request must not replace the committed main-request context.
3. Exercise refused, cancelled and partially delivered calls. Requested, admitted, executed and delivered counts must describe their own evidence. File activity covers explicit tools; arbitrary Shell/MCP filesystem effects and Skill-to-action causality must not be invented.
4. Expand and paginate child invocations. Each child read must retain authorization, stable cursors and row/byte/node bounds. Restricted children must not leak data. The tree does not enable recursive execution or claim whole-subtree totals; current execution admission still allows one child level.
5. Stop the runtime and query persisted diagnostics. Diagnostic reads must not acquire/resume execution or trigger MCP rediscovery. Verify compatible recovery/export reference closure and explicit refusals when a reader/profile cannot preserve promoted evidence.
6. Switch session/actor, close the dialog or revoke access while a query is pending. Old responses must not reappear; stopped-session views must continue to enforce authorization.
7. Commit a verified external publication outcome above 64 KiB with diagnostics enabled, replay it and rebuild missing derived records through writer admission. The business receipt must remain valid, known facts and counts must survive, and diagnostics must explicitly report partial coverage without object reads under the Session fence; inline corruption and changed references must still be rejected.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: basic model context and task/history data did not provide the complete persisted diagnostic and execution-activity views.

After: the combined UI and API expose the five bounded views above. Carried API-fixture render evidence is available for [desktop tool activity](docs/assets/managed-execution-diagnostics/activity-tools-desktop.png) and the [390px invocation view](docs/assets/managed-execution-diagnostics/activity-child-mobile.png). These show fixture-backed UI behavior and do not establish a live backend-to-browser flow on the current head.

Current head `fe6b586a4ae301352ba528599edffc74ac6b104f` additionally corrects the Hosted qualification fixtures: the parallel-child question case now boots with a supported Shell approval configuration, cleanup retry comparison accepts explicit boolean `drain:true` while retaining exact original Session/runtime/binding/generation and every other field, and the restart question case waits at most 30 seconds for its same final transcript marker within the unchanged outer timeout. Final states, two model calls, zero duplicate tool effects, child isolation and exactly-once assertions remain. fg11f records at most 16 tenant-scoped outcome/publication/head metadata rows after the original logs; this is a non-atomic teardown sample with no bodies or credentials, not a claimed recovery fix.

The newest test-only increment passed root typecheck, ESLint/formatting, 28 cleanup tests and 12 pure-Node positive/negative controls against retained CI requests. Existing root build evidence remains applicable to unchanged production inputs. No Java/Maven/MySQL execution was started locally; the shared ledger remains 599.08/600 seconds. The manually dispatched [full MySQL job](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42434013143/job/128588848011) tested exact head `fe6b586a4ae301352ba528599edffc74ac6b104f` and passed 1,648 integration tests across all 91 non-Hosted classes, with zero failures/errors/skips and the complete-source report guard passing. Its unit/H2 summary reports 6,452 tests, zero failures/errors and 17 skips; CSI native-activation, diagnostic-projection and SQL-worker classes executed 25, 3 and 8 tests respectively without skips. The [Java fast job](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42433935487/job/128588896148) also passed the 6,452-test Managed verification summary (17 skips), testing integration merge `ae3ebe1c7c3f5a7f4401bc485f69044bd9bb3e2e` of this head into main `533fc4b57b2683122ad41337c18f3a808a7c8a8b`. The [approval-event gate](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42436882644) has selected full on that integration merge and is executing. Hosted process/failover lanes remain queued, and four formal CHANGES_REQUESTED reviews remain. These unit/SQL results do not establish fg11f or complete process-recovery acceptance.

Current-head Qwen Code CI run [42433935414](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42433935414) failed three jobs and two consequential aggregates in attempt 1. no-AK shard3 passes 151 tests before HOME cleanup fails. Nine browser retry1 traces show module ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED. A separate Pierre failure is now traced to Playwright retaining a virtualized DOM row across pointer retries: the target changes from app.ts to README.md to report.xlsx, and the final input already targets report.xlsx; the application selects that same file. The pinned Playwright 1.61.1 implementation retains the handle unless detached. This supports an automation-fixture flake rather than an observed application selecting a different clicked file; the timing trigger remains unproven. After checking all five failures and the unchanged head, one grouped failed-job retry was requested and read back as attempt 2. No further retry is allowed for this workflow; a repeated failure requires investigation. The earlier one-worker local single-case pass does not clear CI or fix the fixture. No product code or assertions were changed.

The preceding fix head `05db158d44` includes the storage assertion correction `ff86ca4228`, the external-publication diagnostic boundary correction `55afe29c10`, and main `c9179469ab` via merge `05db158d44` (the lock-inventory ordering conflict retains both independent method changes). The Hosted statistics fixture now requires exact storage 4 after the first model-only turn; it retains the statistics, cancellation, replay and cold-load assertions. Empty execution evidence continues to declare format capability and is not suppressed to keep storage 3. The earlier 56-case approval-barrier script result remains valid for its unchanged source; it was not rerun for this Java increment.

A separate PR-owned defect was found while inspecting the failed Hosted artifacts: ordinary publication admission legally stores an outcome larger than 64 KiB as verified external data without inline bytes, but the new diagnostic reducer passed it to an inline/chunk-only CSI reader and rejected the authoritative receipt. The correction preserves known diagnostic facts and counts, marks `receipt_outcome_not_inline` partial coverage, and does not fetch object storage under the Session fence. Cold rebuild now receives the existing Session-scoped, verified journal resource reader, preserving tenant/Workspace/publication checks. Inline and native chunk integrity checks, external corruption verification and business receipt semantics remain unchanged. Four focused reducer regressions and the real publication fixture's commit/replay/public-result/corruption assertions now cover the boundary; the latter additionally deletes derived records, rebuilds through writer admission and asserts no extra object reads. These Java tests remain unrun locally. Current-head CI now compiles and executes their owning classes: reducer 4 tests, publication 128 tests (including the ordinary large-outcome parameterized fixture), row-lock 2 tests and surface-capture 1 test, all with zero failures/errors/skips. This class-level log evidence is separate from still-pending Hosted recovery.

The branch includes main's CI routing update [#16551](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/commit/65e1f1aeaa) and earlier source-size repair [#16542](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/commit/0b54b9be999b68d9c2d322a771ea9c171c733511). The temporary allowance remains removed: the two pins match main at 1326 and 2943, source counts remain 1326 and 2941, and the global ceiling is 3328. No CI selector, class ceiling or native guard was weakened.

On the final main-integrated source tree, root build/typecheck passed using Node 22.22.3 with sandbox building disabled. Focused checks passed: Core 335, CLI 83, WebShell 170, the two changed workflow meta-test files 260, and the failure-signature script 63. The prior 107 routing tests remain valid for unchanged inputs. Documentation formatting and reference checks passed. The lock-inventory conflict resolution retains both independent method contracts in 290 unique sorted entries; static inventory review is not Java compilation or execution. Earlier macOS workflow-helper attempts remain failed/incomplete (209 passed / 42 failed around Linux wrapper fixtures with missing `/usr/bin/rm`; a broader combination timed out at 100 seconds). Formal local feature-wide review was not run because its required foreground workflow tool is unavailable. Static source/test-engineer review is separate evidence.

Historical CI for prior head `a41e2f5de3` ran integration merge `73cedfb41b` (base `a7a65e1783`). [Java fast](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42395012719/job/128470947444) reports 6,445 tests, zero failures/errors and 17 skips; [full MySQL](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42396023138/job/128491553573) reports 1,648 tests across 91 classes with zero failures/errors/skips and the complete-source coverage guard passing, including all eight CSI SQL-worker cases. [Hosted failover](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42396023138/job/128491553510) passed all 27 real scenarios, including 16 approval crash/recovery modes; all 16 retained original action/terminal identity, completed the next Turn with one request, closed the Session and removed the old Harness home. Its sole Node retry and associated WebShell smoke, TUI parity, Serve A/B, no-AK, Java platform and EventTransport gates succeeded. These results do not certify the new Java increment.

The prior-head [Hosted process-fault/admission/O4 job](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42396023138/job/128491553558) completed with 183 tests, three failures, two errors and four skips; its aggregate consequently failed. One failure is the PR-owned exact-storage-3 assertion corrected above. Two have unchanged upstream fixture/contract contradictions: the child-question fixture enables Shell with unsupported default `yolo` approval, and the broker-reply-loss fixture's exact cleanup-payload comparison rejects existing `drain:true` behavior. They are not established network or port flakes. The structured-question transcript failure remains unclassified. fg11f `drop-ack-after-write` is a persistent writes-stopped/recovery failure with the original CSI-proof-unavailable message; its artifacts omit admission bytes and the original receipt rejection stack, so the external-outcome fix is not proof that fg11f is resolved. This mixed-failure workflow was not rerun. The normal PR gate selects fast for pushes. After the earlier push-dismissed approval, yiliang114 approved the current head at 2026-11-08T02:03:32Z; its approval-event gate has selected full and started execution on integration merge `ae3ebe1c7c3f5a7f4401bc485f69044bd9bb3e2e`. The manual qualification now has current-head MySQL evidence, while its Hosted lanes remain queued. Skipped fast-tier lanes do not count as passed coverage; the PR is not merge-ready.

Process-local legacy `UiTelemetry.models` is not reseeded by diagnostic cold restore; the supplied A/B confirms this internal difference. Managed Public/WebShell statistics read persisted SQL projections, and the reported harness did not drive the ACP registered-session route. Exact custom-embedding ledger restoration is deferred; bounded statistics cannot faithfully recover fractional legacy metrics.

No local Java/Maven/MySQL validation has been restarted; the shared budget remains 599.08/600 seconds. Final Java corrections are unvalidated locally. The broader same-id/new-boot CSI `/1` downgrade probe still returned 503 in its local adapter; real server downgrade retry remains unverified. Live backend-to-browser cold recovery, full release qualification and operator deployment agreement remain incomplete.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ Build/typecheck and 107 CI-routing meta-tests passed on the main-integrated tree; unchanged 56-case script evidence is reused. New Java checks are CI-pending; workflow-helper and acceptance limits are recorded above. |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally on the combined head. |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally; current-head CI status is described above. |

### Environment (optional)

Historical focused local checks used macOS and Node 22.22.3. CI uses Node 22, Java 21 and disposable MySQL 8.4 where required. Browser evidence uses API fixtures with Chromium desktop/mobile viewports. No local Java, Maven or MySQL process was started for this follow-up.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: durable occurrence identity, source-reference closure, atomic projection replay and writer fencing must agree across Harness, Server/Broker and CSI workers. Bounded summaries, samples and detail pages expose gaps/overflow rather than unlimited history.
- Not validated / out of scope: remaining current-head Hosted/native-CSI and UI acceptance, real backend-to-browser cold recovery, query-plan/write-overhead qualification and operator deployment agreement remain incomplete. Sources, PR metadata, grouping/pinning/colors, arbitrary filesystem auditing, complete model/tool waterfalls, Skill causal attribution, recursive execution and whole-subtree aggregation are excluded. Formal local review and the separate downgrade-retry limitation remain disclosed above.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no new tables, DDL or database schema version. Diagnostic source commits can advance the stored reader floor to storage 3 for model diagnostics and storage 4 for execution evidence; CSI `/2` and `/3` have distinct pinned profiles. Old readers/writers must preserve the negotiated evidence or be refused. A promoted session must not silently fall back to an older worker.

Combined release order:

1. Upgrade and verify CLI/Harness and CSI worker readers for storage 1/2/3/4 and the admitted CSI profiles, then warm a compatible Server/Broker reader/projector pool.
2. Verify the negotiated floor/profile, drain or isolate old readers and writers, and direct new producer traffic to that compatible pool with a coordinated blue/green cutover. Producer capability follows binary/profile selection; no independent rollout flag is assumed.
3. Keep promoted sessions on compatible workers during rollback, or leave them unavailable. Reader-first fleet agreement and deployment are release prerequisites; this PR monitor has not performed or confirmed them.

Designs: [session diagnostics English](docs/design/2026-11-06-managed-session-diagnostics-and-organization.md), [中文](docs/design/2026-11-06-managed-session-diagnostics-and-organization.zh-CN.md); [execution diagnostics English](docs/design/2026-11-07-managed-session-execution-diagnostics.md), [中文](docs/design/2026-11-07-managed-session-execution-diagnostics.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

N/A. Related PR: #16499, whose execution-diagnostics changes are carried in the current branch. No issue is closed by this description.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

为 Managed 会话增加持久化诊断：已提交主请求的 context、累计模型统计、已配置 Skills/MCP 资源、工具/文件/Skill 活动，以及可展开的子调用关系。经过授权的 Public 和 WebShell 查询读取会话所属 journal 证据与 SQL 投影，Runtime 停止后也可读取。

当前分支在原会话诊断基础上，包含 `d303213cf0` 从 #16499 带入的执行诊断。合并范围共有六组 Public/WebShell API 对和五个诊断页签。执行证据、Tool v4 attestation、调用发生身份、原子且重放安全的投影、资源闭包与恢复兼容性共同版本化。复用现有表，不新增 DDL。

后续修复恢复了显式 writer 事务之前的凭据拒绝，并让 CSI `/3` 验收初始化及诊断参数透传与真实入口一致。继续保留私有连接和 native proof 校验，精确事务/SQL 清单对齐既定接纳合同。小型转换及能力解析使用已有 helper。审批故障恢复检查现在要求与执行证据一致的 storage 4，并保留阶段、请求身份及零执行屏障。已合入上游源码行数修正，类上限现在与 main 一致，临时例外已移除。

## 为什么需要

Managed 会话需要在刷新、重放或恢复后，仍能查询模型用量、工具结果、显式文件操作、已加载的 Skill 指令和子调用。分别表达请求、接纳、执行、捕获、交付状态，并明确覆盖缺口，避免把缺失证据显示为成功调用或已测得的零。

## 评审测试计划

在当前 head 验证合并后的持久化行为及授权、恢复边界。下方历史验证绑定各自测试版本；合并 head 的验收仍等待 CI。

### 如何验证

1. 执行包含模型请求、显式文件读写、Skill 指令加载和直接子调用的 Managed 会话。打开 Context、Statistics、Activity、Resources 和 Agents，确认已配置资源与实际记录的使用事实明确区分，省略或未知证据显式显示。
2. 包含 Hook/压缩模型请求、已提交事件重放及 Turn 冷恢复。累计值不得重复统计，小数原始预算应保留，Hook 或失败、未提交请求不得替换已提交主请求 context。
3. 覆盖拒绝、取消和部分交付调用。请求、接纳、执行、交付计数分别遵循其证据。文件活动仅覆盖显式工具，不得推断任意 Shell/MCP 文件系统副作用或 Skill 到后续动作的因果关系。
4. 展开并分页查询子调用。每次 child 读取均保留授权、稳定游标及行数/字节/节点边界，受限 child 不得泄露数据。树形视图不启用递归执行，也不宣称整棵子树总量；当前执行接纳仍只允许一层 child。
5. 停止 Runtime 后读取持久化诊断。诊断查询不得获取或恢复执行，也不得触发 MCP 重新发现。验证兼容恢复/导出的引用闭包，以及 reader/profile 无法保留升级证据时的明确拒绝。
6. 在查询中切换会话/actor、关闭弹窗或撤销权限。旧响应不得重新显示；停止会话的视图仍须持续执行授权检查。
7. 启用诊断后提交超过 64 KiB、已验证的外置 publication outcome，重放回执并经 writer 准入重建缺失的派生记录。业务回执应保持有效，已知事实和计数应保留；诊断明确显示部分覆盖，不持有 Session fence 读取对象；内联损坏及变更的引用仍被拒绝。

### 证据（前后对比）

之前：基本模型 context 和任务/历史信息无法提供完整的持久化诊断与执行活动视图。

之后：合并后的 UI 与 API 提供上述五种有界视图。带入的 API fixture 渲染证据包含[桌面工具活动](docs/assets/managed-execution-diagnostics/activity-tools-desktop.png)和 [390px 子调用视图](docs/assets/managed-execution-diagnostics/activity-child-mobile.png)。它们证明 fixture 支撑的 UI 行为，不证明当前 head 的真实后端到浏览器链路。

当前 head `fe6b586a4ae301352ba528599edffc74ac6b104f` 还修正了 Hosted 验收夹具：并行子问题用例现在使用支持 Shell 的审批配置启动；cleanup 重试比较允许显式 boolean `drain:true`，仍精确检查原 Session/runtime/binding/generation 及其余所有字段；提问重启用例在不变的外层超时内，最多等待 30 秒出现同一个最终 transcript 标记。终态、两次模型请求、无重复工具副作用、child 隔离和 exactly-once 断言保留。fg11f 在原日志保存之后，按 tenant 最多记录各 16 条 outcome/publication/head 元数据；它是非原子 teardown 采样，不含正文或凭据，不作为已修复恢复缺陷的声明。

最新仅测试代码增量通过根 typecheck、ESLint/格式、28 项 cleanup 测试和基于保留 CI 请求的 12 项纯 Node 正负控；生产输入未变，复用既有根 build。本地没有启动 Java/Maven/MySQL，共享账本仍为 599.08/600 秒。手动完整[MySQL 作业](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42434013143/job/128588848011)直接测试准确 head `fe6b586a4ae301352ba528599edffc74ac6b104f`：91 个非 Hosted 类、1,648 项集成测试，0 失败/错误/跳过，完整源码报告门禁通过；其 unit/H2 汇总为 6,452 项、0 失败/错误、17 跳过。CSI native-activation、诊断投影、SQL-worker 类分别执行 25、3、8 项，均无跳过。[Java fast](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42433935487/job/128588896148)的 Managed verification 汇总同样通过（6,452 项，17 跳过），测试的是该 head 与 main `533fc4b57b2683122ad41337c18f3a808a7c8a8b` 的集成 merge `ae3ebe1c7c3f5a7f4401bc485f69044bd9bb3e2e`。[批准事件门禁](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42436882644)已在该集成 merge 选择 full 并执行。Hosted process/failover 仍排队，四条正式 CHANGES_REQUESTED 保留；这些单测/SQL 结果不代表 fg11f 或完整进程恢复验收通过。

prs.title: ci: raise the ephemeral runner slot cap to 64 per host
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Raises the per-host slot cap for the disposable (ephemeral) GitHub Actions runner manager from 10 to 64, and records the new cap in the manager README and the design document. A regression test now confirms a larger pool (for example 30 slots) is accepted while a value past the new cap is still rejected.

## Why it's needed

The hz4 ephemeral pool routes untrusted fork PR jobs and is queueing at its ten-slot ceiling, which throttles external PR CI. The host is provisioned strongly enough to run more concurrent slots, but the manager's validation rejected any value above 10, so operators could not grow the pool through configuration. This change makes capacity a host-scoped configuration decision again, without introducing queue-driven autoscaling. After merge, growing hz4 to (for example) 30 slots only requires updating `/etc/qwen-ephemeral-runner/config.json` on the host and restarting the service — no further code change.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm the validation boundary: a host config with `slots` set to a value between 11 and 64 is accepted, and a value above 64 is rejected with `Invalid manager configuration`. Behavior is otherwise unchanged — each slot still registers one just-in-time runner in its own container and network.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (configuration-validation change; no UI). Before: `slots: 30` failed validation. After: accepted.

`node --test scripts/ci/ephemeral-runner/manager.test.mjs` → 25 tests, 25 pass.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit test only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: raising the cap lets a single host be configured with many more concurrent containers; operators must size the host (CPU, memory, Docker networks) before increasing `slots`.
- Not validated / out of scope: actually running 30 concurrent slots on hz4 — that is a host configuration and capacity step done after merge, not exercised here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; existing `slots: 10` configurations are unaffected.

Design doc (both languages updated): docs/design/2026-11-07-ephemeral-container-runners.md / docs/design/2026-11-07-ephemeral-container-runners.zh-CN.md

## Linked Issues

References #16514

prs.title: fix(cli): never terminally release a config-scoped Hook owner on a detach
prs.body:
## What

A detach must never terminally release a config-scoped Hook owner. Both held-Runtime drains (lifecycle-v1 close and lifecycle-v2 `settle_resources`) now skip such an id unless the close is terminal, and the predicate is one shared export instead of another copy of the prefix.

## Why

#16116 landed with this defect still in it. The fix was written and verified there, but the PR was squash-merged at an earlier head, so the commit never reached `main` — this PR carries it.

The held-Runtime restore is gated on `session.lifecycleProtocolVersion !== 2`, but that field only reaches the resident through the lifecycle-carrying spread:

```ts
...(lifecycle ? { lifecycleProtocolVersion, mcpClosing: true } : {}),
```

A bare attach carries no lifecycle authority, so the field stays `undefined`, `undefined !== 2` is true, and the restore runs. The settle route later writes the field unconditionally, so the same Session closes as v2 and drains whatever the restore seeded — including the deterministic `extensions-components-<sha256([sessionKey, configRevision])>` owner. `release({ drain: true })` is terminal and persists a `RELEASED` row under the id the next load recomputes; `acquireNewSession` refuses any non-ACQUIRING row, so every Hook on that Session answers `runtime_session_not_acquirable` after the reload.

**Re-pointing the gate would not fix it.** A load cannot know which protocol will later close the Session — the same resident can settle through v1 or v2 — so any restore-time gate on the closing protocol is predicting the future. The invariant belongs at the release, where it is decidable.

The v1 drain has the same exposure and it predates #16116: the restore runs for v1 by design and v1 closes with the same terminal release. The guard covers both.

## How

- Export `isHostedConfigScopedOwner()` from `hosted-hook-session.ts` and use it for the existing private `deterministicOwner` getter, rather than adding a fourth hardcoded `extensions-components-` prefix.
- In both drains, `continue` past a config-scoped id when the close is non-terminal (`kind !== 'delete'` for v2, `req.method !== 'DELETE'` for v1). The entry stays owed, so the mount handback still refuses busy and the detach parks honestly. A delete is terminal and still releases.
- Correct the restore-site comment that claimed the `!== 2` gate was the tombstone protection.

Stopping the background run without tombstoning the owner needs a keep-READY drain, which does not exist on the TS broker today; that is tracked separately in #16579. This PR removes the data-loss half of the problem, not the availability half.

## Reviewer test plan

**How to verify.** Load an extensions Session that has a durable hold row, without a lifecycle authority, then close it through the lifecycle-v2 path with `kind: 'close'`. Before this change the deterministic owner reaches a terminal release; after it, the owner is skipped and the ordinary held id in the same set still drains. A `DELETE` on the same Session should still release terminally.

The new case `never terminally releases a restored config-scoped owner on a v2 detach (R28-1)` encodes exactly that. It restores **two** ids — the config-scoped owner and an ordinary prompt id — and asserts the ordinary one drained while the owner did not. The ordinary id is the control: without it, a route that failed before reaching the drain would pass the test vacuously.

Deleting the v2 guard turns the case red on `expected [ …(2) ] to not include 'extensions-components-eee…'`, which is the direct demonstration of the tombstone.

## Verification

Re-run on this branch's `main` base, not carried over from #16116:

- Full build — rc 0, **zero** type errors.
- `hosted-harness-session.test.ts` — **719/719**, full file run alone (both drains changed, so every close path is in scope).
- `hosted-hook-session.test.ts` + `hosted-mcp-session.test.ts` — **208/208**, covering the extracted predicate's original caller.
- Prettier — clean.

The three changed files are byte-identical to the versions verified on #16116; the suites above were nevertheless re-run against the current `main` rather than assumed still green.

prs.title: fix(serve): refuse to validate a restored worktree whose lock is not held
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A session restore (`POST /session/:id/load` and `/resume`) now refuses to check or attest a worktree checkout whose ownership lock it does not hold.

The restore decides whether to take the worktree ownership lock from its read of the session's worktree sidecar before the bridge restore: when that read finds a sidecar that records its workspace, it locks that checkout and holds the lock to the end of the request, which is what keeps a concurrent `POST /session/:id/worktree-reset` from moving the ownership while the restore validates it. Later reads were never checked against that decision: the Channel re-read under the lock (which decides the superseded redirect) and the read after the bridge restore (which can redirect with `worktree_session_superseded`, classify `worktree_marker_missing` / `worktree_reset_interrupted`, and attest `worktreeState: 'persisted-v1'`). So a sidecar that was missing, legacy or invalid at the first read (for example a read that caught the reset's atomic rewrite), or that now names another checkout, was validated without the lock. In the worst case shown by a new test, a load that caught a reset mid-transfer redirected the caller to a replacement session that the reset then rolled back and deleted.

The restore now records the key it locked, and each later read must name the same checkout:

- at the Channel re-read under the lock, for a sidecar that records its workspace, before its superseded redirect (a sidecar that is legacy by then stays on the lock-free legacy path);
- at the start of the post-restore ownership checks, before the superseded check;
- on the resolved checkout path itself, before containment, the marker read and the attestation (the checkout may have appeared since the key was derived from its raw path).

A mismatch fails the restore closed, like the other integrity failures on that path: the restored session is released and the caller gets a 500, and a later restore re-reads the sidecar and takes the right lock. The key derivation (realpath, else the raw recorded path) moves into one helper so the lock and the checks use the same rule. The Part 4B design document (`docs/design/channel-named-sessions-part4b.md`) now states the check where it describes the lock and the superseded redirect, and corrects a pre-existing line that called the ordinary Part 4A integrity failure a `409` (it is a `500`).

## Why it's needed

The ownership lock exists so that a restore cannot attest exclusive ownership of a checkout while a reset is transferring it; without this check the guarantee held only when the first read and the later reads agreed. It was found while extracting the restore for the PR-state watch (#16583), whose in-process caller relies on the same contract.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/routes/session-worktree-reset.test.ts -t "load worktree classifications"`: 16 tests, 9 new:
  - a first read that is missing, invalid or legacy (no lock taken) followed by a sidecar that records its workspace: 500, the session is released, nothing attested;
  - a first read naming another checkout, source-less restore: 500 after the bridge restore;
  - the same for a Channel restore whose real sidecar is superseded: 500 instead of a redirect, before the bridge restore;
  - a checkout recorded through a symlinked path that is missing while the key is derived and back when it is validated: 500;
  - a checkout recorded through a symlinked path that exists: attested `persisted-v1` (the keys are canonical, not raw);
  - a first read that records its workspace and names another checkout, with every later read legacy: restored on the legacy path, unattested, no lock needed;
  - a load that runs while a reset is parked at its marker flip with the supersede link on disk: 500 instead of a `worktree_session_superseded` redirect, and the reset then rolls the link back.
- Mutants, each caught by those tests: each of the three checks dropped, all three dropped (main's behaviour: 7 of the new tests fail), the Channel check applied to a legacy sidecar too, a raw-path comparison at either read, a key that never canonicalises, the key never recorded (23 existing tests fail), and the post-restore check moved after the superseded check.
- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/server.test.ts src/serve/multi-workspace-sessions.test.ts src/serve/routes/`: 3,884 passed, 1 skipped, 1 failed — `workspace-channel-management.test.ts` "reports a failure instead of an empty journal when the scope is unreadable", which uses `chmod 000` and fails only because the run was as root.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the in-flight-reset test's load answers 409 `worktree_session_superseded` with a `replacementSessionId` the reset then deletes, the Channel case answers the same redirect from a checkout it did not lock, and the other refusing cases answer 200 with `worktreeState: 'persisted-v1'`. After: each answers 500 `Worktree ownership lock does not cover the restored checkout` and releases any restored session; the symlinked-path and legacy cases keep their outcome.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Linux, Node 22.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a restore that races a sidecar rewrite now fails with a 500 where it used to proceed unlocked; a retry succeeds. The Channel worker already treats a 5xx on wake as temporary. No writer in the repository changes a recorded `worktreePath` or upgrades a legacy sidecar, so a restore that does not race keeps its outcome.
- Not validated / out of scope: shapes only a hand-edited sidecar or an outside deletion can produce stay as they were — a legacy sidecar carrying `supersededBy` is still redirected by the Channel re-read, the interrupted-reset classification reads the other session's sidecar without a key check (daemon-written pairs share one `worktreePath`), and a checkout deleted mid-reset under a non-canonical recorded path still keys the lock by the raw path. A non-Channel restore whose first read is invalid still lets the session child run its own worktree context restore before this check refuses the session (pre-existing; bounded by the marker compare-and-set and the session's release). The orphan cleanup derives its lock key the same way in `server/worktree-orphan-cleanup.ts`; the helper is not shared because that file imports `node:fs` as a default import and `server.test.ts` mocks only the namespace's `realpathSync`. This PR and #16583 touch the same block; whichever merges second carries the change across.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Found while preparing #16583 (PR A of the design in #16246 / #16487).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

session restore（`POST /session/:id/load` 和 `/resume`）现在会拒绝在未持有某个 worktree checkout 的所有权锁时，对它做校验或打 attestation。

restore 在 bridge restore 之前读一次会话的 worktree sidecar，并据此决定是否拿 worktree 所有权锁：这次读到的 sidecar 记录了 workspace，就锁住那个 checkout，一直持有到请求结束。正是这把锁让并发的 `POST /session/:id/worktree-reset` 无法在 restore 校验期间转移所有权。但之后的读取从未与这个决定核对过：一处是 Channel 在锁内的重读，它决定 superseded 重定向；另一处是 bridge restore 之后的读，它可能以 `worktree_session_superseded` 重定向、分类出 `worktree_marker_missing` / `worktree_reset_interrupted`，或打上 `worktreeState: 'persisted-v1'`。因此第一次读时缺失、是 legacy 或 invalid 的 sidecar（例如正好读到 reset 的原子改写），或者现在指向了另一个 checkout 的 sidecar，都会在没有持锁的情况下完成校验。新测试复现了最坏的情况：一次 load 撞上进行到一半的 reset，把调用方重定向到一个随后被 reset 回滚并删除的替代会话。

现在 restore 记下自己锁住的 key，之后每次读取都必须指向同一个 checkout：

- Channel 在锁内重读时，针对记录了 workspace 的 sidecar，在其 superseded 重定向之前（届时已是 legacy 的 sidecar 仍走无锁的 legacy 路径）；
- bridge restore 之后的所有权校验开头，在 superseded 检查之前；
- 对解析出的 checkout 路径本身，在 containment、读 marker 和打 attestation 之前（key 按原始路径推出之后，checkout 可能才出现）。

不一致时 restore 以 fail closed 的方式失败，与这条路径上其他完整性失败一致：释放已恢复的会话，调用方得到 500；之后的 restore 会重读 sidecar，拿到正确的锁。key 的推导规则（realpath，失败则用记录的原始路径）收进一个函数，锁和校验共用同一规则。Part 4B 设计文档（`docs/design/channel-named-sessions-part4b.md`）在描述锁和 superseded 重定向的地方补充了这项检查，并更正了一处既有错误：那里把普通的 Part 4A 完整性失败写成了 `409`（实际是 `500`）。

## 为什么需要

所有权锁的作用，是防止 restore 在 reset 转移 checkout 期间声称独占所有权。没有这项检查，这个保证只在第一次读与之后的读一致时才成立。这个问题是在为 PR 状态监视提取 restore（#16583）时发现的，那里的进程内调用方依赖同一契约。

## 评审验证方案

### 如何验证

- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/routes/session-worktree-reset.test.ts -t "load worktree classifications"`：16 个测试，其中 9 个是新增的：
  - 第一次读为 missing、invalid 或 legacy（未拿锁），之后读到记录了 workspace 的 sidecar：返回 500，释放会话，不打 attestation；
  - 第一次读指向另一个 checkout，非 Channel restore：bridge restore 之后返回 500；
  - 同样的情况发生在真实 sidecar 已 superseded 的 Channel restore 上：在 bridge restore 之前返回 500，而不是重定向；
  - checkout 经软链接路径记录，推导 key 时不存在、校验时又出现：返回 500；
  - checkout 经软链接路径记录且存在：正常打上 `persisted-v1`（key 是规范路径，不是原始路径）；
  - 第一次读记录了 workspace 且指向另一个 checkout，之后的读都是 legacy：走 legacy 路径恢复，不打 attestation，也不需要锁；
  - reset 停在 marker 翻转处、supersede 链接已落盘时进行 load：返回 500，而不是 `worktree_session_superseded` 重定向，随后 reset 回滚该链接。
- 变异测试，每个都被上述测试抓到：
  - 逐个去掉三处检查；
  - 三处全部去掉（即 main 的行为：7 个新测试失败）；
  - Channel 处的检查也作用于 legacy sidecar；
  - 任一处读改用原始路径比较；
  - key 永不规范化；
  - 不记录持有的 key（23 个已有测试失败）；
  - 把 bridge restore 之后的检查挪到 superseded 检查之后。
- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/server.test.ts src/serve/multi-workspace-sessions.test.ts src/serve/routes/`：3,884 个通过，1 个跳过，1 个失败。失败的是 `workspace-channel-management.test.ts`「reports a failure instead of an empty journal when the scope is unreadable」，它用 `chmod 000`，只因以 root 运行而失败。

### 证据（前后对比）

修复前：reset 进行中那个测试的 load 返回 409 `worktree_session_superseded`，带着一个随后被 reset 删除的 `replacementSessionId`；Channel 用例从一个未加锁的 checkout 返回同样的重定向；其他应被拒绝的用例返回 200 和 `worktreeState: 'persisted-v1'`。修复后：这些用例都返回 500 `Worktree ownership lock does not cover the restored checkout`，并释放已恢复的会话（如有）；软链接路径和 legacy 用例的结果不变。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境

Linux，Node 22。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：与 sidecar 改写发生竞争的 restore，以前会在无锁状态下继续，现在会以 500 失败；重试即可成功。Channel worker 在唤醒时已把 5xx 视为临时失败。仓库里没有任何写入方会改动已记录的 `worktreePath`，或把 legacy sidecar 升级，所以不发生竞争的 restore 结果不变。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：
  - 只有手工改过的 sidecar 或外部删除才能造成的形态，行为保持不变：带 `supersededBy` 的 legacy sidecar 仍会被 Channel 的锁内重读重定向；reset 中断的分类读取另一个会话的 sidecar 时不核对 key（daemon 写出的一对 sidecar 共用同一个 `worktreePath`）；记录的路径不规范、且 checkout 在 reset 中途被删除时，锁仍按原始路径取 key。
  - 非 Channel restore 第一次读为 invalid 时，会话子进程仍会在本检查拒绝该会话之前，自行恢复 worktree 上下文。这是既有行为，有 marker 的 compare-and-set 和会话释放兜底。
  - orphan cleanup 在 `server/worktree-orphan-cleanup.ts` 里用同样的规则推导锁 key。没有共用同一个函数，因为那个文件以默认导入方式引入 `node:fs`，而 `server.test.ts` 只 mock 了命名空间上的 `realpathSync`。
  - 本 PR 与 #16583 改动同一段代码，后合入的一方负责把改动搬过去。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

在准备 #16583 时发现（#16246 / #16487 设计中 PR A 的一部分）。

</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): enable external workspace execution
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Builds the external Workspace execution slice on top of the materialization prerequisite in #15654. The branch now includes live `hosted-workspace-external-files/1` admission, bounded and single-query Workspace discovery, authoritative registration checks, stable lifecycle refusal classification, and receipt-backed release for external Runtime bindings. The separate materialization operation still creates metadata only; it does not allocate storage or start a worker.

This revision closes the remaining review gaps in that execution slice: registration decode failures, including field-type failures, now resolve to a permanent `409 workspace_unavailable`; a malformed registration disables only its own Workspace during batch discovery; saved-provider shutdown is classified as retryable `503`; attachment actor lookup fails closed on zero, multiple, or null rows; and external lifecycle authorization preserves the exact permanent fence response.

## Why it's needed

#15512 needs a durable link from registered external storage to a Workspace that can be discovered and used safely. A Session must not become executable through a partially wired path, and one corrupt storage row must not hide every healthy Workspace on the page. The same branch also needs terminal close and recovery paths to distinguish permanent identity failures from provider availability failures.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On an isolated fresh catalog, register external storage using the loopback operator credential, materialize its alias with an owner, and verify that only the owner can discover it. Exercise Session creation after the external-files gates and a Harness lifecycle capability are available. Confirm that prompts can run, file tools remain within the external profile, and close/recovery uses the receipt-backed ownership transition without destroying a shared placement.

For the query and failure paths, corrupt one registration and confirm only that Workspace loses Session-creation eligibility while another Workspace remains visible. Confirm that an admission attempt against the corrupted Workspace returns `409 workspace_unavailable` with `retryable=false`. Shut down the saved external provider during drain-capability checks and confirm a retryable `503`. Submit a non-current lifecycle authority to the external attachment path and confirm `409 workspace_lifecycle_claim_fenced` with `retryable=false`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before this revision, a field-type error while decoding an opaque-persisted registration could escape as a mapper failure, batch discovery could fail as a whole when one row was malformed, and a shut-down saved provider was conflated with a permanent binding conflict. The candidate maps these cases explicitly, uses one registration batch read rather than per-row JDBC work inside a mapper, and keeps external lifecycle fences non-retryable.

Earlier evidence in this stack covered materialization, registration replay, and isolated MySQL validation. The newest commit was checked statically and through the repository's CI gates; no local test, build, or typecheck was run under the requested execution policy.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :---: |
| macOS | ✅ static review and `git diff --check`; no heavy local execution |
| Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| Linux | ✅ repository CI for the branch; the new head is checked again after push |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the authenticated operator delegates the Workspace owner. That field is a grant target, not authenticated user identity. Existing operator and tenant checks remain required.
- Batch discovery now fails closed per malformed storage row instead of failing the whole Workspace page. A failed SQL read remains a retryable provider-unavailable verdict.
- `workspace_lifecycle_claim_fenced` remains permanent. Do not reinterpret a stale or non-current authority as a transient outage.
- Full external Hosted shell/capture, attachment widening beyond the current profile, and the Resident shared-worker behavior remain outside this PR. #16023 carries the Resident and EPHEMERAL layers.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the preceding stack extends the shared V1 catalog under the repository's pre-release fresh-catalog policy. No V2 migration is introduced here.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Part of #15512. Related prerequisite: #15654. The Resident shared-worker increment is stacked in #16023 and must not merge before this PR.

prs.title: test(acp-bridge): pin a granted conditional close actually tearing the session down
prs.body:
## Summary

Issue #14389 Item 1 records that the conditional close added in #14276 has no coverage for the outcome it exists to serve. All five sites that assert on `closeIfUnheld` either exercise a refusal or check the option bag against a stub that closes unconditionally, so a granted close silently failing to tear anything down would stay green.

This adds one bridge test that pins that path:

- spawns a Session on a child that negotiated active work and answers `sessionClose` for `onlyIfUnheld` with `{closed: true, holds: []}`;
- calls `closeSession(id, undefined, {closeIfUnheld: true, reason: 'scheduled_task_deleted'})`;
- asserts `sessionCount === 0`, that exactly one `closeIfUnheld` probe was sent, and that the emitted `session_closed` event carries `reason: 'scheduled_task_deleted'`.

The reason is pinned as a **literal**, not read back from the caller's `closeOpts`. The nested `closeSessionImpl` re-emits `closeOpts.reason ?? 'client_close'`, so a read-back would let both sides move together and keep the test green if the hand-off were dropped.

No production code changes.

## Verification

- `cd packages/acp-bridge && npx vitest run src/bridge.test.ts` — 1061 passed.
- Mutation-checked: replacing `reason: opts.closeReason` with `reason: 'client_close'` in `closeIfConlyUnheld` makes the new test fail with `expected 'client_close' to be 'scheduled_task_deleted'`. Reverted before commit.
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/acp-bridge/tsconfig.json` — clean.
- `npx prettier --check packages/acp-bridge/src/bridge.test.ts` — clean.

Not run: full `npm run build`, `npm run lint` across the repo, and the full test suite.

## Scope note

Issue #14389 Items 2–6 are untouched. Note that Item 3's premise has shifted since it was filed: `closeIfChildUnheld`'s `context`/`closeOpts` parameters are now forwarded by an internal caller (`session-control-plane.ts`, the `closeIfUnheld === true` branch of `closeSessionImpl`), so they are no longer unexercised and removing them would not be behaviour-preserving.

Fixes #14389

prs.title: feat(ci): support HTTP proxy in ephemeral runner containers
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds optional HTTP proxy configuration to the ephemeral runner manager. When configured, the manager passes `HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY`/`NO_PROXY` as environment variables to `docker create`, so git, curl, npm, and other tools inside the container use the proxy for external access.

## Why it's needed

Fork PR CI on the ephemeral pool fails at checkout: git clone times out connecting to github.com:443. The host requires an HTTP proxy for external access, but containers don't inherit it — git specifically needs explicit proxy configuration. Verified on #16356 where all checkout steps failed with connection timeout.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Run the new unit tests: `node --test scripts/ci/ephemeral-runner/manager.test.mjs` — 27/27 pass, including the new proxy tests
2. On hz4, add proxy config to `/etc/qwen-ephemeral-runner/config.json`:
   ```json
   "proxy": {
     "http": "http://172.27.32.29:7890",
     "https": "http://172.27.32.29:7890",
     "noProxy": "localhost,127.0.0.1,100.100.100.200"
   }
   ```
3. Restart the manager: `systemctl restart qwen-ephemeral-runner`
4. Trigger a fork PR CI run and confirm checkout succeeds

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — infrastructure configuration change, no UI.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   N/A  |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested (unit tests + hz4 deployment) |

### Environment (optional)

hz4 ephemeral runner pool, systemd service `qwen-ephemeral-runner.service`

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Proxy is optional; without config, behavior is unchanged (backward compatible)
- Not validated / out of scope: End-to-end fork PR acceptance requires merge + real event
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. Existing deployments without proxy config continue to work

## Linked Issues

Relates to #16514 (external PR isolation)

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

为一次性 runner 管理器添加可选的 HTTP 代理配置。配置后，管理器会将 `HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY`/`NO_PROXY` 作为环境变量传给 `docker create`，使容器内的 git、curl、npm 等工具通过代理访问外部网络。

问题背景：fork PR 的 CI 在一次性池上 checkout 失败，git clone 连接 github.com:443 超时。宿主机需要代理才能访问外网，但容器不会继承——git 需要显式配置代理。已在 #16356 验证，所有 checkout 步骤都因连接超时失败。

验证方式：运行新的单元测试 `node --test scripts/ci/ephemeral-runner/manager.test.mjs`（27/27 通过，包含新增的代理测试）；在 hz4 上配置代理后重启服务，触发 fork PR CI 验证 checkout 成功。

</details>

prs.title: feat(serve): add the daemon PR watch store foundation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the foundation for the daemon-owned PR state watch described in the merged design: a per-PR watch store with validated state, fail-closed read classification, atomic temp-and-rename writes, uid ownership gates, private directory/file modes, crash-temp sweeping, and an owner record that follows the channel pidfile identity rules at a caller-chosen path. It also exports the channel pidfile identity helpers needed for that reuse. The store is not wired into the refresh timer, observation, drain, admission, restore, or settings yet, so runtime behavior is unchanged.

## Why it's needed

The daemon PR-state design needs one authoritative baseline, queue, and delivered record per PR, owned by one daemon even when several daemons share a global qwen dir. Later increments (observation, transition detection, drain, and self-push suppression) all depend on this storage layer being safe before any timer uses it. Landing it separately keeps the critical path small and avoids overlapping the in-flight restore extraction in #16583.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run from `packages/cli`:

```bash
npx vitest run src/serve/server/pr-watch-store.test.ts src/commands/channel/pidfile.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false
```

Expected: the new store suite and the existing channel pidfile suite pass. The pidfile suite is the parity guard for the export-only change. Reviewers should also confirm the store takes no locks itself (callers hold the PR lock), absent/invalid reads initialize silently while other read errors fail closed, writes refuse non-regular or foreign-uid targets, owner claims keep unverifiable records and log them, and release only deletes the expected record.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — internal foundation, no user-visible behavior yet.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local Linux checkout at `88e5094800` plus this commit. POSIX-only uid/permission/FIFO/symlink tests skip on Windows.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: this introduces ownership and filesystem safety code that later timer increments will rely on. The owner-record rules intentionally mirror the channel pidfile: unverifiable records block rather than being swept, and a same-uid special file at the owner path must not hang the refresh thread.
- Not validated / out of scope: no timer wiring, GitHub observation, transition detection, drain, self-push ledger read, settings acceptance, or multi-daemon E2E. `packages/cli` typecheck has pre-existing unrelated errors from stale `packages/core/dist`; the changed files have no type errors.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The channel pidfile change is export-only plus a structural parameter widening; existing behavior is covered by the unchanged pidfile suite.

Design documents: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-04-daemon-pr-state-transitions.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/docs/design/2026-11-04-daemon-pr-state-transitions.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

为已合入设计中的 daemon 自有 PR 状态监视添加地基：按 PR 存储的 watch store，包含状态校验、fail-closed 的读取分类、temp+rename 原子写、uid 所有权门禁、私有目录/文件权限、崩溃临时文件清扫，以及沿用 channel pidfile 身份规则但路径由调用方指定的 owner record。同时导出 channel pidfile 的身份判定 helper 以供复用。该 store 尚未接入刷新定时器、观测、drain、准入、restore 或设置，因此运行时行为不变。

## 为什么需要

daemon PR 状态设计需要每个 PR 只有一个权威基线、队列和已投递记录，并且即使多个 daemon 共享同一个 global qwen dir，也只由一个 daemon 拥有。后续增量（观测、转换检测、drain、自推抑制）都依赖这个存储层先安全落地。单独提交可以保持关键路径小，并避免与在途的 #16583 restore 抽取重叠。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

在 `packages/cli` 下运行：

```bash
npx vitest run src/serve/server/pr-watch-store.test.ts src/commands/channel/pidfile.test.ts --coverage.enabled=false
```

预期：新增 store 套件与既有 channel pidfile 套件全部通过。pidfile 套件是 export-only 改动的行为 parity 守卫。评审还应确认：store 自身不持锁（调用方持 PR 锁）；absent/invalid 读取静默初始化，其它读错 fail closed；写入拒绝非常规文件或 foreign-uid 目标；owner claim 保留无法核验的记录并逐次打日志；release 只删除预期记录。

- 主要风险或取舍：本 PR 引入后续定时器增量会依赖的所有权与文件系统安全代码。owner record 规则刻意与 channel pidfile 一致：无法核验的记录会阻塞而不是被清扫；同 uid 在 owner 路径放置特殊文件也不能挂起刷新线程。

prs.title: feat(cli): add semantic statusline colors and live footer preview
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Give built-in status-line items four consistent active-theme colors: project/Git, model/reasoning, context/tokens, and session metadata. Separators stay neutral, and disabling theme colors removes semantic coloring.

Keep the actual input and footer visible while `/statusline` is open, and preview every selection immediately through the saved status line's rendering path. Remove the separate in-dialog preview. The picker owns input while open, including mouse focus and paste; Enter saves once, and Esc discards the draft and restores the previous preset, command, or disabled configuration.

## Why it's needed

Using one accent color for every item makes unrelated information difficult to scan. The old in-dialog preview also hides the real input/footer and does not reflect the saved status line's available width or wrapping. In-place preview makes the result visible before saving without persisting intermediate changes, consistently in Ink and OpenTUI.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. In both Ink and OpenTUI, open `/statusline` with a saved preset. Confirm the picker is above the still-visible input and footer, there is no internal Preview section, and toggling items or Use theme colors updates the real footer immediately. Check all four categories; same-category items should match and separators should remain neutral.
2. Press Enter after a change. Expect one save confirmation and the same footer content, wrapping, and colors as the preview. Reopen, change options, and cancel with Esc; expect the original configuration without a settings write. If search is active, the first Esc clears it and the next cancels. Repeat cancellation from custom-command and disabled status-line configurations, preserving custom ANSI colors and an explicit hide-context setting.
3. Resize to 80×24 and 40×20, select enough items to wrap, and navigate to the final item. Expect a usable compact picker, visible input/footer, and the existing two-row status-line limit without overlap. Switching between Qwen Dark and Qwen Light should repaint the category colors without restarting; NoColor should leave the preset footer uncolored.
4. While configuring, click the visible inactive input, type, and bracketed-paste text. The picker alone should receive typing, the input must remain unchanged, and no prompt should submit. After cancellation, ordinary typing and paste should work again.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Interactive tmux testing reproduced the issue with the global 0.26.5 CLI and verified the local bundle in both renderers. Nonessential picker rows are omitted in these layout excerpts.

Before: the picker contains its own preview, and the real input/footer disappears.

```text
Configure Status Line
...
Preview
➜ workspace · statusline-model · v0.26.5
```

After: there is no internal preview; the real input and footer remain beneath the picker. This excerpt is from the final OpenTUI mouse/paste verification, where the input remained empty.

```text
Configure Status Line
...
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
>   Type your message or @path/to/file
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ➜ workspace · statusline-model · Context 100% left · 0 total in · v0.26.5 · 1.0k window
  ⏸ Ask permissions (shift + tab to cycle)
```

ANSI captures confirmed that the previous uniform Qwen Dark accent `(203,166,247)` becomes project `(166,227,161)`, model `(203,166,247)`, context `(137,180,250)`, and session `(249,226,175)`. Theme switching, save/cancel, command/null restoration, narrow wrapping, and input ownership passed. An independent test engineer's E2E report is posted separately on this PR.

Local regression checks passed: full build and typecheck, reviewed CLI build and bundle, 1,236 unique affected unit tests with one existing skip, all 11 native status-line scenarios, native input focus checks at widths 40/80 with eight normal submissions, and two interactive integration tests per renderer. Changed-file lint/formatting, diff checks, and bilingual design-link validation also passed.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

macOS terminal/tmux; the global 0.26.5 CLI for baseline reproduction, and the locally built bundle under Node for Ink and Bun for strict OpenTUI. Tests used isolated workspace/home/runtime settings, no sandbox and no model requests; user-global settings were not modified.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: keeping the composer mounted requires strict picker input ownership and a bounded height budget. Keyboard, mouse, paste, resize, and save/cancel paths were verified in both renderers, with additional native OpenTUI regression coverage.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows/Linux were not tested locally. Preserve current main's real status-line placement below the input and its two-row limit; this is not a global footer redesign. Unrelated OpenTUI NoColor UI chrome is outside this change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no new persisted settings, dependency changes, or migration. Custom-command output semantics are unchanged after cancellation.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/dragon/issue-8363-statusline-preview/docs/design/statusline-preset-live-preview.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/dragon/issue-8363-statusline-preview/docs/design/statusline-preset-live-preview.zh-CN.md). Both versions are complete and synchronized, including decisions, constraints, acceptance criteria, and scope.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #8363

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次变更

为内置状态栏项提供四组一致的当前主题色：项目/Git、模型/推理、上下文/token，以及会话元数据。分隔符保持中性色，关闭主题色后移除语义着色。

打开 `/statusline` 时保留真实输入框和页脚，每次选择都立即通过已保存状态栏的渲染路径预览。移除对话框内部的独立预览。配置期间由选择器独占输入，包括鼠标聚焦和粘贴；Enter 只保存一次，Esc 丢弃草稿并恢复之前的 preset、command 或禁用配置。

## 为什么需要

所有项使用同一种强调色，让不同信息难以快速区分。旧的框内预览还会隐藏真实输入框/页脚，不能反映保存后状态栏的可用宽度或换行方式。原位预览让用户在保存前看到结果，不持久化中间变更，并保持 Ink 与 OpenTUI 行为一致。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 在 Ink 和 OpenTUI 中，从已保存的 preset 打开 `/statusline`。确认选择器位于仍然可见的输入框和页脚上方，没有内部 Preview 区域，切换条目或 Use theme colors 会立即更新真实页脚。检查四类信息：同类颜色应一致，分隔符应保持中性色。
2. 修改后按 Enter，应仅出现一次保存提示，保存后的页脚内容、换行和颜色与预览一致。重新打开、修改选项并按 Esc 取消，应恢复原配置而不写入设置。有搜索内容时，第一次 Esc 清空搜索，第二次取消。再从自定义 command 和禁用状态栏配置重复取消测试，确认恢复自定义 ANSI 色并保留显式隐藏上下文指示器的设置。
3. 调整为 80×24 和 40×20，选中足够多的条目使其换行，并导航至最后一个条目。紧凑选择器应可用，输入框/页脚保持可见，状态栏遵循现有两行上限且不重叠。切换 Qwen Dark 与 Qwen Light 应无需重启就刷新分类颜色；NoColor 下 preset 页脚应无颜色。
4. 配置期间点击可见但不活跃的输入框，键入并进行 bracketed paste。只有选择器应接收键入，输入框内容不变且不提交 prompt。取消后普通键入和粘贴应恢复正常。

### 证据（修改前后）

交互式 tmux 测试使用全局 0.26.5 CLI 复现问题，并在两种渲染器中验证本地 bundle。以下布局摘录省略了无关选择器行。

修改前：选择器包含自己的预览，真实输入框/页脚消失。

```text
Configure Status Line
...
Preview
➜ workspace · statusline-model · v0.26.5
```

修改后：没有内部预览，真实输入框和页脚保留在选择器下方。该摘录来自最终 OpenTUI 鼠标/粘贴验证，输入框始终为空。

```text
Configure Status Line
...
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
>   Type your message or @path/to/file
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ➜ workspace · statusline-model · Context 100% left · 0 total in · v0.26.5 · 1.0k window
  ⏸ Ask permissions (shift + tab to cycle)
```

ANSI 捕获确认：原先统一的 Qwen Dark 强调色 `(203,166,247)` 变为项目 `(166,227,161)`、模型 `(203,166,247)`、上下文 `(137,180,250)`、会话 `(249,226,175)`。主题切换、保存/取消、command/null 恢复、窄屏换行和输入归属检查全部通过。独立测试工程师的 E2E 报告将作为单独评论附在本 PR。

本地回归检查通过：完整 build 和 typecheck、审查后的 CLI build 和 bundle、1,236 个去重后的受影响单元测试（另有一个已有 skip）、全部 11 个原生状态栏场景、40/80 列原生输入聚焦检查及八次正常提交，以及每种渲染器各两个交互集成测试。变更文件 lint/格式、diff 检查和双语设计链接验证也通过。

### 已测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS 终端/tmux；用全局 0.26.5 CLI 复现基线，用本地构建的 bundle 在 Node 下验证 Ink、在 Bun 下验证严格 OpenTUI。测试隔离 workspace/home/runtime 设置，不使用 sandbox、不发送模型请求，也未修改用户全局设置。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：保留 composer 挂载要求选择器严格独占输入，并为其限制高度。两种渲染器的键盘、鼠标、粘贴、缩放及保存/取消路径均已验证，另补充了原生 OpenTUI 回归覆盖。
- 未验证或范围外：Windows/Linux 未在本地测试。保留当前 main 中真实状态栏位于输入框下方的位置及两行上限，不进行全局页脚重设计。无关的 OpenTUI NoColor UI chrome 不在本次范围内。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无；不新增持久化设置、不修改依赖、不需要迁移。取消后自定义 command 的输出语义保持不变。

prs.title: feat: add hybrid code mode
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Codex-aligned `tools.mode` enum with `direct`, `code_mode`, and `code_mode_only`. `code_mode` keeps ordinary tools directly callable while also exposing the isolated `exec` JavaScript tool; each visible ordinary tool carries its nested JavaScript declaration, while `exec` retains compact `ALL_TOOLS` metadata. `code_mode_only` preserves the strict exec-only ordinary-tool surface, and `direct` remains the default.

Updates filtered subagent tool surfaces so direct declarations and nested exec bindings honor the same allowlists, exposes the enum in Settings as Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only, regenerates the settings JSON schema, and removes the former `tools.codeModeOnly` boolean setting entirely.

Adds synchronized [English](docs/design/code-mode.md) and [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md) design documents, and brings the existing CodeModeOnly design up to the repository's bilingual documentation standard ([English](docs/design/code-mode-only.md), [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)).

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code previously offered only the default direct tool surface or the strict CodeModeOnly surface. Models could not combine direct calls for simple operations with `exec` orchestration for multi-tool workflows. A three-value enum matches Codex's `ToolMode` naming and gives users one explicit setting for all supported exposure modes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Leave `tools.mode` unset or set it to `direct`, restart Qwen Code, and confirm ordinary tools remain available while `exec` is absent.
2. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode`, restart, and confirm both ordinary tools and `exec` are available. Confirm ordinary tool descriptions include their `tools.<name>(args)` declaration and deferred tools remain discoverable through `tool_search`.
3. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode_only`, restart, and confirm ordinary tools are available through `exec` rather than as top-level calls, while direct control tools remain available.
4. Open Settings and confirm Tool Mode cycles among Default, Code Mode, and Code Mode Only. Confirm `tools.codeModeOnly` is no longer present in the settings schema.
5. Start with `--safe-mode` or `--bare` while either code mode is configured and confirm the effective mode is `direct`.

Automated verification completed: focused Core tests (121 tests), focused CLI tests (585 tests), a repeated settings-schema regression run (60 tests), full build, full typecheck, full lint, and both installed and branch-built CLI version smoke checks.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: Settings exposed `Code Mode Only (Experimental)` as a boolean with `false` / `true`.

After: Settings exposes `Tool Mode (Experimental)` as an enum displaying Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only. Updated TUI snapshots cover the default display.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node.js v24.18.0; local source build and package-level Vitest suites.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Hybrid mode adds a short nested-call declaration to each ordinary tool description, increasing prompt size slightly; complete schemas are not duplicated in the `exec` description.
- Not validated / out of scope: Live-provider interactive runs and Windows/Linux local execution were not tested; CI covers supported platforms.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: `tools.codeModeOnly` is removed. Replace `{ "tools": { "codeModeOnly": true } }` with `{ "tools": { "mode": "code_mode_only" } }`.

## Linked Issues

Related to #10377.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增与 Codex 对齐的 `tools.mode` 枚举，支持 `direct`、`code_mode` 和 `code_mode_only`。`code_mode` 在保留普通工具直接调用能力的同时提供隔离的 `exec` JavaScript 工具；每个可见普通工具会携带自己的嵌套 JavaScript 声明，而 `exec` 保留精简的 `ALL_TOOLS` 元数据。`code_mode_only` 保持严格的普通工具仅经 `exec` 调用模式，`direct` 仍为默认值。

更新经过过滤的子智能体工具面，使直接声明和 `exec` 嵌套 binding 遵守同一组 allowlist；在设置界面中将该枚举显示为 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only；重新生成 settings JSON schema；并彻底移除原来的 `tools.codeModeOnly` 布尔设置。

新增同步的[英文](docs/design/code-mode.md)和[中文](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md)设计文档，并将现有 CodeModeOnly 设计补齐为仓库要求的双语文档（[英文](docs/design/code-mode-only.md)、[中文](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)）。

## 为什么需要

Qwen Code 此前只提供默认的直接工具面或严格的 CodeModeOnly 工具面。模型无法在简单操作中使用直接调用，同时在多工具工作流中使用 `exec` 编排。三值枚举与 Codex 的 `ToolMode` 命名一致，并为所有支持的暴露模式提供一个明确的统一设置项。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 不设置 `tools.mode` 或将其设为 `direct`，重启 Qwen Code，确认普通工具仍可用且不存在 `exec`。
2. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode` 并重启，确认普通工具和 `exec` 同时可用；确认普通工具描述包含各自的 `tools.<name>(args)` 声明，延迟工具仍可通过 `tool_search` 发现。
3. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode_only` 并重启，确认普通工具通过 `exec` 而不是顶层调用使用，同时直接控制工具仍然可用。
4. 打开设置界面，确认 Tool Mode 可在 Default、Code Mode 和 Code Mode Only 之间切换，并确认 settings schema 中不再存在 `tools.codeModeOnly`。
5. 配置任一 code mode 后用 `--safe-mode` 或 `--bare` 启动，确认有效模式为 `direct`。

已完成自动化验证：Core 相关测试（121 个）、CLI 相关测试（585 个）、再次运行的 settings schema 回归测试（60 个）、完整 build、完整 typecheck、完整 lint，以及已安装版本和分支构建版本的 CLI 版本 smoke 检查。

### 前后对比证据

之前：设置界面以 `false` / `true` 布尔值展示 `Code Mode Only (Experimental)`。

之后：设置界面以枚举展示 `Tool Mode (Experimental)`，可选 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only。更新后的 TUI snapshot 覆盖默认显示。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

macOS、Node.js v24.18.0；本地源码构建和 package 级 Vitest 测试套件。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：混合模式会在每个普通工具描述中增加一段简短的嵌套调用声明，使 prompt 略微增大；完整 schema 不会在 `exec` 描述中重复。
- 未验证 / 范围外：未进行真实 provider 的交互式运行，也未在 Windows/Linux 本地执行；支持平台由 CI 覆盖。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：`tools.codeModeOnly` 已移除。请将 `{ "tools": { "codeModeOnly": true } }` 替换为 `{ "tools": { "mode": "code_mode_only" } }`。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #10377。

</details>

prs.title: test(managed-agent): make the preflight tests pin what they claim
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This follow-up to #16364 settles the review notes that #16364 deferred and that need no change to what `--check` reports. It makes several preflight tests pin the behavior their names and comments claim, declares SnakeYAML as a dependency of the server module, removes two pieces of dead code, and corrects the design record and the deployment pages where they disagree with Spring or with the check.

Tests:

- `ServiceAccountTest`: a new case covers the group execute bit for entering a directory. It uses the group the file system gives the directory, not a hard-coded `root`, and it shows that an account of root's group is still kept out by a `---------` directory. That assertion used to sit in the root case, where JUnit's `0700` temporary directory stopped the walk before it reached the locked directory, so a regression in the group bits passed unnoticed. The cases that need another account to reach the temporary directory now skip where it cannot, as under macOS's `0700` per-user temporary directory, using the assumption `ServerEnvironmentTest` already had, now shared. On a root host without a `nobody` account, the owner-bits case drops only its owner assertions instead of erroring. On Linux, a new case reads a file through a chain of 40 links and is refused one of 41, as the kernel is; nothing tested `ServiceAccount`'s own link bound before.
- `ServerEnvironmentTest`: the class is disabled on Windows, as its sibling is. The test that runs the real `--check` entry point now asserts exit status 1 and that `database` is its only FAIL row, leaving out `server-port`, whose port another process could take after the test frees it; before, it never read the exit status. A symbolic link to itself now finishes with no file and no hidden directory; without the link bound, that test times out. On Linux, a chain of 41 links to a directory this process cannot enter names no directory, because the kernel follows 40 links and no more; through 40 links, the directory is named. The test first asserts the kernel's own answer for both lengths. Moving the bound, or the constant it reads, either way fails that test. A replaced `spring.config.location` is shown to drop the classpath defaults unless it names `classpath:/` again.

Code:

- `org.yaml:snakeyaml` is declared in `server/pom.xml`, with its version managed by Spring Boot. `ServerEnvironment` uses it directly, and the module's AGENTS.md asks for directly used libraries to be declared.
- The three-argument `configFileCheck` overload is gone. No production code called it, and it hard-coded "not a configuration file" for any file with a property. Its three test callers now pass the formats explicitly.
- `ServiceAccount.allows` loses its `superuser()` guard and becomes private. `can()` already returns for root before it calls `allows`, so the guard was reachable only from a test.

Docs:

- The design record now lists Spring's precedence in Spring's order: `SPRING_APPLICATION_JSON`, then system properties, then the rest of the environment.
- It now says that `spring.config.location` replaces the classpath location too. Unless the location names `classpath:/`, `QWEN_MANAGED_AGENT_SERVER_ADDRESS` then sets nothing, and the packaged loopback `server.address` and the Flyway locations are gone; without an address, the default `auth.mode=auto` refuses to start.
- Its `config` row names the WARN for a secret file that group or others can read.
- The deployment guide and the systemd README name that WARN too.
- The guide's preflight section points systemd deployments at the sandboxed invocation in `systemd/README.md`. That section and the README list every directory the sandbox hides, `/run/user` and `/var/tmp` included.

## Why it's needed

The review rounds on #16364 deferred these notes under the convergence posture. Each one is either a test that passes whatever the code does, a rule of the module the code breaks, or a sentence that tells the operator something false. The design record had the precedence of system properties and environment variables reversed. It also claimed the classpath mapping survives `spring.config.location`. An operator who sets that variable loses the loopback default for `server.address`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

From `packages/managed-agent-server`:

```bash
mvn -B -pl verification -am test -Dtest='ServerEnvironmentTest,ManagedAgentPreflightTest,ResolvedConfigurationTest,ExternalRuntimeConfigurationTest,HarnessConfigurationTest,ServiceAccountTest' -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false
mvn -B -pl server,verification checkstyle:check
```

Each new or tightened test fails when the regression it names is seeded:

| Seeded change | Test that fails |
| --- | --- |
| The group arm grants access whatever the bits | `appliesTheGroupBitsToEnteringADirectory` |
| The group arm reads `GROUP_READ` for entry | `appliesTheGroupBitsToEnteringADirectory` |
| `canEnter` skips the directory's own mode | `appliesTheGroupBitsToEnteringADirectory` |
| `barrier()` follows links without a bound | `stopsAtASymbolicLinkToItself` (times out) |
| `barrier()` follows 50 links, or 39 | `followsNoMoreSymbolicLinksThanTheKernel` |
| `MAX_SYMBOLIC_LINKS` is 41, or 32 | `followsNoMoreSymbolicLinksThanTheKernel` in both classes |
| `ServiceAccount.can()` follows 140 links, or 39 | `ServiceAccountTest.followsNoMoreSymbolicLinksThanTheKernel` |
| `run` returns 0 whatever the rows | `readsTheFilesAtTheDefaultLocationsOfTheDirectoryItRunsIn` |
| A file found both as a property source and at a default location is listed under both spellings | `readsTheFilesAtTheDefaultLocationsOfTheDirectoryItRunsIn` (already, before this PR) |

The last row answers the round-9 note that the dedupe of one file reached through two locations was untested. The child-JVM test already pins it. Removing the four `normalize()` calls between Spring's resources and the rows (in the looked-up map, the read map, the location files and the property sources) does not change the rows either. Naming the file a second time in that test would have stopped it showing that the default location alone finds `config/application.yml`, which is what #16057 fixed. So that test keeps naming no file.

The seeded changes above the last row were run as uid 1000 against the six preflight test classes, and the last row against that test alone; each failed as listed. Some changes also fail other tests; the table names the tests this PR adds or tightens.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A: tests, a POM declaration, dead-code removal and documentation; `--check` reports the same rows.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux x86_64: the six preflight test classes, as root (160 tests, 4 skipped that need a non-root account) and as uid 1000 (160, none skipped), and checkstyle. macOS: not run; the cases that need another account to reach the temporary directory skip there. Windows: `ServerEnvironmentTest` and `ServiceAccountTest` are disabled there.

### Environment (optional)

JDK 21, Maven offline.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none at runtime. The SnakeYAML declaration resolves to the same 2.4 that `spring-boot-starter-web` already brought in.
- Not validated / out of scope: with `server.address` unset, as after a `spring.config.location` that drops the classpath defaults, the `server-port` and `auth` rows still take the address as loopback while the server listens on every address. That changes a verdict, so it goes with the follow-up below. The deferred notes that change what `--check` reports go to a separate follow-up, because each changes a verdict: a root service account whose credentials path sits under a directory this process cannot search; a file the account can read but this process cannot; a config tree or wildcard parent this process cannot list; a hidden directory with no service account configured; a uid-0 account under another name. The two Windows-only and root-without-`nobody` paths were not run here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.
