prs.title: feat(web-shell): label rendered artifact cards Preview and strengthen the details UI-language prompt
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Follow-up to the merged AskUser "Ask for details" side task (#16458). It is an affordance and prompt-wording change, not a routing change. Rendered artifact cards (HTML, Markdown, images) relabel their single open action to **Preview** with an eye icon, replacing the generic "Open" label; the click handler is byte-identical to before and already lands on the rendered preview tab. Non-rendered artifacts keep "Open", and a missing or blocked artifact shows a disabled Preview exactly as Open was guarded. The label reuses the existing `turnOutputs.preview` i18n key (no new key). The details explanation prompt now carries a prominent, whole-page language requirement (every heading, body sentence, list item, and label) so the generated HTML follows the Web Shell UI language, while the question snapshot still leads the prompt (so first-prompt naming stays question-derived) and the controlled-language and scratch-path instructions are preserved.

## Why it's needed

In real use of #16458 two friction points surfaced: the HTML explanation was hard to discover as a rendered view (the card said "Open", which did not signal that the HTML opens rendered), and the generated HTML was not reliably in the reader's language — which defeats the purpose of a quick explanation of the pending question. Tracing the open path shows the click already renders the HTML in one action (the nested side-task pane uses the same handler, and there is no source-first gate below 1 MiB), so the first friction is discoverability, not step count; this PR fixes the labelling. The prompt strengthening makes the explanation match the UI language.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Raise a pending AskUser question in a side-task-capable Web Shell session and click "Ask for details". The child writes a self-contained HTML explanation and an HTML artifact card appears. Before: the card's action was a generic "Open". After: the card shows a "Preview" action (eye icon) that opens the rendered HTML preview directly; a non-HTML artifact (e.g. a CSV) still shows "Open", and a missing HTML artifact shows a disabled Preview. For localization, inspect the details prompt sent to the child: it now states an explicit whole-page requirement (English for the en UI, 简体中文 for the zh-CN UI) covering headings, body, list items, and labels. The question snapshot still leads the prompt and the naming/controlled-language/scratch-path instructions are unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The HTML artifact card before (generic "Open") and after (explicit "Preview" with an eye icon), rendered in real Chromium against a mock daemon (dark theme):

| Before | After |
| :----: | :---: |
| ![before: Open](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/ask-user-details/ask-details-preview/ask-details-card-Open-dark.png) | ![after: Preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/ask-user-details/ask-details-preview/ask-details-card-Preview-dark.png) |

Light theme:

| Before | After |
| :----: | :---: |
| ![before: Open (light)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/ask-user-details/ask-details-preview/ask-details-card-Open-light.png) | ![after: Preview (light)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/ask-user-details/ask-details-preview/ask-details-card-Preview-light.png) |

The before arm temporarily reverts only the rendering source to the base while keeping the same scenario; before/after are byte-different. Unit/component evidence (deterministic): the artifact-card suite asserts the Preview label and open request for an HTML artifact, Open kept for a non-rendered artifact, and Preview disabled for a missing one; the side-task suite asserts each prompt template carries the whole-page language requirement and still leads with the question. The existing artifact-panel suite confirms the HTML rendered-preview path is unchanged. The daemon HTTP is mocked (not a live end-to-end run); a live-model run is probabilistic for the output language, so the prompt directive is pinned by tests rather than gated on a model call.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local unit/component tests (vitest, jsdom) and web-shell `tsc --noEmit`; no real-model E2E for this affordance/text change.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the Preview action is a label/affordance change over the existing artifact-tab preview path (which already renders HTML directly); the click dispatch is unchanged, and it does not add a new renderer or change the sandbox/CSP or the large-document gate.
- Blast radius: the relabel keys off `isRenderedArtifact`, so every HTML, Markdown, and image artifact card in every session reads "Preview", not only the ask-details card. This is intentional for consistency; non-rendered (CSV, PPTX) and external-link artifacts keep "Open".
- Not validated / out of scope: a live click inside a real nested side-task pane (the routing conclusion is a static code trace plus a mock-daemon visuals capture); a live two-browser real-model run confirming the generated HTML language end to end (model-dependent); the language source remains the UI language (no daemon output-language coupling); no auto-open on generation.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Reuses the existing `turnOutputs.preview` label (no new i18n key); existing "Open"/"Download" behavior for non-rendered and external-link artifacts is unchanged.

Design document: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/webshell-ask-details-preview-i18n/docs/design/2026-11-07-ask-details-preview-and-ui-language.md) · [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/webshell-ask-details-preview-i18n/docs/design/2026-11-07-ask-details-preview-and-ui-language.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #16458 (merged).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

已合并的 AskUser「问细节」侧任务（#16458）的跟进。这是 affordance 与提示词措辞改动，不是路由改动。可渲染产物卡片（HTML、Markdown、图片）把其单一打开动作改标为 **Preview**（眼睛图标），替换泛称「Open」标签；点击处理与改动前逐字节一致，本就落到渲染预览 tab。非渲染产物保持「Open」，缺失或被阻塞的产物显示禁用的 Preview（与 Open 的守卫一致）。标签复用已有的 `turnOutputs.preview` i18n 键（不新增键）。细节解释提示词现在携带显著的整页语言要求（每个标题、正文句子、列表项、标签），使生成的 HTML 跟随 Web Shell UI 语言；问题快照仍在提示词开头（首提示命名保持问题派生），受控句式与暂存路径指令保留。

## 为什么需要

#16458 实际使用暴露两个摩擦点：HTML 解释不便被发现为渲染视图（卡片写「Open」，没有传达 HTML 会渲染打开）；生成的 HTML 不能可靠用读者的语言——这违背了快速解释待答问题的本意。追踪打开路径可见点击本就一步渲染 HTML（嵌套侧任务面板用同一 handler，1 MiB 以下无源码优先门槛），故第一个摩擦是可发现性而非步骤数；本 PR 修的是标签。提示词强化使解释匹配 UI 语言。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在支持侧任务的 Web Shell 会话里发起待答 AskUser 问题，点「问细节」。子会话写自包含 HTML 解释并出现 HTML 产物卡片。之前：卡片动作是泛称「Open」。之后：卡片显示「Preview」（眼睛图标）直接打开渲染 HTML 预览；非 HTML 产物（如 CSV）仍显示「Open」，缺失的 HTML 产物显示禁用 Preview。本地化方面，检查发给子会话的细节提示词：现在陈述显式整页要求（en UI 用 English，zh-CN UI 用简体中文），覆盖标题、正文、列表项、标签。问题快照仍开头，命名/受控句式/暂存路径指令不变。

### 证据（前后对比）

HTML 产物卡片改动前（泛称「Open」）与改动后（显式「Preview」＋眼睛图标），真实 Chromium 渲染、daemon HTTP 为 mock（暗色）：

| 改动前 | 改动后 |
| :----: | :---: |
| ![改动前：Open](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/ask-user-details/ask-details-preview/ask-details-card-Open-dark.png) | ![改动后：Preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wenshao/qwen-code/assets/ask-user-details/ask-details-preview/ask-details-card-Preview-dark.png) |

亮色版见上方英文正文配图。before 臂仅临时回退渲染源到基线、保留同一场景；前后逐字节不同。单测/组件证据（确定性）：产物卡片套件断言 HTML 产物的 Preview 标签与打开请求、非渲染产物保持 Open、缺失产物 Preview 禁用；侧任务套件断言每个提示词模板携带整页语言要求且仍以问题开头。现有产物面板套件确认 HTML 渲染预览路径不变。非 live 端到端（daemon 为 mock）；真实模型运行的输出语言是概率性的，故提示词指令由测试钉住，而非以模型调用为门禁。

### 测试平台

Linux ✅（vitest/jsdom 单测与组件测试、web-shell tsc --noEmit）；macOS/Windows 未测。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：Preview 是现有 artifact-tab 预览路径（本就直接渲染 HTML）上的标签/affordance 改动；点击派发不变，不新增渲染器，不改沙箱/CSP 或大文档门槛。
- 影响范围：relabel 基于 `isRenderedArtifact`，故每个会话的 HTML、Markdown、图片产物卡片都显示「Preview」，不止问细节卡片；这是为一致性有意为之，非渲染（CSV、PPTX）与外链产物保持「Open」。
- 未验证/超范围：真实嵌套侧任务面板里的 live 点击（路由结论是静态代码追踪＋mock-daemon visuals 截图）；真实双浏览器＋真实模型端到端确认生成 HTML 语言（模型相关）；语言来源仍 UI 语言（不耦合 daemon output-language）；不在生成时自动打开。
- 破坏性变更/迁移：无。复用已有 `turnOutputs.preview` 标签（不新增 i18n 键）；非渲染与外链产物的现有 Open/Download 行为不变。

设计文档：英文与中文版见上方链接。

## 关联

#16458（已合并）的跟进。

</details>

prs.body:
Fixes #14465

## What changed

Every disable path matched `mcp.excluded` with `matchesAnyServerPattern`, but every enable path removed the entry with an exact `!==` / `includes` comparison. A pattern such as `foo-*` never equals the server name, so it stayed in the list and remained in the runtime union — the dialog then reported `Enabled '<name>'` while the server was still excluded.

The enable side now filters through the same matcher, in all six places that lift an exclusion:

- `serve/routes/workspace-mcp-config.ts`
- `acp-integration/acpAgent.ts` (settings + live configs)
- `ui/opentui/dialog-data.ts`
- `ui/components/mcp/MCPManagementDialog.tsx`
- `ui/components/extensions/views/McpServerActionsView.tsx`
- `ui/components/extensions/tabs/InstalledTab.tsx`

The serve route additionally returned 409 for a glob sitting in the **target** scope — the one this call writes. That scope is owned by the caller, so its patterns are now lifted together with the exact name; only a pattern in a higher-priority scope still blocks, and that is what the 409 reports.

## Verification

Run from `packages/cli`:

- `npx vitest run src/ui/opentui/dialog-data.test.ts` — 75 passed, including a new case where `srv*` sits in both the user-scope and runtime lists.
- `npx vitest run src/serve/workspace-qualified-rest.test.ts` — 68 passed. Adds "lifts a wildcard exclusion from the scope being enabled"; retargets "rejects enabling an MCP server blocked by a wildcard" to a system-scope pattern via `QWEN_CODE_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH`, since a same-scope glob is no longer a refusal.
- `npx vitest run src/ui/components/mcp/MCPManagementDialog.test.tsx src/ui/components/extensions/tabs/InstalledTab.test.tsx` — passed.
- `npx eslint` on all eight touched files — clean.

Not run: the full `npm run build` / repo-wide typecheck. A package `tsc --noEmit` in this worktree reports ~32 errors that all pre-date this change (stale prebuilt `dist` from `main` vs. `ToolResult`/`LlmFinishedEventValue`, Node builtin typings such as `Module.enableCompileCache` and `process.execve`); none are in the files touched here.

The launch-flag half of the report ("success reported while the server stays disconnected") is not addressed: `--disable-mcp-server` is a boot-time union, so it needs a different signal than settings, and the triage note defers it until #14083 lands.

prs.title: fix(channels): journal GitHub mentions added by editing an older comment
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When someone edits an older comment on a GitHub issue or pull request to add the bot's `@mention`, GitHub notifies the bot, but the GitHub channel reads only comments created after its poll cursor. Until now that notification was marked read with nothing to show for it. The bot still does not answer such an edit — the person should post a new comment — but the channel now records it: it journals an `inbound` / `skipped` event with the reason `edited_comment`, which the Web Shell's **Channel events** page lists next to the other skip reasons.

A comment gets that row when it was created at or before the cursor, was updated after it, mentions the bot, is not the bot's own, and is not one the channel has already taken. The row is written once per notification window, so a held window that re-reads the thread does not repeat it. Dispatch, the cursor, the dedupe state and mark-read are unchanged: the change only adds journal rows.

Docs: the GitHub channel guide's Mention Detection section says that an edit does not reach the bot, what the events page shows, and how an edited issue or PR body behaves (answered only on first contact). The Channels overview, the serve protocol reference and the channel events timeline design ([English](docs/design/2026-11-02-channel-events-timeline.md), [Chinese](docs/design/2026-11-02-channel-events-timeline.zh-CN.md)) list the new reason.

## Why it's needed

Finding B11 of the GitHub channel real-scenario E2E (fake GitHub REST, scripted model, real daemon): editing a comment to add `@qwen-bot` produced one `listComments` call and one `PUT /notifications`, no answer and no journal row, so an operator could not tell why a mention went unanswered.

Answering such edits was considered and rejected. The sender allowlist checks a comment's author, while a collaborator with write access can edit someone else's comment. A comment the bot answered long ago can also lose its dedupe key (the ring keeps 500 entries), so a later edit would be answered a second time. The default `claude-code-action` workflows likewise listen only for `issue_comment` `created`, not `edited`. Recording the edit keeps the bot's behaviour unchanged and makes the outcome visible.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- `cd packages/channels/github && npx vitest run src/GithubAdapter.test.ts -t 'editing an older comment|added by an edit'` runs the 18 new tests:
  - positive cases: an edit inside the window; a comment created exactly at the cursor; an edit at and after the notification time; a mixed-case author; a mixed-case mention; several comments in one thread past the ones it skips, including one without a user or a `node_id`; the aggregate lane; once per held window, including a second comment edited mid-window;
  - negative cases: no mention; no body; edited at or before the cursor, including with an older metadata floor; no `updated_at`; the bot's own comment; no `created_at`; created inside the window (answered, no row); created between the cursor and the thread's `last_read_at`; already taken by the channel.
- The whole package: `npx vitest run` in `packages/channels/github` passes 707/707. `tsc --noEmit`, `eslint --max-warnings 0` and `prettier --check` are clean.
- Hand-written mutants of the new function were run against these tests in five review rounds: each bound flipped or removed, an upper bound added, each guard removed, `continue` → `return`, a constant or per-thread journal key, `metaFloor` or `lastReadAt` used as a bound, a case-sensitive mention test, a non-empty body fallback, and the actor not lower-cased. Most survivors are equivalent, for example the bot-name null guard (the name is always set after `connect()`) and a different journal-key prefix (these keys never meet the comment lane's). The last round found two non-equivalent survivors, left as known test gaps: checking the once-per-window key before the dedupe record (it differs only when a key leaves the ring mid-window), and using the thread's `last_read_at` instead of the cursor as the lower bound for the edit time.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Real stack on Linux aarch64: the harness's B phase run against a `main` build (5487f0f4e8) and a build of this branch. B11 has `alice` edit a comment that did not mention the bot to add `@qwen-bot`.

| | `main` | this PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GitHub requests after the edit | `GET …/issues/2/comments`, `PUT /notifications` | same |
| Bot reply | none | none |
| Journal rows for the comment | `inbound/skipped/mention_required` (from B8) | `inbound/skipped/mention_required`, `inbound/skipped/edited_comment` |

The new row: `{"type":"inbound","outcome":"skipped","reason":"edited_comment","triggerKind":"comment","repository":"acme/widgets","thread":"issue:2","number":2,"actor":"alice","messageId":"IC_YzEwMzk="}`. The other 12 B-phase scenarios (mention, first contact, review request, assignment, aggregation, sender and repository gates, `reasonFilter`, `ci_activity`, self-loop guard) gave the same result on both builds.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests on Linux x86_64. Real-stack run with `npm run build && npm run bundle` and the harness's `qwen serve` daemon on Linux aarch64, against a fake GitHub REST API and a scripted OpenAI-compatible model (no real GitHub, no paid model).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: more journal rows, bounded to one per comment per window. A comment the channel already took (answered it, or read it in a batch of followed-thread comments) gets no row while its key is in the dedupe record: adding a mention to it by an edit is neither answered nor recorded. A row can also name a comment where no one has just added a mention:
  - a comment the bot answered before, edited again after its dedupe key left the 500-entry ring (the guide says so);
  - a comment that keeps being edited and contains the bot's handle, such as another bot's status comment, gets a row in each window that re-reads its thread;
  - an edit stamped after the notification can be recorded once more in a later window, because the edit time has no upper bound on purpose (with one, an edit made just after the notification would leave no row).

  `actor` is the comment's author, not the editor: GitHub's REST answer does not name the editor (the protocol doc says so). A sender outside the allowlist also gets a row, as a new comment does on the per-comment lane.
- Not validated / out of scope:
  - An issue or PR body edited after first contact is still not answered and leaves no row (documented); detecting it would need the body's edit time, which the REST answer does not give.
  - Inline PR review comments are not read at all (pre-existing).
  - A notification that reaches the channel after its cursor has passed the edit leaves no row, as a late notification for a new comment already can.
  - In the first window after start-up the cursor carries milliseconds while GitHub's timestamps do not, so an edit made in the same second just before the channel started can get a row; the comment lanes compare `created_at` the same way.
  - That GitHub notifies a mention added by an edit comes from GitHub users' reports, not GitHub's documentation; the harness's fake GitHub models it that way.
  - macOS and Windows were not run; the change is a pure timestamp and string check.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `reason` is a free string, and the Web Shell shows it as is.

## Linked Issues

None filed. This is finding B11 from the GitHub channel real-scenario E2E; findings fixed earlier are in #16333, #16334, #16416 and #16565.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

有人编辑 GitHub issue 或 PR 里的一条旧评论、补上 bot 的 `@mention` 时，GitHub 会通知 bot，但 GitHub channel 只读取建于轮询游标之后的评论。过去这条通知会被标为已读，什么痕迹都不留。本 PR 仍然不回复这种编辑（应当发一条新评论），但 channel 现在会把它记下来：写一条 `inbound` / `skipped` 事件，原因为 `edited_comment`，Web Shell 的 **Channel events** 页会把它和其他跳过原因列在一起。

满足以下条件的评论会记这一行：建于游标或之前、在游标之后被更新过、提到了 bot、不是 bot 自己写的、channel 还没有接手过。每个通知窗口只记一次，窗口被保持期间重读线程也不会重复。派发、游标、去重状态和标记已读都不变，改动只是新增事件行。

文档：GitHub channel 指南的 Mention Detection 一节说明编辑不会触达 bot、事件页显示什么，以及编辑过的 issue/PR 正文如何处理（只在首次接触时回复）。Channels 总览、serve 协议参考和 channel 事件时间线设计文档（[英文](docs/design/2026-11-02-channel-events-timeline.md)、[中文](docs/design/2026-11-02-channel-events-timeline.zh-CN.md)）都列出了新原因。

## 为什么需要

来自 GitHub channel 真实场景 E2E（假 GitHub REST、脚本化模型、真实 daemon）的 B11 发现：编辑评论补上 `@qwen-bot` 后，只有一次 `listComments` 和一次 `PUT /notifications`，没有回复、也没有事件行，运维方无从知道这次 mention 为什么没人回。

回复这类编辑的方案考虑过但没有采用。sender allowlist 检查的是评论作者，而有写权限的协作者可以编辑别人的评论。很早以前回复过的评论，去重键也可能已被挤出（环只保留 500 条），之后的编辑就会被再回复一次。`claude-code-action` 的默认工作流也只监听 `issue_comment` 的 `created`，不监听 `edited`。把编辑记下来，既不改变 bot 的行为，又让结果可见。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- `cd packages/channels/github && npx vitest run src/GithubAdapter.test.ts -t 'editing an older comment|added by an edit'` 运行 18 个新测试：
  - 正向：窗口内的编辑；恰好建于游标的评论；在通知时间及之后的编辑；大小写不同的作者；大小写不同的提及；同一线程里多条评论、越过被跳过的那几条，其中包括没有 user 或 `node_id` 的评论；聚合通道；窗口被保持时每个窗口只记一次，包括窗口中途又被编辑的第二条评论；
  - 反向：没有提及；没有正文；在游标或之前编辑，包括元数据下限更早的情况；没有 `updated_at`；bot 自己的评论；没有 `created_at`；建于窗口内（被回复，不记行）；建于游标与线程 `last_read_at` 之间；channel 已接手。
- 整个包：在 `packages/channels/github` 运行 `npx vitest run`，707/707 通过；`tsc --noEmit`、`eslint --max-warnings 0`、`prettier --check` 均通过。
- 在五轮评审中对新函数手写变异并用这些测试检验：各个边界翻转或删除、加上上界、各个守卫删除、`continue` 改 `return`、常量或按线程的 journal key、用 `metaFloor` 或 `lastReadAt` 作边界、大小写敏感的提及判断、非空的正文兜底值、actor 不转小写。存活的变异大多是等价的，例如 bot 名的空值守卫（`connect()` 之后这个名字总是已设置），以及换一个 journal key 前缀（这些 key 与逐条评论通道的 key 不会相遇）。最后一轮发现两个非等价的存活变异，作为已知的测试缺口保留：先查每窗口一次的 key、再查去重记录（只在窗口中途 key 被挤出环时才有差别），以及用线程的 `last_read_at` 代替游标作为编辑时间的下界。

### 证据（前后对比）

Linux aarch64 真实栈：分别用 `main`（5487f0f4e8）和本分支的构建跑套件的 B 组。B11 中 `alice` 编辑一条原本没提到 bot 的评论，补上 `@qwen-bot`。

| | `main` | 本 PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 编辑后的 GitHub 请求 | `GET …/issues/2/comments`、`PUT /notifications` | 相同 |
| bot 回复 | 无 | 无 |
| 该评论的事件行 | `inbound/skipped/mention_required`（来自 B8） | `inbound/skipped/mention_required`、`inbound/skipped/edited_comment` |

新增的一行：`{"type":"inbound","outcome":"skipped","reason":"edited_comment","triggerKind":"comment","repository":"acme/widgets","thread":"issue:2","number":2,"actor":"alice","messageId":"IC_YzEwMzk="}`。B 组其余 12 个场景（mention、首次接触、review 请求、指派、聚合、sender 与仓库门禁、`reasonFilter`、`ci_activity`、自回环守卫）两边结果一致。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

单元测试在 Linux x86_64。真实栈在 Linux aarch64 上用 `npm run build && npm run bundle`，以及套件里的 `qwen serve` daemon，连接假 GitHub REST API 和脚本化的 OpenAI 兼容模型（不连真实 GitHub，不调用付费模型）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：事件行会变多，上限是每条评论每个窗口一行。channel 已经接手过的评论（回复过，或在跟帖批次里读过），只要其 key 还在去重记录里就不会记行：编辑时给它补上 mention，既不会被回复，也不会被记录。这一行也可能指向并没有人刚刚补上 mention 的评论：
  - bot 以前回复过、去重键被挤出 500 条环之后又被编辑的评论（指南已说明）；
  - 持续被编辑且包含 bot 句柄的评论，例如别的 bot 的状态评论，每个重读该线程的窗口都会记一行；
  - 编辑时间晚于通知时间时，之后的窗口可能再记一次，因为编辑时间刻意不设上限（设了上限，紧接通知之后的编辑就不会留下任何记录）。

  `actor` 是评论作者，不是编辑者：GitHub REST 返回的数据不包含编辑者（协议文档已说明）。不在 allowlist 里的 sender 也会记一行，这和逐条评论通道上的新评论一致。
- 未验证或不在范围内：
  - 首次接触之后被编辑的 issue/PR 正文，仍然不会被回复，也不留记录（已写入文档）；要识别它需要正文的编辑时间，而 REST 不提供。
  - PR 的行内 review 评论本来就不会被读取（既有行为）。
  - 通知到达时游标已经越过这次编辑，就不会留下记录；新评论遇到通知迟到时本来也会这样。
  - 启动后的第一个窗口里，游标带毫秒而 GitHub 时间戳不带，所以在 channel 启动前同一秒内的编辑可能会记一行；评论通道比较 `created_at` 时也是同样方式。
  - "GitHub 会为编辑补上的 mention 发通知"来自 GitHub 用户的反馈，不是官方文档；套件里的假 GitHub 按此建模。
  - 没有在 macOS 和 Windows 上运行；改动只是时间戳和字符串判断。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无。`reason` 是自由字符串，Web Shell 原样显示。

## 关联 Issue

没有单独开 issue。这是 GitHub channel 真实场景 E2E 的 B11 发现；此前的发现已在 #16333、#16334、#16416 和 #16565 中修复。

</details>

prs.title: fix(config): declare model.chatCompression knobs and allow disabling image payload eviction
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes image-payload eviction switchable off, and declares the `model.chatCompression` settings that the runtime already reads.

The eviction threshold now accepts `0`, which means "never rewrite image payloads out of history". The eviction pass is skipped entirely in that case, so the stored history keeps every inline image and so does the outgoing request on an image-capable route. A route whose model declares no image support is still slimmed to `[image: ...]` placeholders before the request is sent.

Declaring these knobs as `integer` also makes them settable through `/config`: `integer` was missing from `SETTABLE_TYPES`, so `/config` now lists 272 rows instead of 248 — the six knobs here plus 18 pre-existing integer settings that were settable but invisible.

`model.chatCompression` was declared in the settings schema as a bare object with no properties, so `imagePayloadThreshold`, `imageTokenEstimate`, `maxRecentFilesToRetain`, `maxRecentImagesToRetain`, `enableScreenshotTrigger` and `screenshotTriggerThreshold` were invisible to settings help, validation and the IDE schema. They are now declared with the defaults and bounds the runtime resolvers already enforce, and the generated IDE JSON schema is regenerated from them. The settings reference documents the eviction threshold and the image token estimate, which were previously undocumented.

## Why it's needed

Fixes #15495. A vision workflow that needs every frame in history had no supported way to stop eviction: the threshold accepted only integers >= 1, and setting a very large number was an undocumented workaround. Undeclared settings also meant the knobs never surfaced in help or validation.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `npm -w packages/core run build`
2. `npx vitest run packages/core/src/services/compactionInputSlimming.test.ts packages/core/src/core/llm-chat.test.ts` — 761 tests pass, including two new ones: the resolver accepts `0`, and a session with three inline images keeps all three in both the durable history and the later request when the threshold is `0`.
3. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/config/` — 2167 tests pass, including a new assertion that every `model.chatCompression` knob is declared with its runtime bound.
4. `npx prettier --check` and `eslint --max-warnings 0` on the touched files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non-UI change (config + schema + docs), so N/A. The new `llm-chat` test fails when the `imagePayloadThreshold > 0` guard is removed, which is the regression this pins.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local `npm run build` for `packages/core` plus vitest unit runs; no sandbox or live model endpoint involved.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: `0` is a new accepted value for a knob whose previous minimum was `1`. A user who set `0` before got the default `20` silently; they now get eviction disabled. That reading matches every other "count of items to keep" knob in the same settings block, where `0` means "none", so the behavior is consistent rather than surprising.
- Not validated / out of scope: the request-only rewrite (not mutating stored history at all, rewriting only the outgoing copy) is the third part of #15495 and needs its own design discussion; it is untouched here. The full `npm run build` and the repo-wide suite were not run. `npm -w packages/cli run typecheck` reports 24 errors, in files this PR does not touch and which reproduce identically on `origin/main` at `6fb74164`.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The new schema properties are additive, and the runtime validation was already the source of truth.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15495

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

让图片载荷驱逐（image payload eviction）可以关闭，并把运行时早已读取的 `model.chatCompression` 设置正式声明出来。

驱逐阈值现在接受 `0`，表示"永不把图片载荷从历史里改写掉"。为 `0` 时整个驱逐流程被跳过，因此存储的历史和发出去的请求都保留全部内联图片。

`model.chatCompression` 之前只声明为一个没有 properties 的空对象，导致 `imagePayloadThreshold`、`imageTokenEstimate`、`maxRecentFilesToRetain`、`maxRecentImagesToRetain`、`enableScreenshotTrigger`、`screenshotTriggerThreshold` 在设置帮助、校验和 IDE schema 里都不可见。现在按运行时解析函数已有的默认值和边界声明它们，并据此重新生成 IDE 的 JSON schema。设置参考文档补上了此前没写的驱逐阈值和图片 token 估算。

## 为什么需要

修复 #15495。需要历史里保留每一帧的视觉工作流，此前没有任何受支持的办法阻止驱逐：阈值只接受 >= 1 的整数，设一个很大的数只是没有文档的变通做法。未声明的设置也意味着这些开关从不出现在帮助或校验里。

## 审阅者验证步骤

1. `npm -w packages/core run build`
2. `npx vitest run packages/core/src/services/compactionInputSlimming.test.ts packages/core/src/core/llm-chat.test.ts` —— 761 个测试通过，其中两个是新增的：解析函数接受 `0`；阈值为 `0` 时，含三张内联图片的会话在持久历史和后续请求里都保留这三张。
3. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/config/` —— 2167 个测试通过，其中新增一条断言：`model.chatCompression` 的每个开关都按运行时边界声明。
4. 对改动文件跑 `npx prettier --check` 和 `eslint --max-warnings 0`。

### 证据

纯配置 / schema / 文档改动，无 UI，N/A。新增的 `llm-chat` 测试在移除 `imagePayloadThreshold > 0` 守卫后会失败，这正是它固定的回归点。

### 测试平台

macOS 已测；Windows、Linux 未测。

### 环境

本地构建 `packages/core` 加 vitest 单测；不涉及沙箱或真实模型端点。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：`0` 是这个开关新的可接受值，之前最小是 `1`。此前把 `0` 写进配置的用户会静默拿到默认值 `20`，现在会真的关闭驱逐。这与同一设置块里其他"保留多少个"的开关（`0` 表示不保留）的读法一致，因此是统一而非意外。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：#15495 的第三部分——不再改写存储历史、只改写发出的副本——需要单独的设计讨论，本 PR 未涉及。未跑完整 `npm run build` 和全仓测试。`npm -w packages/cli run typecheck` 报 24 个错误，都在本 PR 未触及的文件里，且在 `origin/main`（`6fb74164`）上完全一致地复现。
- 破坏性变更：无。新增的 schema 属性是追加式的，运行时校验本来就是唯一真相来源。

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): close managed host integration gaps left by the host mount entry
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Closes the gaps left by the managed host mount entry after #15928 merged. The entry no longer demands a Java backend address when the host injects its own provider, and with neither input it shows the unavailable notice instead of quietly addressing an undefined backend path. Returning to an unconfirmed request's conversation now travels the same path as every other navigation, so it keeps the owning workspace selection and stops carrying the previous conversation's error into the newly opened one; an unconfirmed create still returns to the new-conversation page. The archived-history status callback tolerates an inline host callback instead of re-rendering without bound. Host navigation slots that live outside the shell now render with the product's scoped styles, theme and language rather than as bare unstyled text.

The managed empty state centers only its content, so the conversation header stays at the top and stays reachable when the content grows taller than the pane, and the state no longer applies while history is loading or a first message is in flight. A failed empty conversation shows its banner without a stacked welcome header. In host mode, keyboard focus after a discard or a closed task panel lands inside the conversation instead of falling back to the document body, and the pane is measured once the host supplies a conversation. Disposing one embedded shell twice no longer strips the stylesheet a sibling shell still uses. Finally, the host build mode runs as part of the package build and writes outside the directory the app build empties, so it can neither rot unnoticed nor delete a bundle a host is already serving.

## Why it's needed

These are all reachable defects on the merged head, not speculative hardening. The published mount example only compiled inside test files, and a JavaScript host that omitted the provider sent every request to an undefined path. A host following the documented inline-callback pattern could exhaust the heap. The cross-conversation redirect dropped the workspace selection and misattributed a failure to the conversation the user had just opened. The empty-state rule clipped its own content and snapped between layouts mid-load. Two mounts in one shadow root could leave one of them completely unstyled. Each item was reproduced against the merged code before being fixed, and each new assertion was confirmed to fail without its fix.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Mount the managed shell with an injected provider and no backend address: the documented call now type-checks, and omitting both the provider and the address shows the unavailable notice with no network request. Point a navigation slot at an element outside the shell container and switch theme and language: the list keeps product styling and follows both. Pass an inline archived-status callback and confirm the host render count stays bounded.

For the conversation behaviors: send a message in a workspace-bound conversation, let the response be lost, switch to another conversation and use "Open the original conversation" — the owner keeps its workspace even if the catalog no longer lists it, the other conversation's draft survives, and no stale error follows the jump. Open a failed empty conversation and expect one banner and no welcome header. In host mode, discard an unconfirmed request on a read-only conversation and confirm focus stays inside the conversation; mount without a conversation, then supply one on a wide host and open the task panel inline rather than as a blocking dialog. Mount two shells in one shadow root, dispose the first twice, and confirm the second stays styled.

Local results: the five affected suites pass (210 tests), ESLint reports no problems on the changed files, the changed runtime files produce no TypeScript diagnostics, and the host build mode succeeds and emits its bundle under the new output directory. A whole-package typecheck still fails on unrelated pre-existing errors caused by the shared workspace's stale SDK build output; the same errors reproduce on the untouched base.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Not captured in this pass. Every behavioral claim above is pinned by a regression that was observed failing on the pre-fix code and passing after it, including the host-slot styling, the pending-owner workspace, the focus fallback, the deferred pane measurement, the repeated style release, the empty-state timing, and the failure-banner/welcome pairing.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Vitest with jsdom for the component and host-mount suites, plus a local run of the host build mode. No daemon, Java service, or real browser was involved.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the empty-state and failure-notice changes live in the shared managed conversation page, so the existing Java-backed managed UI is affected too, not only the new host entry. The scoped-CSS wrappers apply only when a host supplies navigation slots; the in-app slots keep their current behavior. The style-release guard is in shared shadow-DOM infrastructure and only makes an already-invalid second disposal a no-op.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows and Linux locally; a real daemon, Java backend, or browser acceptance run; the host entry is still absent from the published exports and file list, which this PR does not change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the backend address becomes optional on the mount props, which widens what callers may pass and breaks no existing caller. Hosts that previously built the host bundle must read it from the new output directory. Adding the mode to the package build lengthens that build by one bundling pass.

Design documents: [English](docs/design/2026-10-29-managed-host-webshell.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-29-managed-host-webshell.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #15928.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

收尾 #15928 合并后遗留的托管宿主接入缺口。宿主注入自己的 provider 时，入口不再强制要求 Java 后端地址；两者都缺省时显示不可用提示，而不是悄悄访问一个 undefined 后端路径。返回未确认请求所属会话时，改走与其他导航一致的路径，因此保留归属工作区选择，也不会把上一个会话的错误带进刚打开的会话；未确认的新建仍回到新建会话页。归档历史状态回调可以接受宿主内联回调，不再无限重渲染。位于 shell 之外的宿主导航插槽现在带有产品的 scoped 样式、主题和语言，不再是无样式的裸文本。

托管空态只居中内容本身，会话头部因此留在顶部，且内容高于容器时仍可到达；历史加载中或首条消息发送中不再套用该状态。失败的空会话只显示一条横幅，不再叠加欢迎头。host 模式下，丢弃请求或关闭任务面板后的键盘焦点落在会话内部，而不是退回 document body；宿主传入会话后容器会被重新测量。同一个 shadow root 中重复销毁一个内嵌 shell，不会再摘掉兄弟 shell 仍在使用的样式表。最后，宿主构建模式已接入包的 build，并输出到应用构建会清空的目录之外，因此既不会无人发现地腐坏，也不会删掉宿主正在使用的产物。

## 为什么需要

这些都是合并版本上可复现的缺陷，不是推测性加固。文档里的挂载示例此前只有在测试文件中才能编译；JavaScript 宿主漏传 provider 时，所有请求都打到 undefined 路径。按文档写内联回调的宿主可能耗尽堆内存。跨会话跳转会丢掉工作区选择，并把失败错误归到用户刚打开的会话上。空态规则会裁掉自己的内容，并在加载过程中来回切换布局。同一 shadow root 里的两个挂载可能让其中一个完全失去样式。每一项都在修复前对着合并代码复现过，每条新增断言也都确认过去掉修复即失败。

## 评审验证方案

### 如何验证

用注入的 provider、不传后端地址挂载托管 shell：文档中的调用现在可以通过类型检查；provider 与地址都不传时显示不可用提示且不发网络请求。把导航插槽指向 shell 容器之外的元素并切换主题与语言：列表保持产品样式并跟随两者变化。传入内联归档状态回调，确认宿主渲染次数有界。

会话行为方面：在绑定了工作区的会话里发消息并让响应丢失，切到另一个会话后点「返回原对话」——即使目录已不再列出归属会话，它仍保留自己的工作区，另一会话的草稿不受影响，也不会有过期错误跟随跳转。打开一个失败的空会话，应只有一条横幅、没有欢迎头。host 模式下，在只读会话上丢弃未确认请求，确认焦点仍在会话内部；先不给会话挂载，再在宽宿主上传入会话，任务面板应内联打开而不是弹出阻塞式对话框。在同一 shadow root 挂载两个 shell，重复销毁第一个，确认第二个仍有样式。

本地结果：受影响的 5 个套件通过（210 个用例），改动文件 ESLint 无问题，改动的运行时文件无 TypeScript 诊断，宿主构建模式成功并在新输出目录产出 bundle。整包 typecheck 仍因共享工作区里 SDK 构建产物过旧导致的既有报错而失败；同样的报错在未改动的基线上也能复现。

### 前后对比

本轮未采集截图。上面每条行为结论都由回归用例固定，且都观察到「修复前失败、修复后通过」，包括宿主插槽样式、未决请求归属工作区、焦点兜底、延后的容器测量、重复释放样式、空态时机，以及失败横幅与欢迎头的配对。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

组件与宿主挂载套件使用 Vitest + jsdom，另外本地跑了一次宿主构建模式。未涉及真实 daemon、Java 服务或浏览器。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：空态与失败提示的改动位于共享的托管会话页，因此现有 Java 托管 UI 同样受影响，不只是新宿主入口。scoped CSS 包装只在宿主提供导航插槽时生效，应用内插槽保持现有行为。样式释放的守卫位于共享 shadow DOM 基础设施，只是让本就非法的第二次销毁变成空操作。
- 未验证/范围外：本地未验证 Windows 与 Linux；未做真实 daemon、Java 后端或浏览器验收；宿主入口仍未接入发布的 exports 与 files，本 PR 不改变这一点。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：挂载 props 上的后端地址变为可选，只是放宽了调用方可传的范围，不破坏现有调用方。此前自行构建宿主 bundle 的宿主需要改从新的输出目录读取。把该模式接入包 build 会让该构建多一次打包过程。

设计文档：[English](docs/design/2026-10-29-managed-host-webshell.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-29-managed-host-webshell.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

#15928 的后续修复。

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): scope sidebarless polling to active conversations
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A sidebarless Web Shell polls only the trusted workspaces that own its connected session or mounted split panes. With neither, the welcome view starts no live-state poll or session-activity catalog fetch. A pane that closes stops keeping its workspace subscribed.

## Why it's needed

The original sidebarless view polled every trusted workspace, including when no conversation was open. Restricting it to the connected session alone would leave a split pane in a second workspace with stale turn state. The poller now covers the conversations that the host actually displays.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Open a sidebarless embed against a daemon advertising live-state support and three trusted workspaces A, B and C. On the welcome screen, expect no workspace live-state or session-activity catalog requests. Connect to A, then open a split pane from B. B should show the cancel control when an external turn starts and return to the send control when it ends. Close B and confirm that subsequent polls target A alone.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Scenario | Prior PR head `c8b10f0` | Updated head `2adfb4e3` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Welcome | 0 live-state requests, 1 qualified catalog request | 0 of either |
| Connected to A | Only A, send → cancel → send | Same |
| Split across A and B | Only A, B's control stayed stale across both transitions | A and B, B's control followed both transitions |
| After closing B | Only A | Only A |

The original upstream baseline polled every trusted workspace. The follow-up A/B used Chromium and a recording local mock daemon with a 1-second poll interval. The updated branch passed 1,522 tests covering App, split view and session catalog, along with Web Shell build and typecheck, ESLint and Prettier.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment

Node.js 22, Chromium, and a local mock daemon with three trusted workspaces.

## Risk & Scope

Only resolved, trusted, absolute workspace paths are eligible. An ambiguously owned Live session contributes no poll target. Workspaces that own a mounted split pane remain covered independently of the connected session. No migration is required.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #16355

AI assistance: OpenAI Codex investigated, implemented, and verified the change.

<summary>中文说明</summary>

用 Chromium 和本地记录请求的模拟 daemon 对比了 `c8b10f0` 和 `2adfb4e3`。欢迎页的目录请求从 1 次降为 0 次，两边都没有 live-state 请求。单会话仍只轮询 A。分屏时只轮询 A 和 B，B 的取消按钮在外部回合开始和结束时均正确切换。关闭 B 后继续轮询 A。Web Shell 构建、类型检查和 1,522 项相关测试通过。

prs.title: fix(web-shell): keep the first prompt running when switching sessions during creation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A first prompt submitted from a new chat now survives the user switching to another session while the session is being created. The created session is kept without binding the connection, the composer's model/mode/reasoning choices are applied through the created session's own client, and the prompt is dispatched admission-only: the daemon accepts it and runs the turn in the background while the user stays on the session they clicked. Nothing is written to the visible transcript, the prompt status, or the connection of the session the user navigated to. The draft text is consumed on successful dispatch (through the composer's existing navigation-safe commit path) and preserved on failure, with an error toast instead of a silent drop. The inline shell command, goal creation, and agent-mention flows that share lazy session creation are adapted the same way. Creations that are not attached to a submitted prompt keep the previous abort-on-navigation behavior.

## Why it's needed

Web Shell creates the daemon session only when the first prompt is submitted. If the user submitted a prompt and quickly clicked another session, the navigation guard detached the freshly created client and aborted preparation: the session still appeared in the sidebar (it had already been spawned on the daemon) but it sat idle forever, and the prompt was silently lost — the submitter's error path swallowed the abort because its owner no longer matched. Pressing send should deliver the prompt even when the user moves on, exactly like sending in an existing session and switching away, where the turn keeps running in the background.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open Web Shell on a daemon with at least one existing session, start a new chat, type a prompt and press send, then immediately click another session in the sidebar. Expected: the switch completes and stays; the new session appears in the sidebar and its turn runs — reopening it shows the prompt and the response. Before this change the new session existed but was empty and idle.
2. Deterministic regression: the new Playwright spec holds the create response, submits a prompt, clicks another session, waits for the switch to settle, then releases the create. It asserts exactly one prompt request reaches the created session and the URL stays on the clicked session. It was red before the fix (prompt request count stayed 0) and is green after.
3. Failure path: when the detached dispatch fails, the draft text remains in the new-chat composer and an error toast is shown; the session stays in the catalog so the user can inspect or resend.
4. Non-prompt creation (e.g. opening the commit dialog on a workspace without a session) still aborts on navigation — the existing navigation-guard tests stay green.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the deterministic E2E fails — after switching sessions mid-create, the prompt request count stays 0 while the created session remains on the daemon (reproduced 2026-11-08). After: the same spec passes; the prompt request reaches `/session/<created>/prompt` with the submitted text and the connection stays on the clicked session. Unit evidence: 441 tests in the actions/session-preparation suites, 529 in the provider suite, and the full App suite (results in the verification report comment). The classification predicate pin is mutation-witnessed: removing the detached-client predicate turns its test red; byte-exact restore returns it to green.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Vite dev server of this checkout against the Playwright mock daemon (deterministic HTTP timing); unit suites via vitest; `tsc --noEmit`, ESLint, Prettier, and the web-shell production build all pass on the rebased branch.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the detached dispatch is admission-only and writes no optimistic transcript block — opening the created session replays the admitted prompt from the daemon instead of showing a local echo. A residual narrow window remains: a click that lands after the create resolved and bound the connection but before the navigation publishes still goes through the attached path's identity checks (unchanged behavior); the reported race — clicking while the create is in flight — takes the new detached path.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS/Windows not tested locally; the resident daemon used for manual smokes runs a different build, so end-to-end verification used this checkout's dev server against the mock daemon. Concurrent duplicate submissions dedupe onto one creation and both prompts are admitted (daemon FIFO); the second dispatch self-heals its client identity if the first already detached.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The session-actions surface gains one admission-only dispatch method and two optional creation options; existing callers are unaffected.

Design document: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/web-shell-first-prompt-navigation/docs/design/web-shell-first-prompt-navigation.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/web-shell-first-prompt-navigation/docs/design/web-shell-first-prompt-navigation.zh-CN.md) (added by this PR; both versions complete and synchronized).

## Linked Issues

None — reported directly in conversation.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在新聊天里提交的首条 prompt，现在即使用户在会话创建期间切换到其他会话也能存活。创建出的会话被保留但不绑定连接，composer 的模型/模式/推理选择通过该会话自己的客户端应用，prompt 以"仅准入"方式派发：daemon 接受后在后台运行 turn，用户停留在点击的会话上。整个过程不写用户导航去的会话的可见 transcript、prompt 状态或连接。草稿文本在派发成功后被消费（走 composer 已有的导航安全提交路径），失败则保留并弹错误提示，不再静默丢弃。共享懒创建的内联 shell 命令、goal 创建、agent @-mention 流做了同样适配。不挂在已提交 prompt 上的创建保持原有的"导航即中止"行为。

## 为什么需要

Web Shell 在提交首条 prompt 时才创建 daemon 会话。如果用户提交后快速点击另一个会话，导航守卫会 detach 刚创建的客户端并中止准备：会话仍出现在侧边栏（daemon 已经 spawn 了它）但永远空转，prompt 被静默丢失——提交者的错误路径因 owner 不再匹配而吞掉了中止错误。点了发送就应该交付 prompt，哪怕用户随即离开；这与"在已有会话发送后切走、turn 继续后台运行"的语义一致。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 在至少有一个已有会话的 daemon 上打开 Web Shell，新建聊天、输入 prompt 点发送，然后立即点击侧边栏另一个会话。预期：切换完成并停留；新会话出现在侧边栏且 turn 在运行——重新打开它能看到 prompt 与回复。改动前新会话存在但空白空转。
2. 确定性回归：新增 Playwright spec 扣住创建响应、提交 prompt、点击另一个会话、等切换落定后放行创建；断言恰好一条 prompt 请求到达新建会话且 URL 停留在被点击会话。修复前红（prompt 请求数恒 0），修复后绿。
3. 失败路径：detached 派发失败时草稿文本保留在新建聊天输入框并弹错误 toast；会话留在 catalog 供查看或重发。
4. 非 prompt 创建（如在没有会话的工作区打开 commit 对话框）仍在导航时中止——既有导航守卫测试保持绿。

### 证据（前后对照）

Before：确定性 E2E 失败——创建中途切换会话后 prompt 请求数恒 0，而创建的会话留在 daemon 上（2026-11-08 复现）。After：同一 spec 通过；prompt 请求携带提交文本到达 `/session/<created>/prompt`，连接停留在被点击会话。单元证据：actions/session-preparation 套件 441 条、provider 套件 529 条、App 全套件（结果见验证报告评论）。分类谓词钉子经过变异见证：删掉 detached 客户端谓词其测试变红，字节级还原回绿。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境

本 checkout 的 Vite dev server + Playwright mock daemon（确定性 HTTP 时序）；vitest 单元套件；rebase 后的分支上 `tsc --noEmit`、ESLint、Prettier、web-shell 生产构建全部通过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：detached 派发仅准入、不写乐观 transcript 块——打开新建会话时从 daemon 回放已准入的 prompt，而不是本地回显。残余窄窗口仍在：点击落在"create 已返回并绑定连接之后、导航发布之前"时仍走 attached 路径的身份校验（行为不变）；被报告的竞态——create 在途时点击——走新的 detached 路径。
- 未验证/范围外：macOS/Windows 未本地测试；常驻 daemon 跑的是另一份构建，端到端验证用本 checkout 的 dev server + mock daemon。并发重复提交会 dedupe 到同一次创建，两条 prompt 都被准入（daemon FIFO）；第二条派发在第一条已 detach 时自愈客户端身份。
- 破坏性变更/迁移：无。会话 actions 面新增一个仅准入派发方法与两个可选创建选项；既有调用方不受影响。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/web-shell-first-prompt-navigation/docs/design/web-shell-first-prompt-navigation.md) / [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/web-shell-first-prompt-navigation/docs/design/web-shell-first-prompt-navigation.zh-CN.md)（本 PR 新增，两版完整同步）。

## 关联 Issue

无——会话中直接报告。

prs.title: feat(daemon): expose last user prompt time and session sorting
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds optional `lastUserPromptAt` consistently to session-list, batch catalog, standalone SDK summaries and loaded-session status. It records the latest genuine persisted human input on the effective main transcript branch, including attachments, voice and human mid-turn input; unavailable values remain absent.

Adds `sortBy: updatedAt | lastUserPromptAt` to workspace lists, batch catalog options, standalone lists and SDK calls, so integrations such as Data Agent can request global question-time ordering. The server sorts all eligible candidates before pagination, keeps organized pins first, places unknown times last and uses session ids for stable ties. Cursors are bound to the selected sort. The WebShell sidebar exposes Recent activity / Last question and remembers the preference per daemon host. Older daemons keep the existing UI; SDK opt-in checks `session_last_user_prompt_sort`.

Cold initialization reconstructs the time once. Successful persisted human inputs update owner-scoped daemon memory; assistant output and automatic activity do not rescan transcripts or advance question time. The scalar index survives catalog TTL and dense-index eviction, with whole-scope eviction bounded to 100,000 entries and 64 scopes.

## Why it's needed

Activity time cannot express when the user last asked a question because assistant output and background work also advance it. For example, A is asked at 10:00 and B at 10:05, then A continues output at 10:10. Recent activity should put A first; Last question should put B first. External integrations need the same server-side ordering across pages, not a reorder of one returned page.

The original size/mtime-keyed scalar cache rebuilt transcript indexes after assistant-only appends. Cold recovery plus writer-driven hot updates fixes that repeated scan cost. Retaining complete scope indexes also avoids the former 512-entry LRU causing repeated scans when sorting larger catalogs.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Create A and B as above. Switch the sidebar between Recent activity and Last question: workspace and Recent rows should switch A/B to B/A. Reload and verify the chosen preference returns. Pinning, grouping, archives and current session selection should still work.
- Request question-sorted list/catalog/standalone pages. Check complete cross-page descending order, session-id ties, unknown values last, and rejection of invalid sort values or cursors from a different sort. Older SDK/daemon combinations must explicitly reject unsupported question sorting.
- Compare list/catalog/status against genuine persisted human records. Human attachment/voice/mid-turn input advances the time; assistant/tool/system/cron/Goal/external-agent activity and inherited history do not. Failed persistence must not advance it.
- After cold initialization of more than 512 sessions, repeat reads, append assistant output, let catalog TTL expire, and persist another human question. Full index-build counts should remain unchanged while the human update changes order. Verify workspace/runtime/archive isolation and explicit rewind/owner recovery.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: activity ordering shows A above B even though B was asked later. After: the sidebar selector uses global server question ordering and shows B above A. Screenshots and the independent E2E report are in the validation comment below.

The original assistant-append reproduction counted full index builds of 1 cold → 1 unchanged → 2 after assistant output → 3 after more output. The same metadata case now stays 1 → 1 → 1 → 1. Final large-catalog and wire results are recorded separately below.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | Local build, typecheck, focused tests, real daemon and Chrome WebShell |
| 🪟 Windows | Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | Not tested locally |

### Environment

Isolated temporary HOME/runtime/workspaces, synthetic transcripts and a loopback fake model. No production history or deployment.

## Risk & Scope

- Cold global question sorting must read the eligible transcript time index, with two concurrent reads. Warm sorting reuses observed writer scalars; explicit scope eviction or owner/history recovery can require cold work again. Cold transcripts exceeding the canonical 256 MiB index limit omit the value without scanning.
- Unobserved external writes to warm unloaded sessions become visible after cold recovery, owner registration or eviction. Default metadata reads still inspect file identity; hot sorting intentionally uses daemon-observed writer state.
- Existing default ordering remains compatible. Question-sort cursors cannot be reused for activity sorting. Native CLI columns/JSON, ACP listing and memory-only live-state remain unchanged. No new endpoint, polling timer or per-card request.
- Designs: metadata [English](docs/design/session-last-user-prompt-time.md) / [简体中文](docs/design/session-last-user-prompt-time.zh-CN.md); sorting [English](docs/design/session-question-time-sort.md) / [简体中文](docs/design/session-question-time-sort.zh-CN.md). Both language versions are synchronized.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的内容

在 session list、批量 catalog、SDK standalone 摘要和已加载会话 status 一致提供可选 `lastUserPromptAt`。它表示有效主转录中最后一次真实持久化人工输入的时间，包含附件、语音和人工 mid-turn；未知时省略。

工作目录列表、批量 catalog 参数、standalone 列表及 SDK 新增 `sortBy: updatedAt | lastUserPromptAt`，供 Data Agent 等外部业务请求全局提问排序。服务端先排序完整候选集再分页，organized 保留置顶优先，未知值排最后，同时间按 session id 稳定排序；游标绑定排序口径。WebShell 左侧新增“最近活动 / 最后提问时间”选择，按 daemon host 保存偏好。旧 daemon 保持原界面；SDK 按需检查 `session_last_user_prompt_sort`。

冷初始化恢复一次时间索引。真实人工输入持久化成功后更新实际 owner 的 daemon 热内存；助手输出和自动活动不推进时间，也不重新扫描转录。标量索引独立于 catalog TTL 和稠密索引缓存，按完整作用域淘汰，最多保留 100,000 个条目和 64 个作用域。

## 为什么需要

活动时间也会被助手输出和后台任务推进，无法体现用户最后提问的时间。例如 A 10:00 提问、B 10:05 提问，A 10:10 继续输出：最近活动应 A 在前，最后提问应 B 在前。外部业务也需要跨页一致的服务端排序，只重排当前返回页不能满足需求。

最初按 size/mtime 缓存标量的实现会在助手追加后重建转录索引。改为冷恢复与 writer 驱动的热更新解决重复扫描。按完整作用域保留索引也避免旧 512 条 LRU 在大列表排序时反复扫描。

## 审阅者验收计划

### 如何验证

- 按上例建立 A/B，切换左侧排序，工作目录和“最近”列表应从 A/B 变为 B/A。刷新后恢复偏好；置顶、分组、归档和当前会话选择正常。
- 请求提问排序的 list/catalog/standalone 多页，验证跨页倒序、同时间 id 稳定顺序、未知排最后、非法排序及跨排序游标被拒绝。旧 SDK/daemon 组合必须明确拒绝不支持的提问排序。
- 对照实际人工记录验证 list/catalog/status 时间。人工附件、语音、mid-turn 推进；助手、工具、系统、cron/Goal、外部 agent 和继承历史不推进。持久化失败不更新。
- 冷初始化超过 512 个会话后重读、追加助手输出、等待 catalog TTL、再持久化人工问题：完整索引构建次数不增加，人工更新会改变排序。验证 workspace/runtime/archive 隔离和显式 rewind/owner 恢复。

### 前后证据

之前：按活动排序，A 在 B 上方，但 B 提问更晚。之后：左侧选择器使用服务端全局提问排序，B 在 A 上方。截图和独立 E2E 报告见下方验证评论。

原助手追加复现的完整索引构建次数为 1→1→2→3；同一元数据用例现为 1→1→1→1。最终大列表及真实接口验证结果单独记录在下方。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | 本地构建、类型检查、定向测试、真实 daemon 和 Chrome WebShell |
| 🪟 Windows | 本机未测 |
| 🐧 Linux | 本机未测 |

### 环境

隔离临时 HOME/runtime/workspace、合成转录与 loopback 假模型。未使用生产历史或执行部署。

## 风险与范围

- 冷全局排序需要读取候选时间索引，最多两个并发；热排序复用已观测 writer 标量。完整作用域淘汰或 owner/历史恢复可能重新进入冷路径。冷转录超过规范 256 MiB 索引上限时省略字段且不扫描。
- 未观测到的外部写入在冷恢复、owner 注册或淘汰后可见。默认元数据读取仍检查文件身份；热排序有意采用 daemon 已观测写入事实。
- 默认排序保持兼容；提问游标不能用于活动排序。native CLI 列/JSON、ACP listing 和 memory-only live-state 不变。不增加端点、轮询定时器或逐卡请求。
- 设计：元数据[英文](docs/design/session-last-user-prompt-time.md) / [中文](docs/design/session-last-user-prompt-time.zh-CN.md)；排序[英文](docs/design/session-question-time-sort.md) / [中文](docs/design/session-question-time-sort.zh-CN.md)。双语完整同步。

## 关联 Issue

无。

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): add workspace collapse controls and drag sorting
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a control beside Workspaces to collapse or expand all project workspaces, with the existing five-session preview on expansion. Workspace headers support drag sorting: session lists temporarily collapse during dragging and restore their previous expansion and Show all state afterward. The existing Move up/down menu remains available.

Workspace order is shared through authenticated daemon storage scoped to the primary workspace and survives restarts; expansion stays browser-local. Failed saves restore the previous order. Changing the primary workspace reloads its saved order, and removing a dragged workspace or losing the ability to sort restores the remaining rows. Older daemons retain browser-local ordering.

Design: [English](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/codex/web-shell-workspace-sidebar/docs/design/workspace-sidebar-controls.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/codex/web-shell-workspace-sidebar/docs/design/workspace-sidebar-controls.zh-CN.md). Both versions contain matching decisions, constraints and acceptance criteria.

## Why it's needed

Large workspace lists are difficult to scan when each workspace shows its recent sessions. Bulk expansion controls and direct manual ordering let users keep their preferred workspaces within reach. The intended goals are explicit workspace placement and consistent manual ordering across browsers connected to the same daemon. This addresses part of #16038; default-collapsed sessions and automatic recently-used ordering remain outside this PR.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Connect to a daemon with several project workspaces and more than five sessions per workspace. Collapse all, then expand all: headers remain available and each expanded workspace shows five sessions.
2. Expand Show all in one workspace and collapse another. Drag a lower workspace above or below a target: all workspace lists temporarily collapse, then the new order appears while the earlier mixed expansion and Show all state return. Escape, self-drop and outside drops preserve order and display state.
3. Reload or open a fresh browser context: the saved order is shared while expansion remains local. Restarting the daemon with the same primary workspace preserves order. Restarting at the same origin/token with a different primary loads that primary's saved order in the already-open page.
4. Attempt a save while storage fails: the UI reports the error and restores the previous order. An unsuccessful initial read prevents sorting rather than overwriting saved preferences.
5. Update the workspace list during dragging, including removing the source or reducing two rows to the source alone: temporary collapse clears without saving a new order. After primary/secondary roles change, the bulk control reflects the visible expansion state.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the validated source baseline provides menu-based movement with browser-local persistence, but no bulk expansion control or header drag sorting. After: the following current-code Chromium screenshots show the five-session preview, temporary drag collapse and restored mixed display after reordering. These three screenshots use the repository's **mock daemon**; they do not validate real Git backend operations.

| Expanded: five-session previews | During drag: compact workspace headers | After drop: order and previous display restored |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ![Expanded workspaces](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/024a7cebc9994f4505aec9983b89fb09170e7d1e/expanded.png) | ![Collapsed workspace headers during dragging](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/024a7cebc9994f4505aec9983b89fb09170e7d1e/dragging.png) | ![Reordered workspaces with restored display](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/024a7cebc9994f4505aec9983b89fb09170e7d1e/dropped.png) |

An independent **real bundled daemon** restart check changed the primary workspace at the same origin/token. The existing page issued another order read and matched the real API response and a fresh context. The screenshots below show the matching displayed order; persistence and restart were separately asserted through HTTP and browser checks. The real-daemon comparison was captured on `8ba85f4530`; the subsequent follow-up corrects a capability test baseline and caches expansion lookups. The three mock-daemon UI screenshots were recaptured after that follow-up. All screenshots were visually inspected and live on a separate asset branch, pinned to one commit; images are absent from the implementation branch.

| Existing page after primary change | Fresh browser context |
| --- | --- |
| ![Existing page displays the new primary's saved order](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/024a7cebc9994f4505aec9983b89fb09170e7d1e/primary-existing.png) | ![Fresh context displays the same saved order](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/024a7cebc9994f4505aec9983b89fb09170e7d1e/primary-fresh.png) |

Full repository build and typecheck passed. The final focused sidebar regression run passed 102 tests, the complete real-daemon HTTP route integration suite passed all 42 tests, and the Chromium mock-daemon suite passed all four tests. Daemon/API and SDK tests also passed before the final frontend-only fixes. Two final independent full code review rounds found no unresolved defects. A separate comment contains the detailed E2E report and coverage limits.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Chromium, real daemon HTTP/restart and component/unit checks |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Local Web Shell in Chromium with the repository mock daemon for session-rich UI scenarios; real bundled daemon with isolated temporary workspaces, configuration and runtime state for authentication, disk persistence, storage failures and restart checks. No model prompts or real Git mutations were used as test evidence.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: shared order uses last-committed-write wins; already-open tabs do not receive live synchronization. Saves within one sidebar are serialized, and failures roll back the display.
- Not validated / out of scope: touch dragging, Windows/Linux local execution, default-collapsed sessions, automatic recently-used ordering and real Git backend operations. Drag-source removal was verified by a component fallback because the browser fixture could not drive the required list replacement.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no new dependencies or automatic migration of browser order. Older daemons keep existing local persistence. Registration membership, runtime/startup order and trust are unchanged. Both design translations are complete and synchronized.

## Linked Issues

Refs #16038. This PR supplies manual controls; it does not close the remaining default-expansion and recently-used-ordering requests.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

在工作区标题旁增加批量展开/收起入口，展开时显示现有的五条会话预览。支持拖动工作区标题排序：拖动过程中临时收起会话列表，结束后恢复之前的展开状态和“显示全部”状态。保留已有的上移/下移菜单。

工作区排序通过经过身份验证的 daemon 存储共享，按主工作区隔离并在重启后保留；展开状态仍保存在浏览器本地。保存失败时恢复原顺序。更换主工作区时重新加载该主工作区保存的排序；拖动源被移除或排序变为不可用时，恢复剩余工作区的展示。旧 daemon 继续使用浏览器本地排序。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/codex/web-shell-workspace-sidebar/docs/design/workspace-sidebar-controls.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/codex/web-shell-workspace-sidebar/docs/design/workspace-sidebar-controls.zh-CN.md)。两个版本的设计决策、约束和验收标准保持一致。

## 为什么需要

每个工作区展示最近会话时，大量工作区难以浏览。批量展开控制和直接手动排序能让常用工作区更容易找到。本次目标是由用户明确安排工作区位置，并让连接同一 daemon 的不同浏览器共享手动排序。本 PR 部分回应 #16038；默认收起会话和按最近使用自动排序不在本次范围内。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

1. 连接包含多个项目工作区、每个工作区超过五条会话的 daemon。全部收起后再全部展开：标题始终可用，每个展开的工作区显示五条会话。
2. 在一个工作区选择“显示全部”，另一个工作区保持收起。拖动下方工作区到目标上方或下方：拖动时全部临时收起，放下后显示新顺序，并恢复原来的混合展开状态和“显示全部”。Escape、拖回自身或在列表外放下时，顺序和展示状态保持原样。
3. 刷新页面或打开全新浏览器上下文：排序共享，展开状态仍属于本地。相同主工作区重启 daemon 后保留排序。在同一 origin/token 更换主工作区重启时，已打开页面加载该主工作区保存的顺序。
4. 存储失败时尝试保存：界面报错并恢复原顺序。初次读取失败时禁止排序，避免覆盖已保存的偏好。
5. 拖动中更新工作区列表，包括移除源工作区，或将两项减少到仅剩源工作区：取消临时收起，且不保存新顺序。主次工作区角色互换后，批量入口与实际展开状态一致。

### 证据（修改前后）

修改前：已验证的源码基线提供菜单移动和浏览器本地持久化，但没有批量展开控制或标题拖动排序。修改后：以下当前代码的 Chromium 截图展示五条预览、拖动时临时收起和排序后恢复混合展示。这三张截图使用仓库的**模拟 daemon**，不验证真实 Git 后端操作。

| 展开：五条会话预览 | 拖动中：紧凑工作区标题 | 放下后：顺序改变并恢复原展示 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ![工作区展开预览](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/024a7cebc9994f4505aec9983b89fb09170e7d1e/expanded.png) | ![拖动时临时收起工作区标题](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/024a7cebc9994f4505aec9983b89fb09170e7d1e/dragging.png) | ![排序完成并恢复展示](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/024a7cebc9994f4505aec9983b89fb09170e7d1e/dropped.png) |

另一个独立的**真实 bundle daemon** 重启验证在同一 origin/token 更换主工作区。旧页面再次读取排序，与真实 API 响应和新上下文保持一致。以下截图展示相同的实际展示顺序；持久化和重启由单独的 HTTP 与浏览器断言验证。真实 daemon 对比在 `8ba85f4530` 上捕获；之后的修复仅补齐能力测试预期并缓存展开状态查询，三张模拟 daemon 的 UI 截图已在这些修复后重新捕获。全部截图均已目视检查，上传到独立素材分支并固定到同一 commit，图片不进入实现分支。

| 主工作区更换后的旧页面 | 全新浏览器上下文 |
| --- | --- |
| ![旧页面显示新主工作区保存的顺序](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/024a7cebc9994f4505aec9983b89fb09170e7d1e/primary-existing.png) | ![新上下文显示相同顺序](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/024a7cebc9994f4505aec9983b89fb09170e7d1e/primary-fresh.png) |

全仓构建和类型检查通过。最终侧栏定向回归通过 102 个测试，完整真实 daemon HTTP 路由集成测试 42 项通过，模拟 daemon 的 Chromium 测试四项全部通过。daemon/API 和 SDK 测试也在最后的纯前端修复之前通过。最后两轮独立完整代码 review 没有遗留缺陷。详细 E2E 报告和覆盖边界见单独评论。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Chromium、真实 daemon HTTP/重启、组件和单元检查 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地验证 |

### 环境（可选）

包含丰富会话的 UI 场景使用本地 Web Shell、Chromium 和仓库模拟 daemon；身份验证、磁盘持久化、存储失败和重启检查使用真实 bundle daemon，以及隔离的临时工作区、配置和运行时目录。没有使用模型请求或真实 Git 修改作为测试证据。

## 风险和范围

- 主要风险或取舍：共享顺序采用最后提交的写入生效；已打开的标签页不实时同步。单个侧栏内保存串行执行，失败时回滚展示。
- 未验证或不在范围：触屏拖动、Windows/Linux 本地运行、默认收起会话、按最近使用自动排序，以及真实 Git 后端操作。浏览器 fixture 无法驱动所需的列表替换，因此拖动源移除使用组件测试兜底验证。
- 兼容和迁移：没有新增依赖，不自动迁移浏览器排序。旧 daemon 保持原有本地持久化；工作区注册集合、runtime/启动顺序和信任不变。两种语言的设计文档完整同步。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #16038。本 PR 提供手动控制，不关闭默认展开行为和最近使用排序的剩余诉求。

</details>

prs.title: feat(telemetry): record OpenRouter routing backend and generation id
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Records two OpenRouter routing attributes on the `qwen-code.llm_request` span: `openrouter.provider`, the backend that actually served the request, and `openrouter.generation_id`, the `X-Generation-Id` response header. Both are read from the raw wire — the response headers and the un-normalized response body or SSE chunk — because the OpenAI converter builds a fresh response from a fixed field whitelist and drops them before telemetry ever sees them.

The non-streaming path now takes its completion through the SDK's `withResponse()` so the raw `Response` is reachable, falling back to a plain await when the client does not expose it. Writes go through a new `GenAiExchangeController.recordResponseAttribute`, which refuses to touch a finalized attempt or a handle from another generation.

## Why it's needed

OpenRouter rotates requests across backend providers, and which backend answered is often exactly what explains a difference in speed, cost, or output quality. OpenRouter reports that decision on every response, but today an external observer of Qwen Code's telemetry can see that something answered via `openrouter.ai` and never which backend. Issue #14629 asks for the two values, and both halves are needed for the routing decision to be usable: the provider for the immediate answer, the generation id because it is the key to OpenRouter's own per-generation cost and latency lookup.

The attributes are vendor-prefixed rather than folded into `gen_ai.provider.name`, which already means the gateway/protocol provider (e.g. `gcp.gemini`); overloading it would silently change the meaning of an emitted field.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Point a config at `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` with telemetry enabled and run a prompt; the `qwen-code.llm_request` span should carry both attributes. Without an OpenRouter key, the behavior is covered by unit tests: header capture, body/chunk capture with first-non-empty-wins, and the hostname gate that keeps a non-OpenRouter endpoint from emitting either attribute even when its payload carries the same field names.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible or TUI change; this only adds span attributes.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A  |

Unit tests only; no live OpenRouter traffic was exercised.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the non-streaming path now goes through `withResponse()` instead of a plain await. Mocked and proxy-compatible clients that lack the method take the same await path as before, and the existing suite covers that fallback; a client whose `withResponse()` resolves an unexpected shape would now fail where it previously succeeded.
- Not validated / out of scope: not exercised against live OpenRouter traffic, so the upstream contract (that `provider` appears on every chunk and `X-Generation-Id` on every response) is taken from the report rather than re-verified here. Full `npm run build` was not run; the core package typecheck, eslint, and prettier are clean on the changed files.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. New span attributes are additive and only emitted on an OpenRouter hostname.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14629

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

在 `qwen-code.llm_request` span 上记录两个 OpenRouter 路由属性：`openrouter.provider`（实际服务该请求的后端 provider）与 `openrouter.generation_id`（响应头 `X-Generation-Id`）。两者都从原始网络层读取 —— 响应头，以及未经归一化的响应体或 SSE chunk —— 因为 OpenAI converter 会用固定的字段白名单重建响应对象，它们在进入遥测之前就被丢弃了。

非流式路径现在通过 SDK 的 `withResponse()` 取得补全结果，从而能拿到原始 `Response`；客户端没有该方法时退回普通 await。写入统一走新增的 `GenAiExchangeController.recordResponseAttribute`，它会拒绝向已 finalize 的 attempt 或属于其他 generation 的 handle 写入。

## 为什么需要

OpenRouter 会把请求轮转分发到多个后端 provider，而究竟是哪个后端应答，往往正是速度、成本或输出质量差异的原因。OpenRouter 在每个响应里都会报告这个决策，但今天观察 Qwen Code 遥测的外部系统只能看到「某个后端通过 `openrouter.ai` 应答」，看不到是哪一个。

属性采用厂商前缀，而不是并入 `gen_ai.provider.name` —— 后者已有确定含义（网关/协议 provider，如 `gcp.gemini`），复用会静默改变一个已发布字段的语义。

## 评审验证方式

把配置指向 `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` 并开启遥测，跑一次提问，`qwen-code.llm_request` span 应同时带有两个属性。没有 OpenRouter key 时，行为由单测覆盖：响应头采集、响应体/chunk 采集（取第一个非空值）、以及 hostname 门禁 —— 即使非 OpenRouter 端点的 payload 里有同名字段，也不会发出这两个属性。

Before/After：不适用，没有用户可见或 TUI 变更，仅新增 span 属性。

仅在 macOS 上跑了单测；未使用真实 OpenRouter 流量验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：非流式路径改用 `withResponse()`，不再是普通 await。缺少该方法或被 mock 的客户端仍走原来的 await 分支，既有测试覆盖了该回退；若某客户端的 `withResponse()` 返回了非预期结构，原本能成功的请求现在会失败。
- 未验证 / 超出范围：未对真实 OpenRouter 流量验证，`provider` 出现在每个 chunk、`X-Generation-Id` 出现在每个响应这两点取自 issue 报告而非本轮复验。未运行完整 `npm run build`；core 包的类型检查、eslint、prettier 在改动文件上均干净。
- 破坏性变更：无。新增 span 属性是纯增量的，且只在 OpenRouter hostname 下发出。

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): scope file changes to the session workspace
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Limits edited-file cards and their reviews to the session working directory and excludes Git-ignored untracked paths. Git-tracked files and non-ignored new files remain visible, including temporary scripts. Managed worktrees use their own execution directory and real parent session owner for virtual subagents. Main chat, split panes, subagent details and restored reviews apply the same policy.

The read-only workspace query is bounded, capability-gated and stays on the selected local or SSH runtime. Missing or failed Git classification falls back to directory containment and retries after connection recovery. Existing transcript and explicit artifact presentation is preserved.

## Why it's needed

Edits to global memory, other projects and ignored helper files currently inflate the file count and line totals. Users need the summary and review to describe the work relevant to the current workspace without guessing whether a filename means “temporary”.

### Summary evidence

Browser E2E uses the merged compiled Web Shell, simulated session metadata/transcript/SSE/bridge state, and the actual Git route with real temporary repositories, indexes, ignore rules and managed-worktree ownership files. No model-generated writes or full daemon authentication/permission middleware are claimed.

Card and review agree on three visible files and +4/-1: source, a tracked `.log`, and a non-ignored temporary script. Ignored helpers/cache and external paths are excluded.

![Workspace file card and review](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5e23a80d8b27c875402a55903a846ebbe38f71c1/root-parent-review.png)

A virtual subagent opened in the main view uses its parent owner and managed cwd. Real HTTP 200 leaves one source file; a direct virtual-ID ownership request remains HTTP 400.

![Virtual managed session file card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5e23a80d8b27c875402a55903a846ebbe38f71c1/managed-virtual-fixed.png)

<details>
<summary>Review regression screenshots / 评审回归截图</summary>

These use the actual final compiled UI with simulated session state and controlled ignore responses. A child linked-worktree edit remains visible without the optional ignore capability; a Live note remains visible with a withheld cwd; releasing the new-file verdict updates the existing card and review from one file to two. These images validate UI state, not real backend Git decisions.

以下为最终实际构建产物，使用模拟会话与受控忽略响应：无忽略能力的子代理仍展示 linked worktree 编辑；Live 隐藏 cwd 时保留笔记；新文件判定返回后，已打开的卡片和评审均从一个文件增加为两个文件。图片验证 UI 状态，真实 Git 判定另由通用路由 fixture 和后端测试验证。

![No-capability child / 无能力子代理](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5e23a80d8b27c875402a55903a846ebbe38f71c1/review-no-capability.png)

![Live with withheld cwd / Live 隐藏 cwd](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5e23a80d8b27c875402a55903a846ebbe38f71c1/review-live-withheld-cwd.png)

![Pending review widens / 等待判定后评审增加文件](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5e23a80d8b27c875402a55903a846ebbe38f71c1/review-pending-widen.png)

An incomplete saved target reports unavailable content: [screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5e23a80d8b27c875402a55903a846ebbe38f71c1/review-incomplete-restore.png). 保存的目标不完整时明确报内容不可用：[截图](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/5e23a80d8b27c875402a55903a846ebbe38f71c1/review-incomplete-restore.png)。

</details>

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- In one turn, edit a source file, a tracked file matching an ignore rule, a non-ignored temporary script, ignored helpers and an external file. The card and opened review should show only the first three, with matching file and line totals. An all-noise turn should show no file card.
- Open the same session in a split pane or a subagent detail, including a managed worktree. Confirm the execution directory determines containment and Git rules even when session details are hidden.
- Reload a saved review and reconnect after a failed classification. The review should preserve its original diff snapshots, recover visibility, and avoid showing unclassified files on a cold load. Non-Git directories and older/unavailable daemons retain contained edits; Live sessions with a withheld cwd retain their original edits. A saved review with a missing referenced edit should report unavailable content rather than silently omit it.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: successful edit calls from external folders and ignored helper files contribute to cards and reviews. After: the screenshots above show only three relevant files, and the virtual managed entry shows only one. A separate noise-only browser case confirms no file card. Images were visually checked and live on an independent assets branch at a fixed commit.

Validation: frozen-lockfile worktree installation; full build, typecheck and bundle; 2,518 relevant unit tests across Web Shell, CLI and SDK; the real-daemon capabilities integration case; two Playwright cases on an isolated port; nine independently reproduced and reverified review regressions; changed-file ESLint and Prettier. The integration baseline also tolerates the runtime-mounted `channel_reload` tag, matching the existing treatment of other bootstrap/runtime differences.

Review fixes: execution metadata resolves even without the optional Git-ignore capability; Live sessions with a withheld cwd retain their edits. Open reviews preserve unfiltered snapshots and can widen after a pending verdict or recovery; missing saved targets produce an explicit restore error. Artifact badges, legal colon filenames, partial client batches and disconnect cancellation are covered. Git probes receive the selected runtime snapshot, or the captured daemon boot environment for a parent-process runtime without a snapshot; missing overlay snapshots remain isolated. The process-environment guard has no new exception.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Local Node 22, built CLI and Chromium. Browser fixtures use simulated session state with real qualified Git routes; SSH is covered by automated boundary tests, without a live SSH host.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: unknown Git status preserves contained edits, so ignored noise can remain during an outage. Path comparisons preserve case and do not resolve filesystem aliases. This is a cross-package daemon/SDK/UI change; no new dependency is added.
- Not validated / out of scope: full repository suite, Windows/Linux hosts, live SSH, and real model file writes. A fresh frozen-lockfile installation succeeded in the repair worktree. Supply-chain checks were not disabled. Additional refresh coalescing, key memoization, metadata retry on later edits, diagnostics and broader mutation tests are recorded in the review thread for follow-up after the repeated review rounds.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: additive capability and REST endpoint; older daemons use containment-only behavior. No migration required.

Design: [English](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/codex/web-shell-workspace-file-changes/docs/design/web-shell-workspace-file-changes.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/codex/web-shell-workspace-file-changes/docs/design/web-shell-workspace-file-changes.zh-CN.md). Both versions are synchronized.

## Linked Issues

No linked issue.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

已编辑文件卡片及其评审只展示会话工作目录内的文件，并排除 Git 忽略且未跟踪的路径。已跟踪文件、未被忽略的新文件继续展示，包括临时脚本。受管 worktree 使用自己的执行目录，虚拟子代理使用真实父会话 owner。主聊天、分栏、子代理详情和恢复的评审统一使用该规则。

新增只读工作区查询有数量、时间和执行次数上限，按能力标记启用，仅在所属本地或 SSH runtime 执行。Git 分类缺失或失败时降级为按目录范围筛选，连接恢复后重试。完整转录和显式 artifact 展示保持原有行为。

## 为什么需要

全局记忆、其他项目和被忽略的辅助文件会增加当前文件数及增删行统计。卡片和评审应反映当前工作区相关工作，不根据文件名猜测“临时”用途。

### 摘要证据

浏览器 E2E 使用合并后的实际 Web Shell 构建产物，会话 metadata、转录、SSE 和 bridge 为模拟数据；Git 查询通过实际路由执行，使用真实临时仓库、索引、忽略规则及受管 worktree 所属文件。不代表模型实际写入文件，也未覆盖完整 daemon 认证/权限中间件。

上方主图中卡片和评审均为三个文件、+4/-1：源码、已跟踪 `.log` 和未忽略临时脚本。被忽略的辅助文件、缓存和外部路径均被排除。第二张图的虚拟子代理主入口使用父会话 owner/受管 cwd，真实 HTTP 200 后仅展示一个源码文件；直接携带虚拟 ID 的所属请求仍返回 HTTP 400。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

- 同一轮编辑源码、匹配 ignore 的已跟踪文件、未忽略临时脚本、被忽略辅助文件和外部文件。卡片和评审仅显示前三项，文件数及行数一致。全部为噪音时没有文件卡片。
- 在分栏和子代理详情打开同一会话，包含受管 worktree。即使隐藏会话详情，仍按执行目录筛选范围和 Git 规则。
- 重载已保存评审，并在分类失败后重连。评审保留原始 diff 快照并恢复可见性，冷加载不提前展示未分类文件。非 Git 目录、旧版或不可用 daemon 保留范围内编辑；Live 隐藏 cwd 时保留原始编辑。保存的评审缺少引用的编辑时应明确报内容不可用，而不是静默遗漏。

### 前后对比证据

改前，外部目录及被忽略文件的成功编辑会进入卡片和评审；改后，上图仅保留三个相关文件，虚拟受管入口仅保留一个。另有纯噪音浏览器用例确认无卡片。截图均已目视检查，放在独立素材分支，链接固定 commit。

验证通过：新 worktree 冻结安装；完整构建、类型检查和打包；Web Shell/CLI/SDK 共 2518 项相关单元测试；真实 daemon 能力集成用例；独立端口的两项 Playwright 用例；九项独立复现并复验的评审回归；改动文件 ESLint 和 Prettier。集成基线同时按其他 bootstrap/runtime 差异的方式，容忍 runtime 挂载后的 `channel_reload` 动态标签。

评审修复：即使没有可选 Git 忽略能力也解析执行目录；Live 隐藏 cwd 时保留编辑。已打开的评审保留未过滤快照，可在等待中的判定或连接恢复后增加可见文件；保存的目标缺失时明确报恢复错误。同时覆盖 artifact 标记、合法冒号文件名、客户端部分批次失败和断连取消。Git 使用所属 runtime 快照；parent-process 缺少快照时使用显式传入的 daemon 启动环境，overlay 缺少快照时仍保持隔离。进程环境 guard 未新增白名单。

### 测试平台

macOS 已测试；Windows 和 Linux 未测试。

### 环境

本地 Node 22、构建后的 CLI 和 Chromium。浏览器会话状态模拟，Git 路由为真实实现；SSH 通过自动边界测试覆盖，未连接真实 SSH 主机。

## 风险与范围

- Git 状态未知时保留范围内编辑，因此故障期间仍可能显示忽略噪音。路径比较保留大小写且不解析文件系统别名。本次跨 daemon、SDK、UI，未添加依赖。
- 未验证全仓库测试、Windows/Linux、真实 SSH 和模型写入。本次修复 worktree 的冻结安装成功，未关闭供应链校验。多轮评审后的刷新合并、key 缓存、后续编辑触发元数据重试、诊断及更广的变异测试已在评审讨论中记录为后续项。
- 能力和 REST 接口为增量扩展；旧 daemon 退化为仅按范围筛选，无迁移要求。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/codex/web-shell-workspace-file-changes/docs/design/web-shell-workspace-file-changes.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/ytahdn/qwen-code/blob/codex/web-shell-workspace-file-changes/docs/design/web-shell-workspace-file-changes.zh-CN.md)，两版已同步。

## 关联 Issue

无。

</details>
