prs.title: feat(web-shell): browse managed auto-memory in /memory (listing, read, toggles)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The web-shell /memory panel gains a third tab, "Auto memory", that browses the managed auto-memory store: entries are listed grouped by scope (project scope under the workspace's managed memory root — `<memory-base>/projects/<workspace>/memory/`, or `<workspace>/.qwen/memory` with `QWEN_CODE_MEMORY_LOCAL=1` — and user scope under `<memory-base>/memories/`; the daemon reports the resolved directories in `projectDir`/`userDir`) with title, description, and size, and selecting an entry reads its content through the daemon with a 1 MiB read cap and an explicit truncation flag. The tab also exposes the managed settings `memory.enableManagedAutoMemory` and `memory.enableManagedAutoDream` as toggles (written to user scope), and on a local daemon advertising the `workspace_local_open` capability a per-scope "Open folder" button opens the scope's directory on the daemon host.

On the daemon side this adds `GET /workspace/auto-memory` and `GET /workspace/auto-memory/file?path=...` (the file route re-validates the requested path against the two managed roots server-side, symlink-canonicalized, before opening it; failures map to typed statuses: 400 outside/non-regular, 404 missing, 403 untrusted workspace), exposed over ACP as `_qwen/workspace/auto-memory` and `_qwen/workspace/auto-memory/file`. The SDK gains `DaemonClient.workspaceAutoMemory()`, `workspaceAutoMemoryFile(path)`, and `openAutoMemoryFolderLocally(scope)`; the web shell gains the `useDaemonAutoMemory` hook, the `AutoMemoryPanel` component, and the new tab in `MemoryMessage`. i18n adds the needed en/zh-CN strings and removes the now-unused "not available yet" placeholders.

## Why it's needed

Issue #13396: the web-shell /memory panel did not render managed auto-memory at all — the folder entry and the auto-memory/auto-dream toggles were dead ends labeled "not available from web-shell yet". Desktop and web-shell users have no TUI, so the memory panel is their only place to inspect what the agent has remembered or to switch memory capture on and off.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `pnpm install`, then start the development daemon and web shell (repo `dev` script) for a workspace that already has auto-memory entries, or create one under the project's managed memory directory (e.g. `<workspace>/.qwen/memory/` with `QWEN_CODE_MEMORY_LOCAL=1`).
2. Run `/memory` in the web shell — the panel now has three tabs: Project, User, and the new "Auto memory".
3. In the Auto memory tab: expect entries grouped under "Project memory" / "User memory" with per-scope file count and total size; click an entry to see its content; a file over 1 MiB shows the truncation notice instead of failing; the toggles reflect the effective settings and persist to user scope when flipped.
4. On a local daemon advertising `workspace_local_open`, an "Open folder" button appears per scope; on a remote daemon it is hidden.
5. Web-shell unit tests (from `packages/web-shell`): `npx vitest run --config vitest.config.ts client/components/messages/AutoMemoryPanel.test.tsx client/components/messages/MemoryMessage.test.tsx client/daemon/workspace/hooks/useDaemonAutoMemory.test.tsx` → 24/24 pass.
6. Daemon unit tests (from `packages/cli`): `npx vitest run src/serve/workspace-auto-memory.test.ts src/serve/routes/workspace-local-open.test.ts` → the new suites pin the read boundary (outside-root refusal, symlink escape, missing file, 1 MiB truncation, torn read, untrusted-workspace fail-closed, relative-path refusal) and the folder-open target (200 with scope, 404 missing dir, 400 non-directory).
7. `npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` and `prettier --experimental-cli --check` are clean for the touched packages in the same environment.

No live-session screenshots in this verification pass (unit/type/format checks ran in a one-off Docker container; interactive before/after screenshots can follow if maintainers want them). Before: the /memory panel had no auto-memory section at all — the "not available from web-shell yet" placeholder strings were the only trace. After: the Auto memory tab described above; behavior is covered by 45 unit tests — 24 web-shell (panel rendering, reads including truncation and 404, toggle persistence and error notices, folder-button gating, tab switching) and 21 daemon-side (path confinement, read contract, listing, HTTP status mapping, folder-open target, relative-path refusal).

One-off `node:22-bookworm` Docker container with a full pnpm workspace install (unit tests, `tsc --noEmit`, `prettier --check`). No live Desktop/daemon session was driven as part of this PR's verification.

prs.title: feat(channels): give bound sessions role guidance without operator templates
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A session bound to a pull request now learns which role it holds even when the operator has configured no action templates, and receives built-in guidance scoped to that role instead of a role-blind instruction to act. Reviewers are told to review and report, verifiers to verify and attribute rather than fix, and only the fixer role is pointed at changing the branch. Bindings without a role keep exactly the prompt they get today, and a configured operator template still takes precedence over the built-in guidance.

The machine-generated event summaries now state facts only. A CI failure reports the head and the failed checks; a conflict reports the mergeable state; a merged pull request is reported as merged. None of them tells the session to fix, rebase, or wrap up. What to do about an event comes from the operator's template, the built-in role guidance, or the session's own workflow — never from the event data.

Routing is deliberately unchanged: without a template map there is still exactly one winner chosen by the same recency rule, and a role on a binding never enables fan-out.

## Why it's needed

A verification session bound to a pull request received a conflict event whose text ended with "Rebase or merge the base branch and resolve the conflicts", with nothing in the prompt saying it was a verifier. It resolved the contradiction by guessing: it built a merge commit on the branch and asked whether to push it. A verification session should report that a conflict blocks verification and leave the branch to its author.

Two independent causes produced that. Legacy delivery discarded a stamped role on purpose, to keep the pre-template prompt byte-identical — a promise written for untyped bindings, but applied to typed ones too, which made a role assigned by a review or verification backfill indistinguishable from no role at all. Separately, the watch summaries were role-blind imperatives naming fixer work, so they reached every role unchanged. Either alone is survivable; together they instruct a verify-only session to push.

Operators could already work around this by writing templates for every role and event, but needing to configure a map to stop a verifier from being told to push is the wrong default.

Surfacing the role also exposed a latent defect. The lost-session fallback built the prompt once for the first target and reused that string for every later candidate. Because the legacy fallback scans all followers without a role filter, it can cross roles, so a departed reviewer's role line and reviewer guidance were delivered to the verifier taking over. The fallback now rebuilds the prompt for each target from that target's own role.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Bind a session to a pull request with the `verify` role, enable bound delivery and the conflict watch event, and configure no action templates. Advance the pull request into a conflicting state. Before this change the delivered prompt carried no role line and ended by telling the session to rebase or merge; after it, the prompt names the verifier role, instructs it to report rather than modify the branch, and the body only states that the mergeable state is dirty.

Then configure an action template for that role and repeat: the operator instruction block appears exactly as before and the built-in guidance does not appear at all. A role with no matching key still receives nothing, so the per-role subscription is intact.

Finally, bind an untyped session and confirm its prompt is unchanged in both modes. Two pre-existing tests that pin the legacy generic prompt pass without modification, which is the regression guard for that claim.

For the fallback fix, arrange two followers of different roles where the more recent one is gone. The session that takes over must receive its own role and its own guidance, never the departed session's.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible terminal or web UI surface. The change is the text handed to a bound session, asserted directly in tests.

Verification run locally:

- Channel base package: 27 files, 1798 tests passed.
- GitHub channel package: 4 files, 696 tests passed (694 when this description was first written; the deferred-retry and partial-snapshot cases were added during review).
- Both changed packages compile; lint and formatting are clean on every changed file.
- The new shared-builder cases were added before the implementation and failed 6 of 40; after it, all 40 pass.

Every source change is witnessed by a mutation. Each was applied in isolation, the named test run, and the source restored; all seven turn the expected test red: dropping the role from the watch target path, from the comment target path, and from the fallback; reusing the first target's prompt in the fallback; dropping the guidance argument; and restoring each of the three removed imperatives (CI failure, merge conflict, merged state). The comment-path witness later needed a partial-snapshot case: the deferred-retry fix made delivery-time revalidation refill the role on a complete snapshot, masking what target selection attached. Independent verification caught that survivor; the added case restores the witness.

That mutation round drove two corrections worth calling out for review. An initial implementation withheld guidance behind a "not role-aware" condition; removing the condition changed no test, because role-aware targets are selected by template match and therefore always carry an operator instruction. The condition was deleted rather than kept as an unreachable branch. And the first role test used a comment event, so dropping the role from the watch path — the path the reported incident actually took — survived; a watch-path test reproducing the incident was added.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only. The adapter tests drive the real routing and the real shared prompt builder, mocking just the GitHub API client and the bound-session port, and assert the exact delivered prompt string.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the prompt text is a model-facing contract, so sessions with older transcripts will see a new sentence. For untyped bindings nothing changes; for role-carrying bindings a role-blind imperative is replaced by role-scoped guidance, which is the intent. The guidance is instruction text, not an authorization boundary — tool permissions remain the boundary.
- Not validated / out of scope: no live-daemon run against a real GitHub channel, and no full-repository build or typecheck; verification was scoped to the two changed packages, both of which compile and pass their complete suites. The daemon-side watch producer is not implemented here, though the guidance table lives in the shared module so it can reuse it.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No setting is added or changed, and no persisted format moves. Operators who already configure action templates see no difference.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

现在，即使运维者没有配置任何动作模板，绑定到某个 PR 的会话也能得知自己持有哪个角色，并收到限定于该角色的内置指引，而不是一条与角色无关的行动指令。评审者被告知去评审并报告，验证者被告知去验证与归因而不是修复，只有 fix 角色才被指向改动分支。不带角色的绑定，其提示词与今天完全一致；已配置的运维者模板仍然优先于内置指引。

机器生成的事件摘要现在只陈述事实。CI 失败报告 head 与失败检查项；冲突报告 mergeable 状态；已合并的 PR 就报告为已合并。它们都不再叫会话去修复、rebase 或收尾。对某个事件该做什么，来自运维者模板、内置角色指引，或会话自己的工作流——绝不来自事件数据。

路由是刻意不变的：没有模板映射时仍然恰好一个赢家，按同一条最近更新规则选出；绑定上的角色绝不启用扇出。

## 为什么需要

一个绑定到 PR 的验证会话收到冲突事件，正文以「Rebase or merge the base branch and resolve the conflicts」结尾，而提示词里没有任何地方说明它是验证者。它靠猜化解了这个矛盾：在分支上造了一个 merge commit，并询问是否推送。验证会话本应报告「冲突阻断了验证」，把分支留给作者。

造成这一点的是两个独立原因。legacy 投递故意丢弃已标记的角色，为的是让引入模板之前的提示词逐字节不变——这条承诺本是为未类型化绑定写的，却也被套用到带角色的绑定上，使得评审或验证回填所赋予的角色与根本没有角色完全无法区分。另一方面，监视摘要是与角色无关的祈使句，点名了修复者的工作，因此原样送达每个角色。单独任一条都还能应付；两条叠加就变成指使一个只做验证的会话去推送。

运维者本来可以通过为每个角色与事件都写模板来绕过，但「必须配置一张映射表才能阻止验证者被指使去推送」本身就是错误的默认值。

暴露角色还显出了一处潜伏缺陷。会话丢失后的回退逻辑只为第一个目标构造一次提示词，随后对每个后续候选复用那个字符串。由于 legacy 回退不带角色过滤地扫描所有跟随者，它可能跨角色，于是已离开的评审者的角色行与评审者指引被投递给了接手的验证者。现在回退会按每个目标自己的角色重建提示词。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

以 `verify` 角色把一个会话绑定到某个 PR，开启绑定投递与冲突监视事件，并且不配置任何动作模板。让该 PR 进入冲突状态。改动前，投递出的提示词没有角色行，并以叫会话 rebase 或 merge 结尾；改动后，提示词点名验证者角色、要求它报告而不是改动分支，正文只陈述 mergeable 状态为 dirty。

随后为该角色配置一条动作模板并重复：运维者指令区块与之前完全一致地出现，内置指引则完全不出现。没有匹配键的角色仍然什么都收不到，因此按角色订阅的语义完好。

最后，绑定一个未类型化会话，确认它在两种模式下的提示词都没有变化。两条钉住 legacy 通用提示词的既有测试未经修改即通过，这是该论断的回归护栏。

对于回退修复，安排两个不同角色的跟随者，其中较近的那个已丢失。接手的会话必须收到它自己的角色与自己的指引，绝不是已离开会话的。

### 证据（改动前后）

N/A —— 没有面向用户的终端或 Web UI 表面。改动的是交给绑定会话的文本，已在测试中直接断言。

本地验证结果：

- channel base 包：27 个文件，1798 条测试通过。
- GitHub channel 包：4 个文件，696 条测试通过（本描述初稿时为 694；延迟重试与 partial 快照两条用例是评审期间新增的）。
- 两个改动包均可编译；所有改动文件的 lint 与格式化干净。
- 新增的共享构造器用例在实现之前加入，40 条中失败 6 条；实现之后 40 条全过。

每处源码改动都有变异作为见证。每条变异单独施加、跑被点名的用例、再还原源码；七条全部让预期用例转红：从监视目标路径、评论目标路径、回退路径分别丢掉角色；在回退中复用第一个目标的提示词；丢掉指引参数；以及把三处被删除的祈使句各自恢复回去（CI 失败、合并冲突、已合并状态）。评论路径的见证后来需要一条 partial 快照用例：延迟重试修复使投递时再校验在完整快照下回填角色，遮蔽了目标选择所附带的那一半。独立验证捕获了这个存活变异，新增用例恢复了该见证。

那一轮变异带来了两处值得评审注意的修正。初版实现把指引藏在「非角色化」条件之后；去掉该条件没有任何测试变化，因为角色化目标是按模板匹配选出的，必然带有运维者指令。该条件因此被删除，而不是作为不可达分支保留。另外，第一条角色用例用的是评论事件，所以从监视路径——也就是本次事故实际走的那条路径——丢掉角色的变异存活了下来；随后补上了一条复现事故的监视路径用例。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

仅单元测试。适配器测试驱动真实的路由与真实的共享提示词构造器，只 mock GitHub API 客户端与绑定会话端口，并断言投递出的确切提示词字符串。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：提示词文本是面向模型的契约，因此持有较早转录的会话会看到一个新句子。对未类型化绑定没有任何变化；对带角色绑定，则是把与角色无关的祈使句替换为限定角色的指引，这正是意图所在。指引是指令文本而非授权边界——工具权限才是边界。
- 未验证 / 范围之外：没有针对真实 GitHub channel 做实时 daemon 运行，也没有做全仓构建或类型检查；验证范围限定在两个改动包，二者均可编译并通过各自完整套件。此处不实现 daemon 侧的监视生产者，不过指引表放在共享模块里，便于它复用。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。没有新增或改动任何设置，也没有持久化格式变动。已经配置动作模板的运维者不会看到任何差别。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/bound-session-role-aware-defaults/docs/design/2026-11-08-bound-session-role-guidance.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/bound-session-role-aware-defaults/docs/design/2026-11-08-bound-session-role-guidance.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

无。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): open the highlighted /mcp server when grouping reorders rows
prs.body:
## What this PR does

`/mcp` now selects servers by identity instead of by a display index. `ServerListStep` reports the selected server object, and `MCPManagementDialog` stores its name and resolves it against `servers` — the same name-based selection the OpenTUI dialog already uses.

## Why it's needed

Rows are grouped by source while `servers` stays in configured order. Top-tier servers (`--mcp-config`, ACP/IDE session, bundled Mem0) render under "User MCPs" but sit last in `servers`, so passing a row index made the dialog open a different server; Disable, Clear Authentication, Reconnect and Approve then applied to that server. Removing the index means the two orderings can no longer be confused.

Fixes #14651.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```console
cd packages/cli
../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/ui/components/mcp
```

The current MCP suite contains 47 tests, including the two added regressions. [wenshao independently verified 47/47 at the current head](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14653#issuecomment-6528151819), with the two added regressions failing on base. My original local run below predates those additions and covered 45 tests. The mixed-source test fails on `9135d45910` because the callback receives the row index, and passes here because it receives `cliSrv`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before: selecting `cliSrv` (row 2) called `onSelect(1)`; the dialog used `servers[1]` = `projectSrv`.
- After: the callback receives the `cliSrv` object; the dialog resolves it by name.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Original local macOS validation: `components/mcp` suite 45 passed (before the two later regressions), `tsc --noEmit`, eslint and prettier on the changed files. No live TUI session was run.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only. No screen recording is attached because no live TUI session was run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: `ServerListStepProps.onSelect` changes signature; it is internal to the MCP dialog package (`ServerListStep`, `MCPManagementDialog`, tests).
- Not validated / out of scope: live TUI keypress flow and non-macOS platforms.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none (internal type only).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14651

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

`/mcp` 原来按行的显示位置传索引，但列表按来源分组后的顺序与配置里的 `servers` 数组顺序不同：`--mcp-config`、ACP/IDE 会话和内置 Mem0 在数组里排在项目服务器之后，显示时却归到 "User MCPs"。选中第二行可能打开另一台服务器。

本 PR 改为按身份选择：`ServerListStep` 把选中的 server 对象交给回调，`MCPManagementDialog` 保存 `selectedServerName` 并用 `servers.find(...)` 解析，与 OpenTUI 版已有的做法一致。新增的混合来源测试在 base 9135d45910 上失败（回调收到行号），最初本地 `components/mcp` 套件 45 个测试通过（早于后续新增的两个回归）；wenshao 在当前 head 独立验证了 47/47、两个新增回归在 base 失败，该 47 项不是我本次执行；`tsc --noEmit`、eslint、prettier 均通过。未跑真实 TUI 会话和非 macOS 平台。

</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): add opt-in personal memory backed by Holo
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds opt-in personal memory to Managed Agents. Each authenticated tenant/actor has one idempotently created MemoryStore, which can be immutably bound when creating a Session and reused across authorized Workspaces. Bound Sessions and children receiving their context require both owner identity and existing Workspace authorization. Unbound Sessions make zero memory requests and expose no memory tools.

The control plane owns Holo credentials, opaque provider namespaces, entry ownership and durable operation receipts. Hosted recalls bounded, untrusted reference context for fresh user input and exposes search, exact-content save, read and content-checked deletion through existing approval and Plan Mode rules. Known credential forms suppress automatic recall before truncation. A failed binding read can be revalidated by a later input; successful validation stays cached, and authorization failures still refuse access. Recovery reuses saved results and never automatically resubmits uncertain external writes. Public API, SDK and WebShell parameter forwarding are synchronized; the feature remains disabled by default. Existing transaction entry points are retained, with small same-package responsibility splits that lower class-size ceilings.

## Why it's needed

Managed Sessions need explicit cross-session personal memory without exposing it through a shared Workspace. Provider user filters alone do not establish tenant authorization. A user-owned Store, immutable Session binding and control-plane authorization provide that boundary while keeping ordinary conversation free of automatic memory extraction.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. On an isolated deployment, create a Store twice as the same trusted actor and confirm the same ID. Other actors and tenants must not bind it. Omit the Session binding and confirm zero memory requests and no memory tools; explicitly bind the same Store in another authorized Workspace and confirm cross-session recall.
2. Explicitly request saving synthetic content and confirm ordinary tool approval is required. Ordinary conversation must not write memory, and Plan Mode must refuse mutations. Read an entry before deletion: changed content must refuse deletion, while confirmed deletion must suppress stale search hits.
3. Give another actor Workspace read/operator access and confirm private Sessions remain inaccessible through lists, details, SSE, history, artifacts, actions and related resources. Children inherit private visibility without Store access; private context must not enter shared Sessions. Unbound Sessions retain current authorization behavior.
4. Replace the Harness and restart the control plane during pending approval. The binding and Action ID must survive; approval must cause one external write. Lost replies must return a saved result or unknown without resubmission. Reject stale writers, foreign entry IDs and changed arguments under the same operation key. Resident and cold resumes must deliver saved memory results to the model without repeating recall or acquiring a Runtime for memory-only work.
5. Submit synthetic AWS-shaped keys, Basic headers/bare encoded pairs, password URIs including protocol-relative forms, curl user/password options, sshpass/password flags, MySQL/mysqldump attached passwords, Docker login `-p` and Redis `-a`. Confirm these recognized forms produce zero recall calls, including a credential after the 512-character cutoff. Ordinary Basic descriptions, username-only options, Docker UID:GID, SSH/MySQL/Redis ports and Docker published ports should still recall. A transient binding transport/503 failure must reject that input but permit the next input to validate the same binding; disabled/foreign bindings and authorization/fencing errors must still refuse access.
6. In the real Hosted fault gates, confirm ordinary lost release replies leave cleanup blocked until terminal drain succeeds, then reload without replaying effects. Keep delayed-provisioning timing/order checks and the actual tool catalog. Confirm child B can answer before child A while A retains its original READY binding without an execution mount; resolve public turn identity to the internal Harness prompt identity for persistence assertions.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI/TUI: no management page or layout change is introduced. API/runtime evidence follows.

Current TypeScript production inputs passed root build, sequential typecheck and bundle. The full memory boundary file passed 54 tests, including the three newly reported short-password forms, their quoted/attached variants and five additional benign port controls. Selected model/tool-turn callers passed 15 with 684 intentionally unselected: 69 distinct passing tests this round, not a full-suite result. The unchanged latency validator's 18 passes and terminal-drain invariant's one pass (27 intentionally unselected) are reused from the earlier fixture increment. Changed-source lint/format and diff checks pass. Independent exact-source and actual built CLI/Core checks cover the same 17 inputs in both modules: all 34 assertions pass, including zero recall dispatch for the three new credential witnesses and unchanged benign inputs. The packaged CLI reports 0.27.0. These synthetic probes do not execute a Managed backend.

Historical pre-integration process evidence includes a packaged Node Harness, Spring control plane and isolated MySQL test against a local Holo protocol fixture: pending approval survived both process restarts, exactly one write occurred, another Workspace recalled the content, and an unbound Session exposed no memory tools or requests. Separate live Holo checks passed 11/11 in two disposable namespaces, covering synchronous IDs, authoritative exact-read scope, search isolation and deletion cleanup. These are earlier-revision results, not current-head backend acceptance; the deployment's cross-service-sharing setting was not inspected.

At pre-fix head `cebcd01a91`, [Java fast](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42435593404/job/128593790936) completed successfully with 6,411 Managed verification tests, zero failures/errors and 17 skips. The configuration/controller/provider classes executed 4/2/20 cases without skips, providing execution evidence for the no-store and provider-refusal assertions. All eight Linux unit shards also completed successfully. Those observations supersede the reviews' earlier pending snapshots; this bounded TypeScript screening fix adds no Java changes. The [full Managed workflow at that head](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42437049917) was triggered by maintainer approval and remained incomplete at the last read; pending and skipped lanes do not establish acceptance.

A later result on the same pre-fix head is still red: [WebShell smoke shard 3](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42435593451/job/128596523460) reports 40 failed and 29 flaky cases, causing its aggregate to fail. The job log shows SSE-harness waits and proxy `ECONNREFUSED` errors; these symptoms do not establish an infrastructure root cause or a memory-code cause. The failure remains unclassified and was not blindly rerun. This security fix does not claim to clear that separate CI failure.

Historical `f832358dad` [full MySQL](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42401798145/job/128506443128) passed 1,574 cases without failures/errors/skips, including seven memory-store and seven private-session cases; [Hosted failover](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42401798145/job/128506443118) ran all 27 E2E commands successfully. Its [Hosted process-fault job](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42401798145/job/128506443236) failed with two failures, one error and four skips among 184 cases. The subsequent fixture corrections retain readiness, owner/generation, exactly-once and sibling-answer-order obligations while fixing terminal-drain forwarding, the stale tool catalog and public/internal turn identity. Real post-correction Hosted execution remains pending; no old workflow was rerun this round.

The final candidate is `53ea4d6623957573e4f0c3b3a19e1f474bfb800e`. It adds three command-specific guards for MySQL/mysqldump attached passwords, Docker login passwords and Redis authentication, preserving case-sensitive MySQL port options, Docker published ports and Redis ports. It retains the previous main integration and sorted, unique 292-row lock-contract inventory. Two clean incremental self-audit passes and an independent bounded review found no further critical issue. Complete acceptance still requires the appropriate CI gates on the revision being accepted; the complete Managed tier uses the repository's maintainer-approval trigger. No further local Java checks were run, and the shared budget remains 591.86/600 seconds. Earlier passes and skipped/pending gates do not establish current-head acceptance.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ focused local checks |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Local checks: macOS 26.7.1 arm64, Node.js 26.12.1, pnpm 11.24.0, built CLI 0.27.0. Earlier backend checks used Oracle JDK 21.0.8, Maven 3.9.14 and disposable MySQL 8.4.11 catalogs, all cleaned up; initial SDK checks used JDK 25. This round started no Java, database, Managed, model or Holo process. Credential probes use synthetic content and in-memory transports.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: privacy enforcement spans shared Session surfaces, child context and recovery. Uncertain external writes return unknown without automatic retry. Enablement requires a dedicated Holo service, server-side credentials and verified cross-service sharing disabled. Explicitly disabled or changed bindings refuse operations rather than silently switching Stores.
- Not validated / out of scope: corrected real Hosted fault cases and current-head Java/MySQL/full Managed gates await CI and the required maintainer approval. Known-form credential screening is not exhaustive: whitespace-only labels such as `DB_PASSWORD value` remain an observed limitation. That broader recognition scope, a separate live-toggle operational runbook and additional Java private-message branch coverage requested in review are explicitly deferred after twelve effective review rounds; existing guards remain. Team stores, automatic extraction, Dream, directory mounts, memory versioning and a standalone management page are out of scope. Live Holo deployment sharing configuration remains unverified.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the first-release V1 schema baseline changes in place, so existing development catalogs must be recreated; no V2 migration is introduced. Memory stays disabled by default. Session binding is immutable. Deletion affects future retrieval, while existing Session history retention and Workspace file-sharing rules continue to apply.

Synchronized design and acceptance criteria: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53ea4d6623957573e4f0c3b3a19e1f474bfb800e/docs/design/2026-11-07-managed-user-memory.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53ea4d6623957573e4f0c3b3a19e1f474bfb800e/docs/design/2026-11-07-managed-user-memory.zh-CN.md). Capability accounting is synchronized in [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53ea4d6623957573e4f0c3b3a19e1f474bfb800e/docs/design/2026-10-21-managed-capability-parity.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/53ea4d6623957573e4f0c3b3a19e1f474bfb800e/docs/design/2026-10-21-managed-capability-parity.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

N/A — implements the approved personal-memory design; no linked issue.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

为 Managed Agent 增加显式启用的个人记忆。每个经过认证的租户/用户拥有一个可幂等创建的 MemoryStore；创建 Session 时可以不可变地绑定该 Store，并在有权访问的多个 Workspace 中复用。绑定后的 Session 及接收其上下文的子 Session 必须同时通过所属用户检查和现有 Workspace 授权。未绑定的 Session 零记忆请求且不提供记忆工具。

Control Plane 负责 Holo 凭据、不透明的 provider namespace、条目归属和持久化操作 receipt。Hosted 为新用户输入召回有界的非可信参考上下文，并通过现有审批和 Plan Mode 提供搜索、准确内容保存、读取及内容核对后的删除。已知凭据形态在截断前阻止自动召回。绑定读取失败后，后续输入可以重新校验；成功校验仍缓存，鉴权失败仍拒绝访问。恢复复用已保存结果，不会自动重发不确定的外部写入。公开 API、SDK 和 WebShell 参数透传同步更新，功能保持默认关闭。现有事务入口保留原位，通过同包的小型职责拆分向下收紧类大小门禁。

## 为什么需要

Managed Session 需要显式跨会话复用个人记忆，同时不能通过共享 Workspace 暴露记忆。Provider 用户过滤条件本身不能替代租户鉴权。用户独立拥有的 Store、不可变 Session 绑定和 Control Plane 鉴权提供这一边界，普通对话不自动抽取记忆。

## 评审者测试计划

### 验证方式

1. 在隔离部署中，以同一可信用户创建两次 Store，确认返回同一 ID；其他用户和租户不能绑定它。省略 Session 绑定时，确认零记忆请求且没有记忆工具；在另一个有权访问的 Workspace 中显式绑定同一 Store，确认可以跨会话召回。
2. 明确要求保存合成内容，确认需要普通工具审批。普通对话不能写入记忆，Plan Mode 必须拒绝修改。删除前读取条目：内容变化时必须拒绝删除；确认删除后必须屏蔽残留搜索命中。
3. 为另一个用户授予 Workspace 读/操作权限，确认个人 Session 不能通过列表、详情、SSE、历史、产物、Action 及相关资源访问。子 Session 继承私有可见性但不获得 Store 访问权；私有上下文不能进入共享 Session。未绑定 Session 保持现有授权行为。
4. 在待审批期间替换 Harness 并重启 Control Plane。绑定和 Action ID 必须保留，审批后只发生一次外部写入。响应丢失时返回已保存结果或 unknown，不能重新提交。拒绝旧 writer、其他 Store 的条目 ID，以及同一操作 key 的不同参数。驻留和冷启动续跑都必须向模型传递保存的记忆结果，不能重复召回；纯记忆操作不能获取 Runtime。
5. 提交合成的 AWS 形态 key、Basic 请求头/裸编码用户名密码、带密码 URI（含协议相对形式）、curl 用户名密码参数、sshpass/密码参数、MySQL/mysqldump 紧随参数的密码、Docker 登录 `-p` 及 Redis `-a`。确认这些已识别形态产生零召回调用，包括凭据位于第 512 字符之后的情况。普通 Basic 说明、仅用户名参数、Docker UID:GID、SSH/MySQL/Redis 端口及 Docker 发布端口仍应召回。绑定读取遇到暂时性传输/503 失败时必须拒绝当前输入，但允许下一次输入重新校验同一绑定；关闭/其他 Store 的绑定及鉴权/fencing 错误仍必须拒绝访问。
6. 在真实 Hosted 故障门禁中，确认普通 release 响应丢失后清理保持阻塞，直到终结 drain 成功，随后重载不重复执行效果。保留延迟供给的时序/顺序检查和真实工具目录。确认子会话 B 可以先于 A 回答，而 A 保留原 READY binding 且没有执行挂载；持久化断言须把公开 turn 身份解析为内部 Harness prompt 身份。

### 变更前后证据

UI/TUI 不适用：不新增管理页面或布局变更。API/运行时证据如下。

当前 TypeScript 产品输入的根 build、顺序 typecheck 和 bundle 通过。完整记忆边界文件通过 54 项，包括本轮报告的三种短参数密码、其引号/紧随参数变体，以及五项新增良性端口对照。model/tool-turn 定向调用方通过 15 项、684 项有意未选中：本轮共 69 项不同测试通过，不能视为完整测试集通过。未变动的延迟校验器 18 项通过及终结 drain 不变量一项通过（27 项有意未选中）复用较早夹具增量的证据。修改源码的 lint/format 及 diff 检查通过。独立准确源码与真实构建 CLI/Core 检查在两个模块中覆盖相同的 17 种输入：34 项断言全部通过，包括三种新凭据样本零召回外发及良性输入保持原文。打包 CLI 报告 0.27.0。这些合成探针不运行 Managed 后端。

整合前的历史进程证据包括打包 Node Harness、Spring Control Plane 与隔离 MySQL，Holo 使用本地协议 fixture：两个进程重启后待审批状态保留，只发生一次写入，另一个 Workspace 能召回内容，未绑定 Session 无记忆工具和请求。独立真实 Holo 检查在两个临时 namespace 中通过 11/11，覆盖同步 ID、精确读取的权威 scope、搜索隔离及删除清理。这些是较早版本结果，不是当前 head 后端验收；未检查部署的跨服务共享配置。

修复前 head `cebcd01a91` 的 [Java fast](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42435593404/job/128593790936) 成功完成，Managed verification 共 6,411 项，零失败、零错误、17 项跳过。配置/控制器/provider 测试类分别执行 4/2/20 项、无跳过，提供 no-store 和 provider 拒绝断言的执行证据。八个 Linux 单测分片也均成功完成。这些观察取代评审较早的 pending 快照；本轮有界 TypeScript 检查修复不新增 Java 修改。[该 head 的完整 Managed 工作流](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42437049917) 已由维护者批准触发，但最后读取时仍未完成；待执行和跳过分组不能证明验收通过。

同一修复前 head 后续仍出现红灯：[WebShell smoke 分片 3](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42435593451/job/128596523460) 报告 40 项失败、29 项 flaky，导致其汇总失败。Job 日志包含 SSE harness 等待和代理 `ECONNREFUSED` 错误；这些症状不能证明基础设施根因，也不能证明由记忆代码导致。该失败保持未归因，没有盲目重跑。本次安全修复不声称消除了这项独立 CI 失败。

历史 `f832358dad` 的[完整 MySQL](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42401798145/job/128506443128) 通过 1,574 项，零失败、零错误、零跳过，包括七项记忆库和七项私密会话用例；[Hosted failover](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42401798145/job/128506443118) 的 27 条 E2E 命令全部成功执行。其 [Hosted process-fault job](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/42401798145/job/128506443236) 在 184 项中出现两项失败、一项错误和四项跳过。后续夹具修正保留 readiness、owner/generation、恰好一次和子会话回答顺序要求，修复终结 drain 转发、过时工具目录和公开/内部 turn 身份混用。修正后的真实 Hosted 执行仍待完成；本轮未重跑旧工作流。

最终候选为 `53ea4d6623957573e4f0c3b3a19e1f474bfb800e`。新增三条命令专用检查，覆盖 MySQL/mysqldump 紧随参数的密码、Docker 登录密码和 Redis 认证，同时保留区分大小写的 MySQL 端口参数、Docker 发布端口和 Redis 端口。此前 main 整合及排序、唯一的 292 行 lock-contract 目录保留。两轮连续干净的增量自审和独立有界复核未发现其他 Critical。完整验收仍要求规定的 CI 门禁在接受的版本上通过；完整 Managed tier 使用仓库的维护者批准触发机制。未额外运行本地 Java 检查，共享预算仍为 591.86/600 秒。旧版本通过和跳过/待执行的门禁不能证明当前 head 已验收。

### 已测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ 本地定向检查 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

本地检查：macOS 26.7.1 arm64、Node.js 26.12.1、pnpm 11.24.0、已构建 CLI 0.27.0。较早后端检查使用 Oracle JDK 21.0.8、Maven 3.9.14 和临时 MySQL 8.4.11 catalog，均已清理；初期 SDK 检查使用 JDK 25。本轮没有启动 Java、数据库、Managed、模型或 Holo 进程。凭据探针使用合成内容和内存传输。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：隐私约束覆盖共享 Session 入口、子会话上下文和恢复。不确定的外部写入返回 unknown 且不自动重试。启用要求专用 Holo 服务、服务端凭据，并确认关闭跨服务共享。显式关闭或改变绑定会拒绝操作，不会静默切换 Store。

prs.title: fix(cli): keep one stream-json message id across block-type transitions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a single model response streams thinking and then text, the stream-json adapter splits it into two `assistant` snapshots, because one assistant message may carry only one block type. The second snapshot minted a fresh `message.id` and restarted block numbering at 0, so `--include-partial-messages` emitted one `message_start` (id A), a thinking block at index 0, then a text block at index 0 again with a snapshot carrying id B.

This PR keeps the turn's `message.id` across an intra-turn block-type change: the pending snapshot is still closed (the single-type rule is unchanged), but the continuation reuses the id and carries the block counter forward, so the text block streams at index 1.

## Why it's needed

An SDK consumer that pairs streamed blocks with the final `assistant` snapshot by `message.id` — the natural rule, and the one that works for a plain-text response — sees the text as a *second* message. The reporter's integration library rendered a 22-character answer as 44 characters against a real Model Studio endpoint, and the block index reuse makes `(message.id, index)` ambiguous even for consumers that key on both.

The issue asked for a wire-contract decision. This follows option 1 as described there: one `message.id` per model response, one `message_start`/`message_stop` pair, and the text block at index 1 so the two blocks stay distinguishable inside the single message. That is also how Claude Code's stream-json behaves, which this format follows.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Drive one turn that streams thinking and then text, with partial messages on:

```bash
qwen -p "..." --output-format stream-json --include-partial-messages
```

Before: one `message_start` with id A, `content_block_start` at index 0 twice, and two `assistant` snapshots with ids A and B.
After: one `message_start` with id A, block indexes 0 (thinking) and 1 (text), and both `assistant` snapshots carrying id A.

The two added unit tests pin exactly that: one asserts both snapshots share `message.id`, the other asserts the block indexes are `[0, 1]`. Both fail on `main` and pass with the change.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI wire-format change. Under the unfixed adapter the two new cases fail with `expected 'id-b' to be 'id-a'` and `expected [0, 0] to deeply equal [0, 1]`; with the change the suite is green.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only: `npx vitest run` from `packages/cli`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: consumers that relied on the split ids to tell the thinking snapshot from the text snapshot now get one id. They can still distinguish the snapshots by block type and by the block index range, which is what the issue asked for; the alternative (a second `message_start`/`message_stop` pair) would make a consumer counting messages or usage see two.
- Not validated / out of scope: the subagent path keeps its own per-tool-call message ids; this change only affects intra-turn transitions. `content_block_stop` for the final block is still emitted by `finalizeAssistantMessage`, unchanged.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none in the schema; the `message.id` stability is a behavioral fix.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15875

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

当一个模型响应先流式输出 thinking 再输出 text 时，stream-json 适配器会把它拆成两个 `assistant` 快照，因为一条 assistant 消息只能承载一种 block 类型。第二个快照重新生成了 `message.id`，并把 block 序号从 0 重新开始，于是 `--include-partial-messages` 会发出一个 `message_start`（id A）、一个 index 0 的 thinking 块，然后又是 index 0 的 text 块，且快照携带 id B。

本 PR 让同一轮内的 block 类型切换保留 `message.id`：待发送的快照仍然会被关闭（单类型约束不变），但续接部分复用同一个 id 并延续 block 计数，因此 text 块以 index 1 流式发出。

## 为什么需要

按 `message.id` 把流式块和最终 `assistant` 快照配对，是消费者的自然做法，纯文本响应下也一直成立。现在 text 会被当成第二条消息：提报方的集成库在真实 Model Studio 端点上把 22 字符的答案渲染成了 44 字符；而 block 序号复用也让按 `(message.id, index)` 配对的消费者无法区分两个块。

issue 里说明这需要先定线上契约。本 PR 采用其中描述的方案一：一个模型响应对应一个 `message.id`、一对 `message_start`/`message_stop`，text 块用 index 1，使两个块在同一条消息内仍可区分。这也是本格式所对齐的 Claude Code stream-json 的行为。

## 验证

用一个先 thinking 后 text 的回合，开启 partial messages：

```bash
qwen -p "..." --output-format stream-json --include-partial-messages
```

改动前：一个 id 为 A 的 `message_start`，`content_block_start` 的 index 出现两次 0，两个 `assistant` 快照 id 分别为 A、B。
改动后：一个 id 为 A 的 `message_start`，block index 为 0（thinking）与 1（text），两个快照都是 id A。

新增的两条单测分别钉住这两点：一条断言两个快照共享 `message.id`，另一条断言 block index 为 `[0, 1]`。在 `main` 上均失败，应用改动后通过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：原先依赖 id 区分 thinking 快照与 text 快照的消费者，现在拿到同一个 id。它们仍可通过 block 类型与 block index 区间区分，这正是 issue 要求的；另一种做法（再来一对 `message_start`/`message_stop`）会让按 `message_start` 计消息或用量的消费者看到两条。
- 未覆盖：subagent 路径沿用各自的每次工具调用消息 id，本改动只影响轮内切换；最后一个块的 `content_block_stop` 仍由 `finalizeAssistantMessage` 发出，行为不变。
- 破坏性变更：schema 无变化，`message.id` 的稳定性属于行为修复。

## 关联 issue

Fixes #15875

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): reject recycled PIDs in runtime session status
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The legacy `runtime.json` sidecar now records an opaque process-start token alongside the PID on Linux, and session-liveness reads require both the PID and that token to match when the token is available. Older sidecars remain readable; an unavailable token falls back to the existing PID-liveness behavior rather than declaring a live session dead. The bundled stuck-session diagnostic is updated to use the same identity check and to exclude zombie processes during discovery.

## Why it's needed

A sidecar is intentionally left behind when a session exits. If its PID is later recycled by an unrelated process, `kill(pid, 0)` succeeds and the stale session is reported as active. The first layer of #14288 already rejects zombies; this change closes the related PID-recycling false positive by carrying the same boot-id plus process-start identity already used by the session registry.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Exercise a runtime-status record whose `proc_start` differs from the current process token: the session should resolve to inactive even though the PID is alive. With a matching token it should remain active. A legacy record without `proc_start`, or an unreadable local token, should retain the previous liveness behavior. The added unit cases cover these branches and the new on-disk field.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — internal status classification, no user-visible output changed.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

No local tests, build, typecheck, lint, or formatting checks were run; only `git diff --check` was used. CI is the verification path for this change.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an unreadable `/proc` token degrades to plain PID liveness, so protection is unavailable on those systems; readable mismatches are treated as stale.
- Not validated / out of scope: suspended-parent zombie reaping remains POSIX-inherent and unchanged. Doctor/status surfacing is a separate follow-up. Sidecars written before this change have no token and retain the old limitation.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the addition is backward-compatible; the schema version is unchanged and unknown fields were already ignored by older readers.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14288

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的作用

传统的 `runtime.json` sidecar 现在会在 Linux 上同时记录 PID 和一个不透明的进程启动标识；会话存活判定在标识可用时要求 PID 与标识同时匹配。旧 sidecar 仍然可以读取；标识不可用时回退到原有的 PID 存活检查，而不是把实际存活的会话误判为死亡。内置的卡住会话诊断流程也同步使用相同身份检查，并在枚举时排除僵尸进程。

## 为什么需要

会话退出后 sidecar 会按设计保留。如果它的 PID 后来被无关进程复用，`kill(pid, 0)` 仍会成功，旧的会话就会被报告为活跃。#14288 的第一层修复已经排除了僵尸进程；本变更通过携带 session registry 已有的“启动 ID + 进程启动时间”身份，关闭相关的 PID 复用误报。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

构造一个 `proc_start` 与当前进程标识不同的 runtime-status 记录：即使 PID 存活，会话也应判定为 inactive；标识匹配时应保持 active。缺少 `proc_start` 的旧记录，或本地标识不可读时，应保持原有存活判定行为。新增单元用例覆盖这些分支及新的磁盘字段。

### 证据（修改前后）

不适用——这是内部状态分类变更，没有用户可见输出变化。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

未在本地运行测试、构建、typecheck、lint 或格式检查；只执行了 `git diff --check`。本变更由 CI 验证。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：`/proc` 标识不可读时会降级为普通 PID 存活检查，因此这些系统无法获得额外保护；能够读到且不匹配时则判定为陈旧记录。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：暂停父进程导致的僵尸回收仍是 POSIX 固有行为，不做修改。doctor/status 的显式展示属于后续独立工作。本次变更前写入的 sidecar 没有标识，仍保留原有局限。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：新增字段向后兼容；schema 版本不变，旧读取方原本就会忽略未知字段。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #14288

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): keep the /mcp action cursor on its action when the list rebuilds
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The OpenTUI `/mcp` server-detail dialog now remembers the highlighted action by its key instead of its row index. When an action succeeds and the host rebuilds the list with fewer rows, the cursor stays on the same action, or falls back to the first row when that action is gone.

## Why it's needed

The cursor belongs to an action, but the host can rebuild the action list after an operation. Retaining only its old row index can select a different action when rows disappear. The ink dialog already tracks the active item by key and falls back to the first entry (`useSelectionList`); this restores parity for the opt-in OpenTUI renderer.

The component regression demonstrates the wrong-action risk using a disconnected server with cached tools. That fixture is broader than the normal product state: disconnected servers drop their tools. The reachable product transition is a four-row to three-row list, where Enter should use the first-row fallback instead of retaining the old index. [wenshao independently verified that real TUI transition](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14661#issuecomment-6527646220); I did not run that live session.

Fixes #14655.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```console
cd packages/cli
../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/ui/opentui/dialogs-mcp.test.tsx -t "keeps the cursor on its action"
```

On `91a7f9e481` this fails with `expected "spy" to not be called with ... "toggle-disable"` because the second Enter falls through to Disable. On this branch it passes.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before (component fixture with cached tools): after Reconnect succeeds, the next Enter calls `onServerAction(server, 'toggle-disable')`.
- After: the cursor falls back to View tools, so Enter opens the tool list and `toggle-disable` is never called.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Original local macOS validation (before the later three regression additions): the dialog test file (19 passed), the related OpenTUI dialog suites (53 passed across `dialogs-mcp`, `opentui-dialog-mount`, `batch-cursor`), `tsc --noEmit`, eslint and prettier on the changed files.

The current head has 22 dialog tests; [wenshao verified 22/22 at head and trial merge, with two failures against base production](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14661#issuecomment-6527646220). This is reviewer evidence, separate from my original local run.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only. No live TUI session was run, so no screen recording is attached.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the change only affects the opt-in OpenTUI renderer (`QWEN_TUI_RENDERER=opentui`); the ink path is untouched.
- Not validated / out of scope: a live keypress session and non-macOS platforms.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14655

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

OpenTUI 的 `/mcp` 服务器详情页原来用行号记录高亮动作，列表变化后可能选中另一动作。组件回归用“断开但仍有缓存工具”的夹具展示误触 Disable；真实产品断开时会清空工具，因此不能将该夹具原样描述为真实 TUI 故障。可达产品路径是四行变三行后应回落到第一行。wenshao 已独立验证该真实 TUI 路径；我未运行该会话。ink 版的 `useSelectionList` 已按 key 记录并回落。

本 PR 把详情页光标改成保存 `action.key`，渲染时再换算成行号；动作消失时回落到第一行。新增回归测试：base 上第二次 Enter 会调用 `toggle-disable`（19 个测试中 1 个失败），分支上 19 个全过；相关的 OpenTUI 对话框套件 53 个测试通过，`tsc --noEmit`、eslint、prettier 均通过。未跑真实 TUI 会话和非 macOS 平台。

</details>

prs.title: test(serve): drive the reconcile probe through the Broker's real rejection path
prs.body:
## Summary

Issue #14388 Item 1 records that `rejectionDetail` classifies the Broker's two contract errors by exact message equality, and that no test would notice if either throw site were reworded. The existing cases feed `rejectionDetail` hand-built `Error` objects whose message is a *copy* of the literal, and `hosted-workspace-broker.test.ts` asserts the same throws with a substring match — so a reword on one side stays green.

This adds a `probeNeverStarted` case per contract error that runs the real `HostedWorkspaceBroker.status()` against a local HTTP fixture:

- `identity_changed` is produced by an answer whose `executionCallId` does not match the probe target;
- `outcome_unknown` is produced by an answer carrying an illegal `state`.

Both then classify through `probeNeverStarted` as `probe_rejected (identity_changed)` / `probe_rejected (outcome_unknown)`, so the classification now runs against the literal the Broker actually throws. Rewording either throw site fails the case.

The fixture server is torn down in `afterEach`, alongside the existing session/root cleanup. The real client is loaded with `vi.importActual` because the module registry substitutes `FakeBroker` in this file.

No production code changes.

## Verification

- `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-never-started-reconcile.test.ts` — 29 passed.
- Mutation-checked: rewording `Runtime execution identity changed.` in `hosted-workspace-broker.ts` makes the new case fail. Reverted before commit.
- `npx prettier --check` on the changed file — clean.
- `npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json` — no errors in this file. The file reports 28 pre-existing errors under `src/utils/relaunch*.ts` (`process.execve` is missing from the Node 20 types installed here); none come from this change.

Not run: full `npm run build`, `npm run lint` across the repo, and the full test suite.

## Scope note

Issue #14388 has two items. Item 2 (`Promise.all` fan-out deferring settlements until the slowest probe resolves) is untouched — it is a real behaviour change whose remedy restructures the fan-out, and the issue itself records it as needing its own change.

Fixes #14388

prs.title: test(managed-runtime): pin the deferred acquire against close
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds the acceptance test item 1 of #14674 asks for: a `/writers:acquire` parked in flight while `seal()` and `stopLocal()` start.

`reacquireWriter()` clears the grant for the whole acquire round trip and restores the expired one only when the acquire fails. Four behaviours on that path shipped with #14570 with no test pinning them. This PR pins them from a real client on fake timers:

- `seal()` does not resolve while the acquire is parked, then seals the grant handed back when it answers.
- `stopLocal()` does not resolve before the acquire answers, and no renewal timer survives it — the late grant is not kept alive.
- A refused acquire restores the expired grant and surfaces the `ManagedSessionStoreHttpError`.
- `joinOriginalCsiWriter()` refuses while an acquire is parked rather than joining a writer it never joined.

The last one is not in the issue text but sits in the same window and is the same data-integrity concern.

This is a test-only change; no production code is touched.

## Why it's needed

#14570 changed what `reacquireWriter()` promises while an acquire is in flight — the grant is cleared for the whole round trip and only restored when the acquire fails. Four behaviours on that path shipped with no test covering them, so a future edit to `seal()`, `stopLocal()`, or `joinOriginalCsiWriter()` could reintroduce a data-integrity bug without any test going red.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the file:

```bash
npx vitest run packages/core/src/managed-runtime/http-managed-session-store.test.ts
```

Expect 209 passed.

Each case was checked against a deliberate mutation of the shipped guard and goes red when the guard is removed:

| Guard removed | Test that fails |
|---|---|
| `await this.acquirePromise` in `seal()` | close test |
| `await this.acquirePromise` in `stopLocal()` | local-stop test |
| `if (this.sealed \|\| this.locallyStopped) await this.sealGrant()` | close test |
| `this.grant = expired` in the acquire `catch` | grant-restore test |
| `this.acquirePromise` in `joinOriginalCsiWriter()` | join test |

`npx prettier --check` and `npx eslint` on the changed file are clean.

`npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json` reports no errors in `packages/core/src/managed-runtime`. Nine errors remain under `packages/core/src/utils/` (`ignore` / `mime/lite` resolution from the reused `node_modules` in this worktree), all in files this change does not touch.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only change, no user-visible behaviour.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS is where the suite and the mutation checks above were run. I did not run Windows or Linux locally; Linux CI is the authority for the unhandled-error platform difference this file exercises, and it has not run against this branch yet.

### Environment (optional)

Local `vitest` only, no sandbox. N/A.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Test-only. The tests bind to the current in-flight acquire semantics, so a deliberate redesign of that path will need them updated rather than silently relaxed.
- Not validated / out of scope: No full `npm run build` (the workspace `build` script fails in this worktree on `packages/browser-use` runtime assembly), no full repo suite, and not item 3's real-stack outage scenarios, which need a control plane plus MySQL.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Refs #14674 — this is item 1 of three, so it does not close the issue.

### 环境（可选）

仅本地 `vitest`，无 sandbox。不适用。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：纯测试。这些测试绑定当前的飞行中 acquire 语义，若有意重新设计该路径，需要同步更新测试，而不是悄悄放宽。

prs.title: docs(design): propose idle parking for resident Hosted Sessions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR adds a design proposal, in English and Chinese, for parking idle resident Hosted Sessions. A parked Session is unloaded from the Hosted Harness while its sandbox stays resident, and it is loaded again on the next input. The PR contains no code. The document asks maintainers to agree on five questions before any implementation starts.

- English: [`docs/design/2026-11-08-hosted-idle-parking.md`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/docs/hosted-idle-parking/docs/design/2026-11-08-hosted-idle-parking.md)
- Chinese: [`docs/design/2026-11-08-hosted-idle-parking.zh-CN.md`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/docs/hosted-idle-parking/docs/design/2026-11-08-hosted-idle-parking.zh-CN.md)

The proposal builds on what `main` already has:
- Java verbs load a Session that is missing from the attachment cache.
- The Kubernetes drain added a release that writes a durable receipt and cancels no accepted input.

It explains why that release cannot park today's resident Sessions, and proposes:
- **A Harness-owned trigger.** The Harness keeps a per-Session idle clock and a per-Session gate.
- **A single Store transaction.** It commits the activation release, seals the head, writes the receipt and, for an uncompacted journal, clears the wake hint, so a refusal leaves nothing to undo.
- **One connector rule in Java.** It turns a `404` on a cached attachment into one passive load, with the stale entry and its recovery marker removed in one atomic step per key.

It also explains why a longer writer lease is not a substitute: it cuts the renewal statements, but it delays the takeover after every Harness crash, and after every restart that does not release its Sessions first, and it leaves the heartbeat, the memory and the listener in place.

The work is split into six phases, starting with measurements and with changes that are useful without parking. A Validation section lists the tests and rig checks each phase lands with.

The first measurements, taken on the #16320 rig, are in the document and change the order:
- Waking a Session reads every durable resource of its history at least once.
- One wake of a 200-Turn Session cost about 178,000 statements and added 17 s to its first Turn. That equals about two days of its idle traffic.
- So the phase that cuts a wake's cost per Turn of history comes before parking.

## Why it's needed

#16320 measured that every resident Hosted Session costs 51–56 statements a minute with nothing running, almost all of it the activation renewal every 20 s. The Java heartbeat every 30 s adds requests but no SQL. The Harness also keeps the Session's whole event log in memory, and a loopback listener for every Session that ran a Shell. Steps 1–5 of #16320 have merged. Step 6, idle parking, is the step that removes this traffic, and #16320 says it needs agreement before code. The triage there placed it under #15082.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Read the document and decide the five questions at its end:
1. Should the Harness own the trigger?
2. In single-address mode, is the writer fence enough, or should single mode get a placement row?
3. Should MCP servers keep running across a park, or restart on wake?
4. Should a parked Session be visible in the public API?
5. Are reading each resource body once and reading in batches enough, or should a wake after a clean park receipt also skip re-reading what the receipt covers?

Every code reference is pinned to `main` at `0807f5d391`, so each claim can be checked at that commit.

How the document was checked:
- Three independent surveys of the code mapped the existing design documents, the Harness attach lifecycle and the Java control plane's attachment model.
- Five rounds of independent review then checked every factual claim against the code and reviewed the design from scratch. Each round fixed real problems, for example:
  - a release that could not back out in a pool;
  - a deadlock between the park gate and a waiting load;
  - a pause of the renewals from inside the serial queue the renewal itself runs in;
  - a held pool load that would carry a released placement.
- A sixth round checked only the last edits for critical problems, and its one finding is fixed.
- A separate review checked that the Chinese translation matches the English.
- The Phase 0 numbers come from one run of a rig built from `main` at `a32684604a`. A separate review recomputed them from the run's raw output.
- The first review round on this PR asked for:
  - removing a stale attachment and its recovery marker in Java in one atomic step;
  - a per-source breakdown of the idle cost, and the case against a longer lease;
  - a residency term in the idle clock;
  - checking sticky conditions before the gate, and re-arming the clock;
  - a paced and capped retry for an unknown outcome;
  - a correction about `bootId` in single mode;
  - acceptance checks, including one that a parked Session's idle traffic is gone, and one test per deterministic outcome;
  - the measurement method of Phase 0.

  The revision addresses each one. It also excludes activation renewals from the idle clock, because otherwise, without the Store's in-place renewal, the clock would never expire. And it fences the park verb on the lease the Harness last saw, so that dropping a Session after an unknown outcome is safe at any time. Six further rounds of review checked the revision against the code and the translation. The last round found nothing critical; the smaller points it left are listed in the reply on this PR.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A. This PR changes documentation only.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A. This PR changes documentation only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Parking trades idle traffic for wake cost. A wake costs about 870 statements per earlier Turn, so parking pays off only for Sessions that stay parked long: with the default 60 s lease, about 45 minutes at one Turn of history, and hours once a Session has more than a few Turns. The document therefore puts the load-cost phase before parking and keeps `park-after` off by default until that phase picks a value. Clearing the wake hint at park time replaces the wake scan's independent replay with the writer's own assertion, for uncompacted journals only. In single-address mode a stale load can reopen a parked Session; Question 2 asks whether that is acceptable.
- Not validated / out of scope: Nothing is implemented, so none of the design has run. The Phase 0 numbers are from a single run on one rig and are indicative. Retiring idle Runtime bindings or Workspaces, and receiving background-Shell output outside the Harness, are out of scope. MCP and Hook Sessions are not parkable until phase 5.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. The PR adds two documents. The proposal would later add a `park-after` setting that is off by default, a Store park verb, a receipt shape with a retention rule, and a lease counter column on `ma_session_head` that writer grants carry.

Design document: both the English and the Chinese version are linked above. They are complete and synchronized: the same sections in the same order, and the same status, decisions, constraints, phases and follow-up work, validation plan and acceptance criteria, Phase 0 results and five open questions. Both pass Prettier 3.6.1, and their language links resolve in both directions.

## Linked Issues

- #16320: this is its step 6. It does not close the issue.
- #15082: the capacity and idle-reclamation discussion where the triage placed step 6.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

这个 PR 新增一份设计提案（中英文各一份），用于让空闲的常驻 Hosted Session 进入 parking：Session 从 Hosted Harness 卸载，沙箱保持常驻，下一次输入到来时再加载。PR 不含代码。文档请维护者先就五个问题达成一致，再开始实现。

- 英文：[`docs/design/2026-11-08-hosted-idle-parking.md`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/docs/hosted-idle-parking/docs/design/2026-11-08-hosted-idle-parking.md)
- 中文：[`docs/design/2026-11-08-hosted-idle-parking.zh-CN.md`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/docs/hosted-idle-parking/docs/design/2026-11-08-hosted-idle-parking.zh-CN.md)

提案建立在 `main` 已有的能力之上：
- Java 动词会加载 attachment 缓存中缺失的 Session。
- Kubernetes drain 引入了一种释放：写一张持久回执，且不取消任何已接受的输入。

文档说明了这种释放为何 park 不了今天的常驻 Session，并提出：
- **由 Harness 触发。** Harness 为每个 Session 维护空闲计时和闸门。
- **单个 Store 事务。** 一次完成提交 activation 释放、封存 head、写回执，并对未压缩的 journal 清除 wake 提示，因此被拒绝时没有任何东西需要撤销。
- **Java 侧一条 connector 规则。** 把缓存 attachment 上的 `404` 转为一次被动 load，并按 key 用一个原子步骤同时移除过期条目和它的恢复标记。

文档还说明了为什么加长 writer 租约不能替代 parking：它能减少续约语句，但会推迟每次 Harness 崩溃之后、以及每次没有先释放 Session 的重启之后的接管，而且心跳、内存和监听端口都还在。

工作分为六个阶段，先做测量，以及即使没有 parking 也有用的改动。“验证”一节列出了每个阶段要带着落地的测试和 rig 检查。

在 #16320 的 rig 上测得的首批数据已写进文档，并改变了阶段顺序：
- 唤醒一个 Session，至少会把它历史中的每一个持久资源都读一遍。
- 一次唤醒 200 个 Turn 的 Session 花了约 178,000 条语句，并让它的第一个 Turn 多出 17 s，相当于它约两天的空闲流量。
- 所以降低唤醒在每个历史 Turn 上成本的那一阶段要排在 parking 之前。

## 为什么需要

#16320 实测，每个常驻 Hosted Session 在什么都不运行时每分钟消耗 51–56 条语句，几乎全部来自每 20 s 一次的 activation 续约。Java 每 30 s 一次的心跳会增加请求，但不产生 SQL。Harness 还会把 Session 的完整事件日志留在内存里，并为每个跑过 Shell 的 Session 保留一个 loopback 监听。#16320 的第 1–5 步已经合入。第 6 步空闲 parking 正是消除这部分流量的一步，#16320 写明它需要先达成一致再写代码，triage 把它放在 #15082 下讨论。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

阅读文档，并就文末五个问题作出决定：
1. 是否由 Harness 负责触发？
2. 单地址模式下，writer fence 是否足够，还是应给单地址模式加一行 placement？
3. park 期间 MCP server 是继续运行，还是唤醒时重启？
4. 已 park 的 Session 是否要在公共 API 中可见？
5. 每个资源正文只读一次加上批量读取是否足够，还是在有干净的 park 回执时，唤醒还应跳过重读回执所覆盖的内容？

所有代码引用都固定在 `main` 的 `0807f5d391`，每一条都可以在该提交上核对。

文档的核对方式：
- 三路独立的代码调研，分别梳理了现有设计文档、Harness 的挂载生命周期，以及 Java 控制面的 attachment 模型。
- 随后做了五轮独立评审，逐条对照代码核对事实陈述，并从头审视设计。每一轮都修正了实际问题，例如：
  - pool 模式下无法回退的释放；
  - park 闸门与等待中的 load 互相等待导致的死锁；
  - 在续约自身运行的串行队列里暂停续约；
  - 被挂起的 pool load 会带着已释放的 placement。
- 第六轮只检查最后几处改动中的 critical 问题，查出的一条已修正。
- 另有一轮评审核对了中文译文与英文是否一致。
- 第 0 阶段的数字来自一次 rig 运行，该 rig 从 `main` 的 `a32684604a` 构建。另有一轮评审根据这次运行的原始输出重新计算过这些数字。
- 本 PR 的第一轮评审要求：
  - 在 Java 中用一个原子步骤同时移除过期 attachment 和它的恢复标记；
  - 按来源拆分空闲成本，并说明为什么不用更长的租约；
  - 空闲计时加入驻留项；
  - 在升起闸门之前检查长期阻塞条件，并重新计时；
  - 结果未知时的重试要有节奏、有上限；
  - 更正单地址模式下关于 `bootId` 的说法；
  - 验收检查，包括确认已 park 的 Session 不再产生空闲流量，以及每种确定性结果一个测试；
  - 第 0 阶段的测量方法。

  修订逐条处理了这些问题。另外，空闲计时排除了 activation 续约，否则在没有 Store 原地续约时计时永远不会到期；park 动词还对 Harness 最后看到的租约做 fence，使结果未知之后任何时候丢弃 Session 都是安全的。之后又做了六轮评审，对照代码和译文核对修订。最后一轮没有发现 critical 问题，剩下的小问题列在本 PR 的回复里。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用。这个 PR 只改文档。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  N/A   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### 环境（可选）

不适用。这个 PR 只改文档。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：parking 用唤醒成本换空闲流量。一次唤醒在每个历史 Turn 上约花 870 条语句，所以只有 park 得足够久的 Session 才划算：按默认 60 s 租约计算，历史只有 1 个 Turn 时约 45 分钟，历史超过几个 Turn 后就要数小时。因此文档把降低 load 成本的阶段排在 parking 之前，并且在该阶段定出数值之前，`park-after` 默认关闭。park 时清除 wake 提示，是用 writer 自己的断言替代 wake 扫描的独立重放，只适用于未压缩的 journal。单地址模式下，过期 load 可以重新打开已 park 的 Session；问题 2 问的就是这是否可以接受。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：没有任何实现，所以设计中的任何部分都没有运行过。第 0 阶段的数字来自一个 rig 上的一次运行，只是指示性的。回收空闲的 Runtime binding 或 Workspace，以及在 Harness 之外接收后台 Shell 的输出，都不在范围内。MCP 与 Hook Session 在第 5 阶段之前不可 park。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。本 PR 只新增两份文档。提案日后会新增一个默认关闭的 `park-after` 设置、一个 Store park 动词、带保留规则的回执结构，以及 `ma_session_head` 上一个随 writer 授予下发的租约计数列。

设计文档：上文已给出英文版和中文版的链接。两份文档完整且同步：章节相同、顺序相同，状态、设计决策、约束、阶段与后续工作、验证计划与验收标准、第 0 阶段结果和五个待决问题都一致。两份都通过 Prettier 3.6.1 检查，语言链接双向可达。

## 关联 Issue

- #16320：本文是它的第 6 步，不关闭该 issue。
- #15082：容量与空闲回收的讨论，triage 把第 6 步放在这里。

</details>

prs.title: perf(managed-agent): take tool execution admission off tenant placement
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Tool execution admission on an ordinary session-class binding no longer takes tenant `runtime_placement`. This is part (b) of #16415, which took dispatch off both tenant guards and admission off the publication guard.

Placement ordered admission's plain read of the Harness drain fence against its writers:

- Lifecycle begin and lifecycle effects already write the fence under the Session root, which admission holds since #16415.
- The storage fence is backstopped by migration's `assertRetired`.
- `requestHarnessDrain` was the gap: it took no row that admission takes.

The changes:

- **Drain takes the Session root.** `requestHarnessDrain` locks the Session root after placement and before it writes the fence. Placement → root is the order every placement owner already uses.
- **Placement-free admission.** Before the transaction, plain reads on their own connection (`ExecutionAdmissionPlacement.free`) check that all of these hold:
  - the binding is not CSI and not a Resident Workspace;
  - it is session-class and does not share Runtime Sessions;
  - it has no lifecycle authority;
  - the Session root exists;
  - it has no storage, or LOCAL storage.

  Such an admission locks the Session root as its first statement instead of placement. Every other admission takes placement first, as before.
- **The root is the first statement.** Under REPEATABLE READ the first plain read fixes the snapshot, and `lockExecutionControl` starts with one. Locking the root first makes the fence read see every drain committed before the root was granted.
- **One storage order.** Admission and `createSession` lock the binding before the `ma_storage` alias and `ma_storage_owner` rows. `completeStoppedSessionRelease` locked them the other way round, which placement used to make safe. It now locks the binding first. The design records the audit of every LOCAL alias and owner locker.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/admission-off-placement/docs/design/2026-11-05-managed-admission-placement.md), [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/admission-off-placement/docs/design/2026-11-05-managed-admission-placement.zh-CN.md).

## Why it's needed

After #16415, every tool call of a tenant still queued once on the tenant placement row. It waited behind binding transitions, provisioning, retention, maintenance, collectors and writer acquisition.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

`ExecutionControlTenantGuardsTest` runs on H2, and on MySQL through `ExecutionControlTenantGuardsMySqlIT`:

- `sessionIsolatedAdmissionCompletesWhileBothTenantGuardsAreHeld`;
- `withoutASessionRootAdmissionKeepsPlacement`;
- `drainWaitsForTheSessionRootAnAdmissionHolds`;
- `admissionAfterACommittedDrainIsRefusedWithoutPlacement`: the refusal arrives while placement is held, so the admission took the fast path.

`ExecutionControlTenantGuardsMySqlIT.admissionBesideDrainAndBindingControlOfTheSameSessionDoesNotDeadlock` runs 40 admissions against binding control of the same binding and a drain of the Session. The test checks two things:

- there is no InnoDB deadlock;
- every admission after the first refused one is refused.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, every admission took placement. After, run locally (macOS, JDK 21, Maven 3.9.16; MySQL 8.4.2) with `-Pmysql-integration`, covering the tests that exercise `admitExecution`, `requestHarnessDrain`, `requestWorkspaceClose` and `completeStoppedSessionRelease`:

- **H2:** `ExecutionControlTenantGuardsTest`, `RuntimeHarnessDrainTest` (74), `RuntimeBrokerServiceTest` (199), `WorkspaceLifecycleStoreTest` (68), `SessionLifecycleCoordinatorTest` (37), `OperationRetryTerminalStateTest` (81), `WorkspaceRuntimeTest` (53), `JdbcPhysicalStorageReleaseTest`, `SharedHarnessOwnershipTest`, `Issue13183*Test`, `WorkspaceSessionCloseTest`, `WorkspaceSessionRetentionTest`, `DispatchAuthorizationEvidenceTest`, and the lock contract, `ClassSizeRatchetTest` and `ManagedStoreDecompositionTest` suites. All pass.
- **MySQL:** these pass:
  - `ExecutionControlTenantGuardsMySqlIT` (9);
  - `RuntimeHarnessDrainMySqlIT` (74);
  - `WorkspaceLifecycleMySqlIT` (86);
  - `JdbcRuntimeBrokerMySqlIT`;
  - `WorkspaceExecutionMembershipMySqlIT`;
  - the Runtime retention, Resident and CSI checkpoint and reservation suites.

  `WorkspaceCsiNativeActivationRenewalMySqlIT` fails for the known environmental reason: `packages/core/dist` is not built locally.
- **Static checks:** checkstyle passed; spotbugs was skipped locally.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ targeted H2 + MySQL 8.4.2 suites |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested (CI) |

### Environment (optional)

macOS 13, JDK 21.0.13, Maven 3.9.16, MySQL 8.4.2 (local, disposable).

## Risk & Scope

- **Main risk or tradeoff:**
  - A plain read placed before the root lock would reopen the drain race under REPEATABLE READ. `lockEntry` is the first statement, and its comment says why.
  - The drain now waits for the Session root behind that Session's short journal and lifecycle steps.
- **Not validated / out of scope:**
  - SSH_LOCAL, CSI and EXTERNAL storage keep placement, because their alias and owner lockers were not audited.
  - Bindings that share Runtime Sessions, Resident Workspaces and lifecycle-authority admissions are unchanged.
  - The full MySQL pipeline and spotbugs run in CI.
- **Breaking changes / migration notes:** none. There are no schema, API or configuration changes.

## Linked Issues

Related to #13800. Follows #16415.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次 PR 的改动

普通 session 类 binding 的工具执行准入不再获取租户 `runtime_placement`。这是 #16415 的 (b) 部分；#16415 让派发不再获取两把租户 guard，准入不再获取 publication guard。

placement 让准入对 harness drain fence 的普通读与 fence 的写入方互斥：

- 生命周期开始和生命周期 effects 本来就在 Session root 下写 fence，而 #16415 之后准入一直持有这个 root。
- storage fence 有迁移的 `assertRetired` 兜底。
- `requestHarnessDrain` 是缺口：它不获取准入会获取的任何行。

具体改动：

- **drain 获取 Session root。** `requestHarnessDrain` 在 placement 之后、写 fence 之前锁 Session root。placement → root 是所有 placement 持有者已经在用的顺序。
- **不经 placement 的准入。** 事务开始前，用独立连接上的普通读（`ExecutionAdmissionPlacement.free`）确认以下条件全部满足：
  - binding 不是 CSI，也不是常驻工作区；
  - binding 是 session 类，且不共享 Runtime Session；
  - 没有 lifecycle authority；
  - Session root 存在；
  - 没有存储，或存储为 LOCAL。

  满足的准入以锁 Session root 作为第一条语句，代替 placement；其他准入照旧先获取 placement。
- **root 是第一条语句。** 在 REPEATABLE READ 下，第一次普通读会定下快照，而 `lockExecutionControl` 一开始就有一次普通读。先锁 root，读 fence 时就能看到 root 锁授予之前已提交的所有 drain。
- **统一存储相关的加锁顺序。** 准入和 `createSession` 都先锁 binding，再锁 `ma_storage` alias 行和 `ma_storage_owner` 行。`completeStoppedSessionRelease` 原来顺序相反，过去靠 placement 才安全，现在改为先锁 binding。设计文档记录了对所有 LOCAL alias 和 owner 加锁者的审计。

设计文档（[英文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/admission-off-placement/docs/design/2026-11-05-managed-admission-placement.md)、[简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/admission-off-placement/docs/design/2026-11-05-managed-admission-placement.zh-CN.md)）。

## 为什么需要

#16415 之后，租户内每次工具调用仍要在租户 placement 行上排一次队，排在 binding 状态转换、provisioning、retention、维护、回收器和 writer 获取之后。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

`ExecutionControlTenantGuardsTest` 在 H2 上运行，也通过 `ExecutionControlTenantGuardsMySqlIT` 在 MySQL 上运行：

- `sessionIsolatedAdmissionCompletesWhileBothTenantGuardsAreHeld`；
- `withoutASessionRootAdmissionKeepsPlacement`；
- `drainWaitsForTheSessionRootAnAdmissionHolds`；
- `admissionAfterACommittedDrainIsRefusedWithoutPlacement`：拒绝发生在 placement 仍被持有的时候，说明准入走的是快速路径。

`ExecutionControlTenantGuardsMySqlIT.admissionBesideDrainAndBindingControlOfTheSameSessionDoesNotDeadlock` 让 40 次准入与同一 binding 的 binding 控制、该 Session 的 drain 并发，检查两点：

- 没有 InnoDB 死锁；
- 第一次被拒绝之后的准入全部被拒绝。

### 证据（改前与改后）

改前，每次准入都获取 placement。改后，在本地（macOS、JDK 21、Maven 3.9.16、MySQL 8.4.2）以 `-Pmysql-integration` 运行了覆盖 `admitExecution`、`requestHarnessDrain`、`requestWorkspaceClose` 和 `completeStoppedSessionRelease` 的测试：

- **H2：** `ExecutionControlTenantGuardsTest`、`RuntimeHarnessDrainTest`（74）、`RuntimeBrokerServiceTest`（199）、`WorkspaceLifecycleStoreTest`（68）、`SessionLifecycleCoordinatorTest`（37）、`OperationRetryTerminalStateTest`（81）、`WorkspaceRuntimeTest`（53）、`JdbcPhysicalStorageReleaseTest`、`SharedHarnessOwnershipTest`、`Issue13183*Test`、`WorkspaceSessionCloseTest`、`WorkspaceSessionRetentionTest`、`DispatchAuthorizationEvidenceTest`，以及锁契约、`ClassSizeRatchetTest`、`ManagedStoreDecompositionTest`，全部通过。
- **MySQL：** 以下测试通过：
  - `ExecutionControlTenantGuardsMySqlIT`（9）；
  - `RuntimeHarnessDrainMySqlIT`（74）；
  - `WorkspaceLifecycleMySqlIT`（86）；
  - `JdbcRuntimeBrokerMySqlIT`；
  - `WorkspaceExecutionMembershipMySqlIT`；
  - Runtime retention、常驻工作区以及 CSI checkpoint 和 reservation 测试。

  `WorkspaceCsiNativeActivationRenewalMySqlIT` 失败，是已知的环境原因：本地没有构建 `packages/core/dist`。
- **静态检查：** checkstyle 通过；本地跳过 spotbugs。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :--: | :-- |
| macOS | 已运行相关 H2 与 MySQL 8.4.2 测试 |
| Windows | 未测试 |
| Linux | 未测试（CI） |

### 环境（可选）

macOS 13、JDK 21.0.13、Maven 3.9.16、本地临时 MySQL 8.4.2。

## 风险与范围

- **主要风险或取舍：**
  - 如果在锁 root 之前插入一次普通读，就会在 REPEATABLE READ 下重新打开 drain 竞态。`lockEntry` 是第一条语句，注释中写明了原因。
  - drain 现在要等待 Session root，排在该 Session 很短的 journal 和生命周期步骤之后。
- **未验证或不在范围内：**
  - SSH_LOCAL、CSI 和 EXTERNAL 存储仍获取 placement，因为它们的 alias 和 owner 加锁者没有审计。
  - 共享 Runtime Session 的 binding、常驻工作区和带 lifecycle authority 的准入不变。
  - 完整 MySQL 流水线和 spotbugs 在 CI 中运行。
- **破坏性变更与迁移说明：** 无。没有 schema、API 或配置变化。

## 关联问题

与 #13800 相关；承接 #16415。

</details>
